fdroid:com.al.countforme.name: Count for me
fdroid:com.al.countforme.summary: An interval timer you write, not one you just set.
fdroid:com.al.countforme.description:
An opinionated interval timer built for workouts that do not fit neatly into standard work, rest, and round patterns.
 What it does 
 Timers that announce and stop. A single cue when the timer reaches zero, like a sports watch, with no alarm to dismiss.
 Two interval modes that fit how you think. Build workouts from work, rest, cycles, and sets, or define a block, cycle, and work duration and let the timer calculate the rest and cycle count.
 Variable cadence timer. Split a block into ranges and give each range its own rate. Repeat the complete pattern across rounds.
 Themes that carry their sound and their music. A theme is the colours, the sound of every cue, the spoken counts, and the music the workout runs to, in one folder. The app ships with one; make your own from blank or from a copy, edit it in place, and see it live.
 Music the cues cut through. Play your own music in the app and every cue ducks it: the song drops as the cue lands and comes back between, by however much and however fast you set.
 Presets in categories. Save a complete setup by name, group presets into categories, and pick one back up from the top of the screen. A category can name a theme, and picking a preset from it puts that theme on — its look, its cues, and its music, or as much of that as the category asks for.
 Presets and themes that travel. Export what a tab holds to a file, or a theme as a zip, and hand it to someone else. Import either from anywhere on the phone.
 What it can become for you 
Nothing above is new in kind. It is deeper. A theme is not colours any more but colours, sounds and music. A preset is not alone but in a category, and a category can carry a theme. Both travel.
Put those together and you are not saving a workout. You are saving a story line.
A set of workouts with its own palette, its own gong, its own voice counting the reps, its own music underneath it all, and names that mean something to you, is an identity. Someone who opens it does not open five squats, five push-ups, five pull-ups, five rounds. They open a room you made, and the workout is what happens in it. A program can walk them through levels of it, each with its own look and sound.
This is a tool for creators and for a community. It is made for sharing your programs and what stands behind them: the part of you that does not usually travel with a program. Your mood, your thinking, the zone you are in. Sounds, colours, themed categories, the names of the workouts and the workouts themselves all say it, and they say it together.
You are the creator, and you decide what this app is. Another interval timer, or far more than that. It is in your hands.

fdroid:com.lord1egypt.pocketclaw.name: PocketClaw
fdroid:com.lord1egypt.pocketclaw.summary: A private AI agent that runs on your Android phone, with real on-device tools
fdroid:com.lord1egypt.pocketclaw.description:
PocketClaw is a private AI agent that runs on your Android phone. The language model is remote — you bring an API key for the provider you choose — but everything else lives on the device: the agent's gateway, its tools, its workspace and your credentials.
 What it does 
 An on-device agent gateway, bound to loopback only. The background core uses about 20 MB of memory (PSS) while idle and roughly 26–33 MB during active agent work on our Android 16 test phone; the app's screens and web view use more while they are open.
 A Managed Runtime of real command-line tools compiled for the phone and shipped inside the APK: python 3.14, git 2.51, gh 2.101, curl 8.11, ripgrep 14.1, sqlite3 3.50 and jq 1.7. PocketClaw never downloads its runtime after install; the tools reach the network only when the agent uses them for something you asked.
 Skills: reusable instruction and tool bundles. The agent can find and install them from the ClawHub registry or GitHub when you ask it to.
 A local web dashboard for providers, models, channels, skills and logs, in 14 languages. It opens inside the app, and in a browser on your own network if you turn on Public Mode.
 Chat with the agent in the app, or over Telegram.
 A workspace directory in the app's own storage that the agent reads and writes.
 The app itself in 12 languages, right-to-left included.
 Requirements 
 An arm64-v8a device with Android 8.0 or newer. The bundled tools and the agent runtime exist for arm64 only.
 An API key for a model provider, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint you run yourself.
 Network services 
PocketClaw contacts nothing until you configure it. It then talks only to what you set up:
 The model provider you choose. Built-in templates include proprietary services (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI and others) and self-hosted ones (Ollama, vLLM, any OpenAI-compatible server).
 Telegram, if you connect it. One-tap setup uses PocketClaw's onboarding service, whose source is published under the MIT licence; a manual bot token works without it.
 Whatever the agent's tools reach when you ask them to: web search (Sogou by default; SearXNG and others are selectable), git remotes, GitHub, the ClawHub skill registry, URLs you give it.
There are no analytics, no crash reporting and no update checks.
 Anti-feature: non-free network services 
PocketClaw promotes and integrates with proprietary network services: hosted AI model providers, Telegram and other chat platforms, web search and the ClawHub skill registry. None of them is required — a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible model server and the in-app chat are enough.
PocketClaw's own code is MIT licensed. The agent core is based on PicoClaw.

fdroid:com.pebblentn.app.name: PebbleNTN
fdroid:com.pebblentn.app.summary: Turn-by-turn directions from your phone's nav apps on your Pebble watch
fdroid:com.pebblentn.app.description:
PebbleNTN — Pebble Notification To Navigation — puts the turn-by-turn directions from your phone's navigation app onto your Pebble watch, so you don't have to reach for your phone while you ride, walk or drive.
It works by reading your navigation app's notifications on the phone and sending the next step to the watch: distance, road name, and — depending on the app — the maneuver arrow and ETA. Nothing is sent to any server — the notification is parsed on your device and forwarded to your paired Pebble over the local connection.
Supported navigation apps:
* Google Maps (English plus German, French, Spanish, Italian and Dutch) — maneuver arrow, distance, road and ETA
* Organic Maps — distance and road; the watch shows a neutral turn marker (no ETA)
* CoMaps — distance and road; the watch shows a neutral turn marker (no ETA)
* OsmAnd — distance and road; the watch shows a neutral turn marker (no ETA)
Full maneuver arrows and ETA for these apps depend on data they don't currently put in the notification text; support may improve in a future update.
PebbleNTN recognises each app's notifications with a small, declarative rule set that ships with the app, so support for more apps can come in future releases. You can write your own rules for an unsupported app, or share an anonymised capture log to help add official support.
Features:
* Next maneuver, distance, road and ETA on the watch (maneuver icon and ETA are currently Google Maps only — see supported apps above)
* Automatic watchapp launch when navigation starts (configurable in settings)
* Three arrow styles, accent colours, and light or dark themes
* Metric or imperial units, left- or right-hand arrow layout
* Privacy-first: the notification is parsed locally and never uploaded; the optional "share logs to help" step lets you review and redact before sharing
* No ads, no tracking, no account
Permissions:
* Notification access — to read the navigation app's turn-by-turn notification (this is the core function)
* Internet — not used on Google Play installs, which get their updates from Google Play. Installs from GitHub, F-Droid or Obtainium use it only for an optional check for a newer version on GitHub (when you tap Check for updates, or weekly if you turn it on); it sends no personal data
Requires a paired Pebble watch and the Pebble/Rebble companion app installed on the phone. The matching Pebble watchapp is distributed separately (Rebble app store / .pbw).

fdroid:io.paperterm.app.name: PaperTerm
fdroid:io.paperterm.app.summary: An e-ink-friendly SSH terminal for Android
fdroid:io.paperterm.app.description:
PaperTerm is an SSH terminal built for e-paper devices such as the Onyx Boox range, where
screens redraw slowly and leave ghosting behind. It pairs the Termux terminal engine with a
pure-Java SSH client, and adds the details that make a terminal usable on e-ink.
It is a pure SSH client: there is no local shell and no local code execution.
 Readable on e-paper 
A dark-on-white ANSI palette keeps nvim, less and top legible instead of washing them out.
Ghosting was stress-tested with fast streaming output, large dumps, full-screen inversion,
repeated clears and TUI scrolling: the device's own EPD handling turned out to beat app-level
refresh calls, which caused keyboard flashing, so PaperTerm deliberately stays out of the way.
 Page turning, e-reader style 
Turn pages with the volume keys or on-screen triangles. Auto, Page-keys and Wheel modes let
editors and terminal multiplexers each behave the way they should.
 Korean and CJK input 
Composed syllables appear as they are finalized, without sending backspaces, so vim and other
full-screen apps stay safe. Latin text is sent immediately. Jamo can optionally be shown while
composing.
 A keyboard row you control 
The extra-keys row is fully customizable: a comma separates keys, a semicolon starts a new row,
and KEY=label sets the icon. Any other token is typed literally, so symbols or whole words can
become keys.
 SSH essentials 
Password and key authentication with a shared key store, known_hosts verification, keepalive,
reconnect after an unexpected disconnect, clipboard support including OSC 52, and per-host
environment injection so remote shells can switch to light themes.
 Typography 
Four bundled monospace fonts (CJK-capable by default), font import, and pinch-to-zoom sizing.
PaperTerm is free software under the GPLv3.

fdroid:net.clench.wallet.name: Clench Wallet
fdroid:net.clench.wallet.summary: Secure non-custodial Bitcoin wallet with multisig support
fdroid:net.clench.wallet.description:
Clench is a Bitcoin-only, non-custodial Bitcoin wallet for Android. It uses Bitcoin Dev Kit and stores wallet data locally on the device.
Wallet features:
- Create single-sig and multisig wallets.
- Import watch-only wallets from descriptors.
- Create or restore BIP-39 seed phrase wallets with an optional passphrase.
- Use native SegWit, nested SegWit, legacy, and Taproot script types.
- Connect to Electrum servers, including personal servers and Tor SOCKS5 routes.
- Use coin control, UTXO freezing, labels, batch payments, RBF fee bumping, CPFP, cancel replacement attempts, raw transaction import, and sweep flows.
- Run node diagnostics for Electrum route, Tor mode, TLS pinning, server version, and tip height.
Hardware-wallet features:
- Exchange PSBTs by animated QR, BBQr, an intentional NFC tap, microSD/user-selected file import, or signed-return import where supported.
- Clench does not communicate with signing devices over USB or Bluetooth. A signer may still use USB for power.
- Work with QR-based signers such as SeedSigner, Keystone, Foundation Passport, and Blockstream Jade. v0.3.28 adds physically unverified protocol presets intended for OneKey Pro, Krux, and Specter DIY; the Krux and Specter DIY presets also include user-selected microSD/file transfer.
- Work with Coldcard Q, Coldcard Mk4, and Coldcard Mk5 transfer paths.
- Check TAPSIGNER NFC Tap Protocol status.
- Sweep SATSCARD active slots with certificate verification and explicit CVC-authenticated unseal confirmation.
- Set up, verify, import, and back up TAPSIGNER cards, and directly sign supported single-signature BIP84 native-SegWit or standard BIP48 native-P2WSH multisig inputs with complete in-app review and returned-signature verification.
- TAPSIGNER payment signing does not support Taproot, legacy, nested SegWit, nonstandard P2WSH, other account paths, or PIN change.
- The OneKey Pro, Krux, Specter DIY, and TAPSIGNER multisig paths have automated coverage but no recorded physical-device acceptance; no model/firmware compatibility claim is made for those new paths.
- Require explicit broadcast confirmation after hardware-wallet signing.
Security and privacy features:
- Encrypt keys with Android Keystore.
- Encrypt the Room application database with SQLCipher. BDK public wallet-state files rely on the Android app sandbox and device encryption.
- Protect wallet access with PIN and biometric authentication where available.
- Validate signed PSBTs and finalized transactions before broadcast.
- Avoid analytics, advertising SDKs, Firebase, Google Play Services, crash reporting services, and account sign-in.
Network use is limited to wallet sync and optional user-triggered fee or price data lookups.
Clench is free software under the MIT License.

controlled by SMS commands.

- Log to multiple destinations with multiple settings (frequency, min distance, min accuracy, significant move)
- Log to PhoneTrack Nextcloud app (PhoneTrack log job)
- Log to any server which can receive HTTP GET or POST requests (custom log job)
- Store positions when network is not available
- Remote control by SMS:
 - get position
 - activate alarm
 - start all logjobs
 - stop all logjobs
 - create a logjob
- Start on system boot
- Display devices of a Nextcloud PhoneTrack session on a map
- Dark theme
- Multi-Lingual User-Interface (translated on https://crowdin.com/project/phonetrack )
# Requirements
If you want to log to Nextcloud PhoneTrack app :
- Nextcloud instance running
- Nextcloud PhoneTrack app enabled
Otherwise, no requirements! (Except Android>=4.3)
# Alternatives
If you don't like this app and you are looking for alternatives: Have a look at the logging methods/apps
in PhoneTrack wiki : https://gitlab.com/eneiluj/phonetrack-oc/wikis/userdoc#logging-methods .

Blinken is based on an electronic game released in 1978, which challenges players to remember
 sequences of increasing length. On the face of the device, there are 4 different color buttons,
 each one with their own distinctive sound. These buttons light up randomly, creating the sequence
 that the player must then recall. If the player is successful in remembering the sequence of lights
 in the correct order, they advance to the next stage, where an identical sequence with one extra
 step is presented. If they are incorrect, the game is lost, and the player must start again from
 the beginning. The goal is to get a high score - each step in the sequence is worth one point,
 so correct entry of a sequence of 8 lights is worth 8 points on the high score table.

ikoOSKAR (short for iko Ortak Sınav Karma Sistemi) allows you to easily generate and manage randomized student seating schemes for exams.

 With ikoOSKAR you can:
 Create student placement schemes with minimum same-grade student interaction.
 Get placement schemes for each classroom / exam hall.
 Create the list of students' exam places (the classroom / exam hall and the desk number) for each class / section, respectively.
 Prevent students from cheating in exams.
 Easily manage the student database.
 View and manipulate each class / section.
 Add hundreds of new students to the database at once; just select the spreadsheet file exported from e-Okul or create your own xlsx file.
 Add, edit or remove individual students.
 Update all students' grade informations at the end of each academic year, with just one click.
 This action also assumes that every 12th grade student have graduated and proceeds to delete every 12th grade student from the database.
 View and edit older schemes, grouped by date.

The AES implementation uses AES-NI when available (on x86 and x86-64 architecture), but fallback gracefully to a software C implementation. The software implementation uses S-Boxes, which might suffer for cache timing issues. fedora-packages:ocaml-ppx-let/ocaml-ppx-.description: Ppx_let is a ppx rewriter for monadic and applicative let bindings, match expressions, and if expressions. The aim of this rewriter is to make monadic and applicative code look nicer by writing custom binders the same way that we normally bind variables. In OCaml, the common way to bind the result of a computation to a variable is: ``` let VAR = EXPR in BODY ``` ppx_let simply adds two new binders: `let%bind` and `let%map`. These are rewritten into calls to the bind and map functions respectively. These functions are expected to have ``` val map : 'a t -> f:('a -> 'b) -> 'b t val bind : 'a t -> f:('a -> 'b t) -> 'b t ``` for some type `t`, as one might expect. These functions are to be provided by the user, and are generally expected to be part of the signatures of monads and applicatives modules. This is the case for all monads and applicatives defined by the Jane Street's Core suite of libraries.

See https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax for the canonical reference, but known syntactic ”gotchas” relative to Python are: • PCRE supports \Z and \z; RE2 supports \z; Python supports \z, but calls it \Z. You must rewrite \Z to \z in pattern strings. Known differences between this module’s API and the re module’s API: • The error class does not provide any error information as attributes. • The Options class replaces the re module’s flags with RE2’s options as gettable/settable properties. Please see re2.h for their documentation. • The pattern string and the input string do not have to be the same type. Any str will be encoded to UTF-8. • The pattern string cannot be str if the options specify Latin-1 encoding.

firefox-addons:3120937.name: MAX Privacy Guard
firefox-addons:3120937.summary: Block selected tracking requests on MAX and reduce WebRTC address exposure in the Firefox web client.
firefox-addons:3120937.description:
MAX Privacy Guard applies browser rules to web.max.ru to block known tracking requests and reduce WebRTC address exposure. Choose the available protection mode, review activity in the local panel, and keep your MAX browsing settings in Firefox.
 Free: basic and strict MAX protection, WebRTC controls, and a local activity log.
 Pro: VK protection after you grant Firefox site access, up to 10 saved settings profiles, and user-initiated removal of cookies and site data after browser permission and confirmation.

firefox-addons:3062950.summary: Pomodoro timer, site blocker & focus analytics. Stay focused, get more done.

FocusZone - Focus & Productivity 🎯
Pomodoro timer, site blocker & focus analytics. Stay focused, get more done.
A green-and-gold focus companion. Start a Pomodoro, take a break, and — with Pro — lock distracting sites only while you are actually focusing.

 Timer 
 Focus, short break, and long break with a live ring (free);
 Pause, resume, skip, or stop;
 Auto-start the next break or focus session;
 Desktop notifications and an optional completion chime.
 Site blocking (Pro) 
 Add domains you want locked during focus;
 Rules turn on only while a focus session is running — browsing stays free on breaks;
 A friendly blocked page reminds you to stay on task.
 Stats (Pro) 
 Total focus minutes, completed sessions, current and best streaks;
 A 7-day chart of daily minutes.
 Configurable 
 Language: follow system, English, or 中文;

 Free & Pro

firefox-addons:780964.name: Block Image|Video
firefox-addons:780964.summary: Easily block all images and videos within a website!
firefox-addons:780964.description:
Block Image|Video is an addon that lets you easily block or hide desired items (image, video, etc.) with just one click. 
Once you add this addon to your Firefox, a button will appear in the toolbar. This button shows that the addon is active (with a red color). Now, before using the addon, please visit the options page and choose a desired item(s) to block or hide (i.e. image). 
By default, NO item is selected. Please note that, if you choose to - hide - items, the addon lets these items to be loaded in the browser, but, will make them invisible. On the other hand, if you choose to – block - any item, the addon prevents that specific item from loading into your browser. This way, loading the web-pages may become faster but you cannot make images to become visible again (if the addon is turned off).
 Note 1 : before using the addon, please visit the options page and adjust the item(s) you want to block or hide.
 Note 2 : to report bugs, please visit the addon homepage and fill the bug report form.

firefox-addons:784025.name: YouTube Dark Theme
firefox-addons:784025.summary: A highly customizable dark charcoal/blue theme for YouTube
firefox-addons:784025.description:
"Dark Theme for YouTube" extension converts YouTube theme to a highly customizable dark charcoal/blue theme. This extension is built on top of the default YouTube theme (native dark theme) so it is very light-weighted compare to using themes injected by Stylish or Stylus extensions.
Extension Preview:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3lan4mQKxBk 
Features:
Turn on and off from the action button to switch between light and dark themes
Accepts scheduling to turn on only on the specified period
Customize default color scheme
Inject custom CSS to alter the default theme (change font-size or font-family for instance)
How does this extension work?
This extension alters a cookie globally to turn the dark theme on and off. It also injects a lite script to the YouTube pages to alter the color scheme of the root element. In oppose to the other similar extensions, there is no resetting of the default theme or inverting the white theme with an inversion filter. Both of these methods are computationally inefficient. Instead, this extension asks YouTube to turn the native dark theme and only alter the global CSS variables to alter the colors.
Note that this method only works if the product supports native coloring. Some Google products do not yet support this feature.
Privacy Policy: 
This extension does not send or receive any data to any server whatsoever.
Bug Report:
Please either use the commenting section of the FAQs page or the GitHub page for bug reporting.
Change Log:
0.2.0
Use the built-in dark theme (Material Design only)

bluejetty:00116033:ios.description:
GoTall is the most accurate height predictor. Here's why it works:
1. We use real science.
GoTall uses data from the CDC, a group of top doctors and scientists who study how kids grow.
2. To guess your true potential, we ask about:
Your parents' and relatives' height (because your genes matter)
Your sleep, food, and activity (because habits affect growth)
Your stage of puberty (because timing matters)
We look at the full picture.
Instead of guessing from just your age, we look at everything together. That’s why our results are more accurate than just using a growth chart.
Stick to the growth plan, and we’ll keep guiding you every step of the way.
GoTall gives you a custom growth plan that includes:
Daily exercises proven to support posture, bone strength, and natural growth hormone activity
Nutrition analysis that checks if your diet supports optimal growth
Lifestyle tracking so you can improve sleep, habits, and recovery
We also offer premium features with subscriptions or purchases, such as a custom plan designed to support natural HGH production and optimal growth, or monthly updates that adjust your plan based on your habits and progress, so you can stay on track.
Disclaimer: GoTall doesn’t offer medical advice. Our recommendations are based on widely known practices related to height growth. Always speak to a healthcare provider for individualized guidance.
Some features, including full analysis and advanced tools, require a premium subscription or purchase.

bluejetty:00156513:ios.description:
Bees360 is a leading innovator of deep learning and computer vision technology who focuses on bringing AI and drone solutions to property underwriting and claim inspections. It is founded by PhDs and insurance experts whose collective background in data science, mathematics, property claims & underwriting provide an unparalleled level of knowledge to build AI-powered workflow and a disruptive business model for the conventional insurance industry.
The new BeesPilot™ app offers the following features:
1. All-In-One App: Combine Drone Flight, Mobile Image Acquisition, and Onsite Interview altogether. Drone pilots can complete property inspections using this single App;
2. Map view: Display the geographic locations of all properties in one map;
3. History List: Automatically archive the completed inspections in the History List;
4. Inspection Detail Page: Provide the fastest route to the next property along with key information about the inspection;
5. More Drone Compatibility: Now offering compatibility with 8 different types of drones which include: DJI Phantom 4, Phantom 4 Pro & V2.0, Phantom 4 Advanced, Mavic Pro & Platinum, Mavic 2 Zoom, Mavic 2 Pro, Mavic Air, and Mavic Mini.
Tips：
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Follow us:
1. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/bees360inc/
2. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/bees360/
3. Twitter: https://twitter.com/bees360inc
4. YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNdTfmxsU51NYmryJpGScOw
Visit our website for more information at www.bees360.com.

bluejetty:00186208:ios.description:
Following the footsteps of Maha Periyava!!!
Sri Kamakshi Community Center (SKCC) was founded with goal of pursuing the vision and teachings of Sri Sri Sri Maha Periyava, Peetathipathi of Kanchi Kamakodi Peedam in maintaining and learning Hindu Vedic tradition and values. SKCC has the blessing and privilege of having Sri Kamakshi and Sri Sri Sri Maha Periyava Shrine. 
SKCC is pleased to launch our first smartphone app. 
 - It makes available all upcoming events of the center at your finger tips, sends reminder for events through push notifications so you will never miss the next big event at the center
 - You can sponsor for events, sign up for Puja or Archana right from the app!
 - This app is a great learning tool, be it your favorite Sanskrit Slokas or Veda Mantras
 - You can learn our time old and cherished custom of Sanatana Dharma from the life history of our Acharyas of Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam and their tireless work to uphold our Sanatana Dharma.
The next generation of children growing in Bay Area and other cities world around will enjoy this learning opportunity and be able to connect to our roots. More features planned so check for updates periodically!

bluejetty:00119461:ios.name: Pharos Print
bluejetty:00119461:ios.summary: The Pharos Print app, part of the Pharos MobilePrint solution, allows you to easily submit content from your iOS device to a Pharos secure print queue. To use this app, Pharos MobilePrint and a Pharos secure print solution must be in place
bluejetty:00119461:ios.description:
The Pharos Print app, part of the Pharos MobilePrint solution, allows you to easily submit content from your iOS device to a Pharos secure print queue. To use this app, Pharos MobilePrint and a Pharos secure print solution must be in place within your organization.
Features
• Easily submit content from your phone or tablet into a Pharos secure print queue. 
• Edit your finishing options before you print. 
• Preview your document(s) before you print. 
• Delete a print job from your Pharos secure print queue.
• View all documents in your Pharos secure print queue.
• View your Available Funds and job cost (when applicable).
• Release print jobs to the printer (if configured).
• Select printers for release by scanning QR code (if configured).
Operating Environment
• Supports iOS 14.0 and newer iPhone and iPad models.
• Supports Pharos MobilePrint 2.0+ with Pharos Uniprint 9.0+ 
• Supports Pharos MobilePrint 2.0+ with Pharos Blueprint 5.2+ 
• QR Print Release requires MobilePrint 2.4 and Uniprint 9.1 SP3
Supported Files (Important)
Uploading or opening files from other apps via “Open In” and "Sharing", or via the "Upload" button in the app supports the following file formats: Microsoft Office® documents, Microsoft Outlook®, PDF, images (JPG, GIF, PNG, BMP), text files (CSV, RTF & TXT), and OpenOffice documents. 
How to use the features of Pharos Print app
[Note: some features or settings may be disabled by your organization, as noted]
A. Download and install the Pharos Print app to your iOS device.
B. Connect Pharos Print to your organization’s Pharos MobilePrint server.
 a. Open the Pharos Print app.
 b. Contact your organization’s IT administrator to obtain the Pharos MobilePrint server information (URL).
 c. Enter the Pharos Server Name and Server Port (both are required).
 d. Select Connect
 e. The Pharos Print app will connect to the Pharos server and display a User Authentication Screen.
C. Authenticate to the Pharos Server.
 a. Enter the credentials that you normally use to print (your username and password).
 b. Select Log On to enter the Pharos Print app.
D. Files can be submitted either via the Upload icon in the app or by using the native iOS “Open In” or the "Sharing" command to submit your print job. 
 a. To upload supported documents from the app, simply log in and use the "Upload" button. Sources for files on your device, or cloud, will be presented.
 b. To upload supported documents using “Open In" or "Sharing" 
 i. Select content in any app that supports “Open In" or "Sharing".
 ii. Select Open In/Share.
 iii. Select the Open/Share in Pharos Print icon.
E. You may set finishing options, preview, or delete a document
 a. Select a print job in your job list.
 b. Apply your desired finishing options via the "Print Options" tab at the bottom of the app:
 i. 1 sided or 2 sided
 ii. Color or Black & White
 iii. Pages per side
 iv. Number of copies
 v. Page range to print
 c. To preview documents, select a document and use the "Preview" button.
 d. To delete documents, select a document and use the "Delete" button.
F. To print documents, this option must be allowed by your organization
 a. Select document(s) to print
 b. Then either use the tab at the bottom of the app to select a printer (if available)
 c. Or use the “QR Code” icon at the top right of the app (if available) to enable the camera and point it at the QR code on the printer you want to print to.
G. To view available funds you have for printing, use the “Payment method” tab at the bottom of the app.
 a. If made available by your organization, the app may offer the ability to “Add Funds” via the link on this tab.
H. Logging out
 a. To log out of the Pharos Print app, select the gear icon in the upper left corner and select Log out.

bluejetty:00082763:ios.name: imoo Watch Phone
bluejetty:00082763:ios.summary: imoo watch phone is a product designed for children and parents. The app can be connected with the watch by wearing the watch on the children’s wrist and its supporting app on the parents’ mobile phone. Parents can make mutual calls between
bluejetty:00082763:ios.description:
imoo watch phone is a product designed for children and parents. The app can be connected with the watch by wearing the watch on the children’s wrist and its supporting app on the parents’ mobile phone. Parents can make mutual calls between the watch and the mobile phone, accurately locate the children’s position, and send voice message between the app and the watch by setting watch-related functions in the app. 
Main Functional Features:
1.Phone Function:
The phone module is installed in the hardware of the watch to allow calls between the phone and the watch, and between watches, thereby making communication and connection between parents and children more convenient. In addition, the watch can be switched freely between regular and privacy mode, making calls more comfortable.
2.Location Function:
A GPS chip and WiFi module are installed in the hardware of the watch, enabling the APP to show the precise position of the watch whether outdoors or indoors.
3.Chat Function:
Voice messages can be sent between the watch and the APP, realizing a new form of communication between children and parents. In addition, the APP can send SMS text messages to the watch for greater diversity of communication. 
4.Soaking Reminder: 
If the watch is accidentally immersed in water, the screen will light up to remind the child to stop using it. The APP will also send a message to the parents notifying them to contact the child. 
5.Schedule Alarm: 
Parents can set up and manage the daily schedule of the child through schedule alarms that remind the child to drink water, do homework and other matters by means of regular reminders, customized voice reminders, etc., enabling the child to gradually develop good time keeping habits.
6.SMS:
The watch will only receive messages from contacts in its address list and reject messages from strangers, thereby protecting the child from being affected by unwanted or harassing messages.
7.Step Counting Function:
The child’s number of steps can be viewed on the watch in order to help the parents record the child’s progress step by step and ensure their healthy growth. 
8.Class Mode:
Parents can set the times of the child’s classes. When the child attends school wearing the watch, they will not be distracted from learning by playing with the watch.
9.Contacts:
Parents can use the APP to manage the contacts on their child’s watch, thereby making sure that their child will not be harassed by unknown calls while also preventing their child from making random calls.
10.Unknown Call Rejection:
When the unknown call rejection function is activated through the APP, only the contacts in the address list can make calls to the watch, and strangers will be blocked. If receiving unknown calls, the APP will receive a notification message, giving the parents a chance to confirm the call. 
11.Auto Answer:
With the auto answer function activated through the APP, if the parents call the child and there is no answer, the watch will automatically connect after 10 seconds.
12.Call Location Report:
When the watch calls the phone, it automatically reports the location of the call to the parents.
13.Low Power Mode
With the reserve power function activated, when the power level of the watch drops too low, it will automatically enter low power mode, conveniently saving power for the parents to contact the child when required.
Note: This feature is not available on some models.

- Chúng ta sẽ dùng bộ bài tứ sắc với 104 lá: Tướng, Sĩ, Tượng, Xe, Pháo, Mã, Tốt mõi loại có 4 màu xanh, trắng, vàng, đỏ. Mõi màu lại có 4 lá.

- Người chơi nào hết rác đầu tiên ở lượt mình đi hoặc hết rác thì phải chờ tướng hoặc được gì đó thì mới được tới.

Vòng đánh: mõi lượt người chơi tư săc phải quánh hoặc dở bài ở bài cái ra, đưa qua mặt người kế nằm bên tay phải
Nếu dở hoặc rút bài thì ưu tiên được ăn lẻ (người có lá bài đó trước mặt), nhưng ăn chẵn nếu có vẫn bị cướp tạo nên Khàn hay Phụng.
Nếu quánh hoặc đánh thì ưu tiên người kế bên nằm ở bên tay phải.

- Chơi tư sắc đang hăng mà hết chíp thì vào lại cũng có.

- Tứ sắc có nhiều avatar là nhiều nhân vật xinh trai đẹp gái và thân thiện.
- Bàn chơi tư săc thì nhiều mà còn miễn phí.
- Bạn là cao thủ hay nghiệp dư đều có thể chơi Theo cấp độ phù hợp
- Icon, emotion cực ngầu

bluejetty:00119838:ios.name: ABC Kids - Tracing & Phonics
bluejetty:00119838:ios.summary:
Looking for a fun, free, and simple educational app to help your toddler learn phonics and trace letters of the alphabet? Look no further than ABC Kids.
ABC Kids is a free phonics and alphabet teaching app that makes learning fun for child
bluejetty:00119838:ios.description:
Looking for a fun, free, and simple educational app to help your toddler learn phonics and trace letters of the alphabet? Look no further than ABC Kids.
ABC Kids is a free phonics and alphabet teaching app that makes learning fun for children, from toddlers all the way to preschoolers and kindergartners. It features a series of tracing games to help kids recognize letter shapes, associate them with phonic sounds, and put their alphabet knowledge to use in fun matching exercises. Any toddler, kindergartener or preschool age child can learn English and the English alphabet simply by following the arrows with their finger. They can even collect stickers and toys as they complete tracing games!
ABC Kids is more than just a kid-friendly educational app, it was designed with adult participation in mind, too. The interface keeps toddlers focused on alphabet reading and writing, tucking menu commands away from moving fingers. Adults can easily access settings to engage Teacher Mode, look at report cards, or toggle tracing and phonics games to better facilitate learning.
Best of all, ABC Kids is full-featured and free from in-app purchases and third party advertisements. Toddlers and adults can enjoy learning together without interruption.
Features:
- A colorful early education app that helps children learn the English alphabet.
- Includes ABC tracing games, phonics pairing, letter matching, and more.
- Uppercase and lowercase letters to trace, listen to, and match.
- Smart interface helps kids focus on phonics and letters without accidentally exiting the game.
- No third party ads, no in-app purchases, no tricks. Just pure educational fun!
Note to Parents:
When creating ABC Kids, we wanted to build the best experience possible for both adults and for children. We're parents ourselves, and we know how paywalls, in-app purchases, and intrusive third party advertisements can detract from the learning experience. With ABC Kids, we put the features of a paid app into a preschool friendly package, leaving out frustrating pop-ups and microtransactions. The end result is exactly the educational experience we want for our children. We think you and your family will enjoy it, too!
- Best wishes from the parents at RV AppStudios

bluejetty:00161901:ios.description:
Health Mate Pro is an easy-to-use heart rate monitor, health app.
- Heart rate monitor free
- Check pulse, stress and energy
- View trends and reports
- Record blood pressure, blood oxygen and blood sugar
- Track body temperature and BMI
Our app seamlessly syncs with Apple Health, allowing you to access your health data effortlessly. Since Apple Health integrates with your Apple Watch, you can monitor your heart rate and tracker vital health metrics in real-time.
Key Features:
Heart Rate Monitoring, Easily measure your heartrate. Simply place your finger on the camera to measure your heart rate, inpulse: heart rate monitor free. Receive reminders to check your pulse and log your vitals on a daily basis so you can stay healthy and fit. Get your stress levels under control and negative emotions identified and leveled.
Blood Pressure App, tracking blood pressure by users to input their readings. Whether you have high, low, or normal blood pressure, this tool ensures you have a clear record of your data for ihealth blood pressure.
Blood Oxygen App, use Journal to record your blood oxygen saturation.
Blood Sugar App, for those managing diabetes or keeping an eye on their glucose levels, Health Mate Pro provides an easy way to record and track blood sugar levels.
BMI Calculator, free tool to track BMI, weight, and height. Monitor your progress and lose weight effectively with our BMI tracker to stay healthy!
thermometer: body temperature, keep an accurate log of your body temperature to monitor for fever.
Sleep Aid for Better Sleep – Relax with calming sleep sounds and guided articles. Improve mental health and sleep quality with soothing sleep: sounds.
The heart rate monitor is one of the fastest, easiest, and most accurate ways to monitor your heart health. Simply place your finger on the back of the camera to quickly check your heart rate. Health Mate Pro detects a color change in your finger tip each time your heart beats and uses an advanced algorithm to show you your heart rate.
How to Check Heart Rate Using Finger:
- Firstly, ensure that your fingers are clean and tidy for better detection.
- Gently press with your fingers to ensure that they cover the flashlight and camera lens.
- Keep your heart rate steady and wait for a moment to know the heart rate result.
Why Choose Health Mate Pro?
- Heart rate measurement
- Real-time photoplethysmogram (PPG) graph
- Blood Pressure Tracker
- Tracking: Blood Oxygen
- Blood Sugar Tracker
- BMI Calculator
- Thermometer: body temperature
- Sleep Aid for Better Sleep
- Apple Health App Support (Instant Heart Rate Settings > Health App Sync)
Health Mate Pro is your all-in-one health monitoring solution. It helps you keep record of essential health metrics like pulse, blood pressure, blood sugar, body temperature, and more. With the ability to log your health data, Health Mate Pro is the perfect companion for anyone looking to improve their well-being or manage chronic health conditions.
You can choose a free trial with all features available.
Subscription, Access to all features
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all the app has to offer.
- Subscriptions are billed automatically at a rate depending on the selected subscription plan.
- Users can manage their subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to their App Store Account Settings after purchase.
Important Note
- This application is not designed for medical purposes. it is for fitness purposes only.
- The app cannot measure blood pressure,blood sugar, oxygen levels, or body temperature.
- Any medical-related decisions should be made in consultation with a physician.
- My app tracks your health data, but it cannot connect directly to Apple Watch or Apple TV.
By using the app, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://sites.google.com/view/healthmateproprivacypolicy
https://sites.google.com/view/health-mate-pro-tos

bluejetty:00024008:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00024008:ios.description:
Meet Sniper Attack 3D, the most fun, easy to play FPS game ever equipped with great graphics and realistic sound effects.
Crawl on the ground, run, find the target, hold your breath and just release the trigger. Congratulations! You shot it.
You will experience various conflict areas and scenarios, such as the hostage crisis in front of a bank raided by robbers, the capture of a military base by militants.
Sometimes it will be enough to just hit the target they are standing in front of, not the enemy soldiers. Just shoot the target highlighted in red such as choppers, vehicles, ammunition depots or gas tankers.
As you level up, you can get new and more powerful weapons and jump in rank. However, you need to be careful that as you progress, the stable targets will become mobile and it will be difficult for you to aim. You have to neutralize the enemy soldiers before they shoot you.
You can get extra points for each enemy you shoot in the head. You will also earn extra points as you shoot the targets marked with green next to the enemy targets. But there is a dilemma, you should first shoot the prize to get it, not the enemy soldier. Which one will you shoot first? As soon as you hit the prize, the enemy soldier notices you and starts shooting at you.
Enemy soldiers will sometimes be wearing armoured helmets and vests, which will force you quite hard. So you shouldn't miss and waste your bullets. If you are careful, you can find small but pretty effective methods and pitfalls to kill them all.
Enjoy Sniper Attack 3D committed to the action!
This game has a subscription-based premium feature package, it enables users to use the app without advertisements and with extra features. It's an auto-renewable subscription. The subscription period is weekly. Payment is charged to the App Store account at confirmation. Subscription is renewed unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the period, and the account will be automatically charged for renewal as well. You may turn it off in your Account Settings anytime.

bluejetty:00084927:ios.description:

If you do not cancel the subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, it will automatically renew.

Mi Palacio: la aplicación oficial de El Palacio de Hierro
Pocas historias son tan fascinantes y entrañables como la de El Palacio de Hierro. Desde nuestra fundación en 1888 y la apertura del primer gran almacén en el Centro Histórico de la Ciudad de México, hemos sido pioneros y referencia de lujo en tiendas departamentales del país. A lo largo de 135 años, nos hemos convertido en parte de la vida e historia de México; forjando estrechos lazos con más de cinco generaciones de mexicanos. Somos una empresa orgullosamente mexicana que representa y selecciona lo mejor del mundo y del país. “Soy Totalmente Palacio” es una forma de ser, de vivir, expresar y celebrar el estilo personal.
Una experiencia de compra única
En "Mi Palacio", ofrecemos una selección exclusiva de las mejores marcas de moda para mujeres, hombres y niños, belleza, perfumería, relojes, joyería, hogar y tecnología. Lleva el estilo y lujo de El Palacio de Hierro siempre contigo y descubre una plataforma que combina lo mejor del diseño con funcionalidades innovadoras.

- ¿Tienes la imagen de algún artículo que te encante? Toma una foto o súbela desde tu galería y deja que nuestro buscador por imagen lo encuentre por ti.
- Guarda todos los artículos que te gusten en “Favoritos” y encuéntralos con un solo clic.
- Recibe notificaciones personalizadas de exclusivas, preventas y promociones directo en tu celular..
- Realiza tus compras con tu Tarjeta Palacio, tarjetas bancarias, tarjetas de débito o PayPal.
- No importa donde estés, realizamos envíos a toda la República Mexicana.
- Realiza devoluciones en cualquiera de nuestras tiendas sin complicaciones.

- Realiza el pago de tu Tarjeta Palacio de manera segura desde la aplicación.
- Controla tu Tarjeta Palacio de forma rápida y sencilla con la función de encendido y apagado.
- Consulta tu estado de cuenta, saldo, Puntos Palacio y movimientos en cualquier momento.
- Agrega todas tus Tarjetas Palacio y adicionales a tu app y manéjalas en un solo lugar.
Con "Mi Palacio" tienes acceso a:
Tendencias de Moda: Explora una amplia gama de artículos de lujo, desde bolsos, zapatos y joyería, hasta ropa de diseñador y moda infantil. Descubre estilos de marcas icónicas como Gucci, Kurt Geiger, Veja, Chanel, Balenciaga, Alexander McQueen y más.
Productos de belleza y cuidado personal: Desde fragancias exclusivas hasta maquillaje y productos para el cuidado de la piel, la app ofrece las mejores opciones para cada estilo y necesidad.
Hogar y tecnología: Equipa tu hogar con productos de lujo, muebles, y la última tecnología. Encuentra televisores, laptops, línea blanca y más.
Nuestras categorías destacadas incluyen:
- Moda y Accesorios para Mujer y Hombre
- Belleza y Fragancias
- Tecnología y Electrodomésticos
- Hogar y Decoración

- Facilidad de uso: Navega entre miles de productos y encuentra lo que necesitas.
- Compras seguras: Disfruta de la seguridad y confianza de El Palacio de Hierro en cada transacción.

bluejetty:00185952:ios.summary: Angry Shark Simulator is an exciting ocean adventure game that takes you deep into a stunning 3D underwater world filled with exploration, challenges, and endless fun. Start your journey as a powerful shark and discover a new way to experie
bluejetty:00185952:ios.description:
Angry Shark Simulator is an exciting ocean adventure game that takes you deep into a stunning 3D underwater world filled with exploration, challenges, and endless fun. Start your journey as a powerful shark and discover a new way to experience the ocean. Travel through beautifully designed environments, complete missions, and unlock new areas as you grow stronger. With smooth controls, high-quality graphics, and immersive sound effects, this offline simulator game gives you a relaxing yet thrilling ocean experience anytime, anywhere.
In this ocean simulator, you will guide your shark through different underwater zones, each offering unique challenges and objectives. Explore coral reefs, hidden caves, deep trenches, and vibrant marine regions filled with sea creatures. Every mission brings something new, including exploration tasks, collection challenges, timed objectives, and survival-based gameplay that keeps you engaged throughout the adventure. As you progress, you can upgrade your shark, unlock new species, and customize their appearance with a variety of skins.
Angry Shark Simulator offers a complete underwater experience with smooth mechanics that allow you to swim freely, navigate obstacles, and enjoy the beauty of the deep sea. The game is designed for players of all ages, providing a balance of calm exploration and mission-based excitement. Whether you want to relax and roam the ocean or take on exciting challenges, this simulator gives you the freedom to play your way.
You can choose from multiple shark types, each with its own style and animations. Unlock epic ocean creatures as you level up and expand your collection. Special effects and detailed underwater visuals make the world feel alive, while the dynamic controls help you move effortlessly through the ocean. Since the game is fully playable offline, you can enjoy the adventure anytime without needing an internet connection.
During your journey, you may encounter large ocean creatures or environmental challenges that require strategy and quick decision-making. Navigate wisely, use your timing skills, and explore every corner of the underwater world to complete your missions successfully. The game rewards exploration, curiosity, and clever movement, making each mission fresh and exciting.
With dozens of missions, multiple sharks to unlock, beautiful 3D environments, and smooth controls, Angry Shark Simulator offers a complete underwater adventure perfect for players who enjoy exploration, simulation, and ocean-themed games. Dive in, discover hidden secrets, complete challenges, and enjoy the ultimate deep-sea experience.
Download Angry Shark Simulator today and begin your journey through the amazing world beneath the waves!

bluejetty:00184686:ios.name: Tabletop
bluejetty:00184686:ios.summary: Tabletop is an expandable studio with over a dozen included musical devices. Tabletop is a modular environment where you can mix and match different devices. Select from over 40 devices including samplers, mixers, effects, sequencers and mo
bluejetty:00184686:ios.description:
Tabletop is an expandable studio with over a dozen included musical devices. Tabletop is a modular environment where you can mix and match different devices. Select from over 40 devices including samplers, mixers, effects, sequencers and more. Buy only the gear you need from an expanding catalog. 
Need help? Email support@retronyms.com and we’ll answer your questions. 
Retronyms has partnered with industry giants like Akai Professional and Arturia to create some of the Tabletop-Ready Apps, like iMPC, iMini, and iProphet! Using the Tabletop features of time stretching and pitch shifting, you can slice loops and time stretch them to different tempos and pitches in iMPC Pro. You can also use sliced loops from purchased AudioCopy sound packs inside Gridlock and iMPC Pro. Loops from these sound packs will automatically match the tempo of your sessions.
Tabletop is an audio playground where you can create beats, compose songs, mix live, make mashups with samples from your iPod library, and more... the possibilities are endless. Plug the output of a keyboard into a delay to add an echo, or wire it up to a mixer and adjust the pan. Chain up multiple effects to create new and evolving sounds. 
FEATURES: 
• 43 devices including effects, sequencers, drum machines, and synths
• 14 devices are included for free
• 64 bit audio support 
• Access powerful Tabletop-Ready Apps 
• Piano Roll style timeline editor
• Cut, copy, paste, duplicate, and create notes
• Control Tabletop’s keyboards, drum pads, knobs, faders, and other parameters
• Correct note timing with Fix to Grid
• Edit note length and velocity
• Undo changes and edits with Tabletop’s History Menu
• Features Core MIDI Support
• Works with any MIDI-compatible hardware
• Customize control mapping with Midi Learn mode
• Connect multiple devices
• Share your music to SoundCloud and interact with other Tabletop users

bluejetty:00180030:ios.description:
Board game for two people.
The goal of this tactical game is to align at least 4 tokens of the same color in a row (horizontal, vertical or diagonal).
You can play, without wifi (offline), against the computer or with another person on the same device.
You can also play this game online and challenge your family, friends or connected people around the world with the multiplayer mode. 
************ Features ***********
"1 Player": Play against the computer in 2 distinct modes:
 - "Challenge" Mode: Play a classic game against the AI.
Choose the difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert) and complete all levels. The AI's difficulty increases with the level.
 - "Puzzle" Mode: Win the game with the maximum number of tokens in predefined grids.
Choose the difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert) and complete the 50 randomly selected levels from a pool of 250 different levels.
After 3 consecutive failures, a hint will be offered to help you complete the level.
"2 Players": Play with two players on the same device. Choose your rules and tokens.
"Online": Play with another player connected via Game Center.
1 point is awarded for each round won, and an additional point is awarded to the winner.
If your opponent leaves the game or is disconnected before the end of the game, then you will be credited with 1 additional point.
************* Automatic Save ***********
All games started in "1 Player" or "2 Player" mode are automatically saved.
You can accumulate up to 10 saves in each game mode. Beyond that, the oldest saves are overwritten by the newest ones.
************* Statistics ***********
Only for single-player games (1 Player).
 In "Challenge" mode, the first line shows the number of times you have completed the chosen difficulty level.
For each difficulty level, the number of rounds, wins, losses, and draws completed is recorded.
 In "Puzzle" mode, the first line shows the number of times you have completed the chosen difficulty level without any losses.
The second line shows the number of times you have completed the chosen difficulty level (with or without a loss).
The third line shows the number of wins compared to the number of losses. In the case of multiple consecutive failures (on the same puzzle), only one loss is counted.
The fourth line shows the number of times you have asked for help to complete a puzzle.
The fifth line shows the number of puzzles completed out of the 250 available per difficulty level.
************* In-App Purchase ***********
Remove all ads from the game.
**************** Support ****************
https://dunjegame.com/Support.html
This is a free board game that contains advertisements that you can remove with in app purchase.
This game doesn't require wifi (no need of internet connection) for the 1 player and 2 players mode. Thus, you can use it like a pastime game during your travel (plane, train, bus, car, ...) without getting bored.
Be strategic and above all have fun !!

bluejetty:00120303:ios.description:
Experience Language Learning with LingQ — the natural and effective way to learn a new language.
LingQ is a language learning app that lets you grow your vocabulary and improve comprehension through meaningful exposure to the language with real content. 
Follow your interests and enjoy an immersive learning experience in over 50 languages. Learn Spanish, English, Japanese, Korean, Italian, German, Portuguese, French, Chinese, Arabic, and other languages.
Trusted by Learners Worldwide:
◆4.7 star rating from over 45000 reviews.
◆Featured in CBC, Men’s Health, La Vanguardia, El País.
Designed for Real Language Learning
LingQ uses an input-based approach: you learn languages by reading and listening to real, interesting content at your level.
◆ Massive Content Library: Thousands of lessons from podcasts, books, interviews, videos, articles, and more — all with matching text for easy listening and reading.
◆ Follow Topics You Enjoy: Choose content you love and progress naturally through immersion, not drills.
◆ Import Your Favorite Content: Turn Netflix, YouTube, podcasts, books, and articles into personalized lessons.
◆ Powerful Reader: An effective, optimized reader that tracks every word you encounter to boost your vocabulary.
◆ Interactive Learning: Listen, read along, tap words for instant definitions, and learn naturally as you go.
◆ Advanced Progress Tracking: Monitor your listening, reading, study time, and vocabulary growth.
◆ Learn Anytime, Anywhere: Study offline and sync your progress automatically. Learn whenever you want.
AI Language Learning Tools
• AI Audio Transcription: Turn podcasts and audiobooks into interactive lessons.
• AI Voices: Make your lessons, reviews and chats more immersive with natural sounding text-to-speech voices.
• Advanced Chatbot: Get detailed tutor responses and real-time web search with our advanced Lynx AI Chatbot.
• AI-Simplified Lesson: Take advantage of more interesting content earlier on in your learning journey by generating simplified versions of lessons.
 Read and Listen with Interactive Tools
• SRS vocabulary review for long-term retention;
• Mini Stories that build a strong foundation at any level;
• Grammar guides with clear, accessible explanations;
• Audio playlists for hands-free listening;
• Karaoke Mode to follow the text while listening;
 A Global Community to Support You
• Writing Exchange for real corrections from native speakers;
• Tutoring sessions tailored to your goals;
• Community forum for questions, guidance, and motivation;
• Challenges that help you stay consistent and build strong habits;
Built by Language Learners
LingQ was co-founded by Steve Kaufmann, a polyglot who learned more than 20 languages using this same natural approach.
Learn Multiple Languages
LingQ supports more than 50 languages, including Spanish, English, Japanese, Korean, Italian, German, Portuguese, French, Chinese, Arabic and more.
Get LingQ Premium and Accelerate Your Learning
• Unlimited vocabulary lookup and SRS review;
• Comprehensive word tracking to boost your progress;
• Unlimited content imports;
• Access to AI features;
Start learning from real content. 
Download LingQ and begin today.
Feedback? Let us know.
Send suggestions and feedback to iosapp@lingq.com.

Sandbox: Powder Alchemy – Mix, Create & Experiment!
Enter the world of alchemy, science, and chemistry in this ultimate sandbox! Experiment with elements, powder, and chemical reactions to discover new materials. In this playground sandbox, every interaction creates something new—mix, explore, and unleash the power of physics! 
Mix, Experiment & Discover New Elements 
Combine fire, water, earth, and air to explore endless possibilities. Just like in Little Alchemy, you can mix different elements and powder to trigger amazing chemistry and physics reactions. Experiment with different materials and watch your creations come to life! 
The Ultimate Physics & Chemistry Playground 
Test the laws of science, physics, and alchemy as you create explosive chain reactions. Watch how powder, elements, and chemistry interact in real time. Melt metal, freeze water, or set fire to your sandbox—this is the perfect place to experiment and create!

Build & Experiment in a Living World 
Use elements and powder to create landscapes, structures, or even entire ecosystems. Play in your own world box, conduct crazy chemistry experiments, or mix different materials to see what happens. Whether you want to build or destroy, the power is in your hands! 
Why Sandbox: Powder Alchemy? 
- Ultimate alchemy sandbox – mix, combine & discover new elements and powder 
- Realistic physics simulator – explore science, chemistry, and physics reactions 
- Endless experiments – play with powder, fire, water, earth, and air

- Create and destroy – shape the world or watch it crumble into powder!

bluejetty:00038428:android.description:
■New event “Autumn Leaves Resort with the Quintuplets ~A journey through the autumn leaves with you~” will be held!
Enjoy the original story with the theme of "Autumn Leaves Resort" in full voice while clearing the puzzles with the quintuplets.
[Event period]
Friday, November 17, 2023 11:00 to Sunday, November 26, 23:59
-------------------------------------------------- -------------------
The first game app for the anime “The Quintessential Quintuplets” is now available!
The strongest romantic comedy is finally turned into a game on your smartphone!
■Fully supervised by Weekly Shonen Magazine editorial department! A new story of you and the quintuplets!
In addition to reliving the original story, you can also enjoy the new game original story.
Produced under the supervision of the editor in charge of the original work of “The Quintessential Quintuplets”!
■Popular characters from anime appear!
-------------------------------------------------- -------------------
Now, who will you choose?
This is the story of a part-time tutor with favorable conditions who comes to you who is living in poverty.
However, his student turns out to be his classmate! And they were quintuplets!?
The unique Nakano family quintuplets are all beautiful girls.
But he's a problem child who is on the verge of failing and hates studying!
The first task is to win their trust...!?
-------------------------------------------------- -------------------
The quintuplets Ichika, Nino, Miku, Yotsuba, and Satsuki appear in the game!
You can enjoy a romantic comedy puzzle game that is 500% cute and progresses while deepening your bond with the quintuplets.
■The richness from that child that was impossible in the original work...! "Now, who will you choose?"
Deepen your bond with the quintuplets and create a “special relationship”! Not selected in the original work
You can also choose the girl you are interested in...! ?
■Gorgeous voice actors from the anime “The Quintessential Quintuplets” will appear!
Ichika Nakano (CV: Kana Hanazawa)
Nino Nakano (CV: Ayana Taketatsu)
Miku Nakano (CV: Miku Ito)
Yotsuba Nakano (CV: Ayane Sakura)
Satsuki Nakano (CV: Inori Minase)
Raiha Uesugi (CV: Natsumi Takamori)
-------------------------------------------------- -------------------
*About image quality settings
There are four levels: "Highest", "High", "Medium", and "Low".
Recommended settings will be defaulted according to your device specifications.
In order to play comfortably on a variety of Android devices, we have set the following settings.
The recommended default setting is "Medium" (*)
Below the "Medium" setting, the character's facial expressions are turned off.
(*) Some terminals may be set to "Low".
If your device has high specs and there are no problems with operation, please increase the settings.
If you want to change it after starting the game, you can change it from "Menu" > "Options" > "Settings" in the upper right corner of the homepage.
================================================== ====

◉ Instant Solutions: No equals button needed. Simple Voice Calculator shows results in real-time as you input or edit equations.
EXTRA: Apple Watch App - Calculate on-the-go from your wrist with instant solution access and equation control. Includes face widgets.

• Division

• Percents

bluejetty:00062728:ios.description:
Strategic Breathing, Max Strom’s App is specifically designed for individuals in high stress / low margin for error professions or situations, and those suffering from PTSD such as military personnel and first responders.
If you can breathe, this App will work for you.
The App features Max Strom’s voice in combination with an animated CG Avatar and motion graphics to guide you through a safe and effective practice of breathing patterns and meditative movement.
The Strategic Breathing App is the result of Max’s 23 years of teaching breathing evolutions across the world and is known to produce a level of an inner calm that helps you to feel better, sleep better, and function at a higher level in your relationships and your life-work.
App content:
• Breathing technique tutorial.
• Talk on how breathing and emotions are deeply connected. 
• Standing breathing evolutions ranging from 5 to 30 minutes. 
• Seated breathing evolutions ranging from 5 to 30 minutes.
• Deep relaxation practice to prepare for sleep.
Max Strom has taught breath-work for 23 years, and currently travels the globe teaching breathing evolutions, wellbeing, and yoga to medical, government, and well being conferences. Max is known for inspiring and igniting personal growth. His TEDx talk, Breathe to Heal, has over one million views on Youtube. Max is also the author of two books, A Life Worth Breathing, and There is No App for Happiness.
What medical doctors are saying about Max Strom’s breath work as an intervention for mental health:
“The impact breathing has on our health and well-being is only now beginning to be recognized more widely. Max’s depth of experience as a teacher of human qualities put him at the forefront of this movement and I have used his methods successfully with many patients.”
Dr. Stephen James
Director of The Breathlessness Clinic and Consultant in Anesthesia and Exercise Capacity, King’s College Hospital, London, UK
“There is a worldwide pandemic of anxiety and stress-related illness. Max Strom teaches a simple and effective way to control these problems without the use of drugs or any harmful therapies. His techniques can help both patients and those who care for them.”
Dr. Chris Moulton
Vice-President of the Royal College of Emergency Medicine and Consultant in Emergency Medicine at the Royal Bolton Hospital, UK
"I have been repeatedly amazed at the effect the techniques of Max Strom have had on all who attended. In his simple, no frills format, he has a gift of immediately being relevant and motivating to all who meet him. His teachings are very relevant to all struggling with modern life, its complexities and challenges, whether they are professional or personal.”
H. Alomran, MD
Medical Affairs, King Faisal Specialist Hospital Riyadh
“Max Strom's Inner Axis practice brings calm to our stressed nervous systems and breathes us back to life.”
Layla Banihashemi, Ph.D.
Neuroscientist Pittsburgh PA USAMBChB Monterey, CA USA
“Max Strom’s teachings show us that we can calm ourselves through breathing and this is a powerful tool that has tremendous benefits.”
Dr. Devi Mahendran
MBChB Monterey, CA USA

bluejetty:00131665:ios.description:
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and given it a facelift! This faster native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the "Your News" tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience.
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day's paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline "Reading Preferences" can also be customized for Settings.
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select "follow" at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily "Unfollow"

The Florida DMV Driving License Test
bluejetty:00045169:ios.description:
Are you applying for the Florida FL DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this app to prepare and clear DMV driver’s license permit test for Florida state and get permit on the first go. 
The Florida DMV Driving License Test Preparation App is the ultimate study guide for anyone looking to pass their driving license exam. This app is designed to help you prepare for the real DMV test by providing you with a wealth of information, practice questions, and exam simulations. Whether you're a new driver just starting out, or an experienced driver looking to brush up on your skills, this app has everything you need to succeed.
One of the key features of the app is its comprehensive study guide, which covers all of the road rules, regulations, and hand signals you'll need to know in order to pass your driving license exam. From speed limits and right-of-way rules, to hand signals and road signs, this app has it all. The study guide is easy to use and understand, so you can quickly find the information you need to know in order to ace your exam.
Another important feature of the app is its practice questions. These questions are designed to help you prepare for the real DMV test by simulating the types of questions you'll encounter on the exam. This app includes questions based on official Florida DMV state manual. With practice questions covering everything from road signs to traffic laws, you can be confident that you're fully prepared for your license test.
In addition to its comprehensive study guide and practice questions, the Florida DMV Driving License Test Preparation App also provides you with detailed simulations of the actual DMV exam. These simulations allow you to see what the exam will be like, and to practice your driving skills in a realistic environment. You'll be able to see how you perform on each simulation, and get feedback on your driving skills, so you can be sure that you're ready for the real thing. The app allows you to prepare and practice for the Car, Motorcycle and Commercial Driving license (CDL) driver’s license test for Florida State and all practice tests are based on the latest manuals.
Following is a brief overview of the facilities provided by the app.
- Practice tests design specially for you.
- Practice as much as you want for Florida DMV test preparation.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- Keep your progress for each practice test and view history. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Practice test for Car, Motorcycle and Commercial Motor Vehicle (CDL) driver’s license test.
- Exceptionally large set of practice questions which covers every aspects of the test.
Why Choose Florida DMV Permit Practice Test?
- We have prepared this app with heart and keeping in mind the questions asked in Florida DMV permit test.
- It makes preparation for the DMV test easy and quick.
- It also allows you to shorten your study and you can use it as your study guide.
- There are chances to get better score by doing practice with the questions and answers provided in this app.
So why wait? Download the Florida DMV Driving License Test Preparation App today and get ready to pass your driving license exam with flying colors!

We have powerful edits like face reshape, smooth skin, tons of stunning filter
bluejetty:00073755:ios.description:
PrettyUp is your all-in-one face & body editor for photos and videos! Whether it's a selfie, vlog, or live photo, easily retouch and enhance your natural beauty.
We have powerful edits like face reshape, smooth skin, tons of stunning filters, tools like quality enhancer, object remover. Say goodbye to awkward angles and camera distortion—shoot, edit, and share flawlessly!
Body Editor & Creative Reshaping
• Body Tune: Effortlessly adjust and customize your shape. Highlight your favorite features and achieve your desired proportions with smooth, natural-looking results.
• Background Protect: Our smart AI keeps your surroundings looking natural and intact while you edit, preventing any visual distortion.
• Proportion Adjustments: Easily fine-tune perspectives to create an elegant and balanced look in your full-body shots.
• AI Pose Changer: Unsure how to pose or feeling stiff in front of the camera? Instantly adjust or swap your posture in photos to match trending influencer poses for an effortlessly look.
• Detail Enhancer: Add subtle, artistic definitions to your photos and videos, such as highlighting natural curves or toned lines.
 Face Retouch & Natural Glow
• Refine Contours: Lets you refine facial features and brighten selfie videos instantly. Enlarge eyes or slim face, adjust eyebrow shapes or customize details for your natural look with magic.
• Retouch Face: Slim cheeks and sculpt jawlines naturally using face-slimming & facelift function.
• Blemish Fixer: Fix all your facial imperfections. Erase wrinkle, remove acne & eyebags to get a better realistic look with smooth skin.
• Teeth Editor & Lips Plumper: Brighten your smile with white teeth and enhance your pout for a confident look.
• Makeup Editor: Freely edit your makeup—add lipstick, eyeshadow, and eyelashes...
• Hair Color Explorer: Try on new looks freely! From blonde to trendy colors, find the perfect shade that suits your style.
Retro digital camera & Ambient Lighting
• Vibe Mode: Skip the studio. Turn on Vibe Mode for a virtual photobooth with heavy grain and soft glow to make you the main character.
• DSLR Mode: Turn your phone into a vintage digital cam. Get the rich nostalgia and raw textures of F300EXR, XT5, and G12 instantly.
• Ambient Lighting: Tap to switch between aesthetic blue, moody purple, or warm tones. Snap flawless, high-vibe shots in any low-light scene.
Other Advanced & Creative Tools
• Unlock premium features like HD Quality Enhancer, Object Remover, AI Try-On, Flash and 3D relight to take your edits to the next level.
Ready to shine? Experience the powerful face and body editor to share on Instagram or Tiktok. We only help you highlight your authentic beauty, not change it. Life may be messy, but memories don't have to be. Beauty has no standard—everybody is beautiful, just as it is—remember, you were born beautiful.

-Manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in Account Settings. No cancellations during active period.
-Unused free trial time is forfeited upon subscription.

The FM Radio app is your gateway to a global network of radio stations, offering a seamless and intuitive way to explore, play, and manage stations from around the world. With a subscription, unlock the full potential of your listening experience.
Subscription Benefits:
- Complete Access: Gain full access to radio stations from every corner of the globe.
- Enhanced Features: Enjoy an ad-free experience, higher sound quality, and advanced search filters.
- Personalization: Create and save personalized collections of your favorite stations for quick access.
- Timer Functionality: Set reminders to play or pause your favorite stations at scheduled times, ensuring you never miss a beat.
- Song Information: Stay updated with real-time song info and view album covers for an enriched visual experience.
- Custom Settings: Customize your app settings for a tailored and enjoyable listening experience.
Subscription Details:
- Auto-Renewable Subscription: Choose from weekly, yearly, or lifetime options.
- Pricing:
$3.99 per week for a weekly subscription 
$6.99 per week for a weekly subscription
$6.99 per week for a weekly subscription with 3-day trial
$14.99 per month
$29.99 per year for a yearly subscription
$29.99 per year for a yearly subscription with 3 day trial
$29.99 for lifetime
How It Works:
- Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of the initial subscription.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Manage Your Subscription:
- Easily manage your subscription and auto-renewal settings by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Trial Period:
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Stay Connected:
For questions or support, please contact us at [support@normalv.com](mailto:support@normalv.com).
