bluejetty:00142706:ios.summary: Astro Sadhana is the Vedic astrology app that brings you authentic Vedic remedies, personalised for you. Now with Parashar AI, your personal Jyotish AI, available 24/7. Get your daily horoscope and a detailed Kundli analysis, and chat with
bluejetty:00142706:ios.description:
Astro Sadhana is the Vedic astrology app that brings you authentic Vedic remedies, personalised for you. Now with Parashar AI, your personal Jyotish AI, available 24/7. Get your daily horoscope and a detailed Kundli analysis, and chat with expert Vedic astrologers.
Perform personalised Vedic remedies yourself. Ask Parashar AI for instant answers from your birth chart, or chat and talk with our in-house astrologers when you want a human touch.
Astro Sadhana offers:
• NEW: Parashar AI – instant, Kundli-based answers to your life questions
• Free personalised Vedic remedies based on your Kundli
• Live Vedic astrologer consultations on chat and call
• Answers to your questions through Astro Forecasts
• Free daily and weekly horoscopes
• Recommended actions for the day
• Astrologer nudges
• Kundli generation
• Comprehensive Kundli report with planetary predictions, Vimshottari Dasha, Shani Sade Sati and Kaal Sarp Dosha
• Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly Hindu calendar (Panchang and Muhurat)
• Your Dasha planets and what they mean
• Snippets of wisdom on Vedic astrology
MEET PARASHAR AI – YOUR JYOTISH AI:
Named after Maharishi Parashara, the father of Vedic astrology, Parashar AI reads your Kundli and answers your questions in seconds, any time of day or night.
Ask about your career, marriage, finances, health or current Dasha, and get an answer grounded in your own birth chart, not a generic sun-sign reading.
Want to go deeper? Take your question to one of our expert Vedic astrologers anytime. Parashar AI questions are available as in-app purchases.
CHANGE YOUR LIFE WITH VEDIC REMEDIES:
Gone are the days when a dim horoscope or astrology prediction left you feeling hopeless! If you are not satisfied, take charge and change it with customised remedies drawn directly from the Vedas.
Every remedy is free and combines authentic Vedic rituals like Japa, Abhishekam, Yagna, Nitya Puja and Sadhana.
With each chant of a mantra, turn the tides in your favour and create your life your way.
Find the best time for your Sadhana with our detailed Vedic Panchang, including the Sadhana Panchang and Muhurat Calendar.
PERSONALISED ASTROLOGER GUIDANCE:
Sometimes the warm assurance of a human touch helps when nothing else can. For your deepest and most worrying questions, approach any of our in-house expert Vedic astrologers. Book a call or chat consultation and get all your questions answered. Our astrologers will also send you nudges to keep you on track.
HOROSCOPES:
Learn what your daily and weekly horoscope predictions say about your day and week. Go deep with our detailed birth chart report.
Not satisfied with what it says? Make it better through a customised Vedic remedy, often just 10 minutes a day or less!
Your horoscope focuses on two areas of life you choose, plus two chosen by our expert Vedic astrologers: Career, Education, Finance, Health, Love, Peace of Mind, Relationships, New Initiatives and Spiritual Growth.
These areas address life's biggest questions:
Career: Will I be able to get a job abroad?
Finance: How do I improve my finances?
Love: When will I get married?
Peace of Mind: When will I be settled in life?
Health: When will I get healthy?
Have a question that can't wait? Ask Parashar AI for an instant answer, or talk to our astrologers for a personal consultation.
SNIPPETS OF WISDOM:
Vedic astrology is no longer the mysterious Vedanga it once was. Our mission is to demystify it and reveal its secrets, one snippet of wisdom at a time!
It is for everybody, even atheists and non-believers.
Because every remedy in our app has one ultimate purpose: to bring you closer to your best self.
All Vedic remedies and daily and weekly horoscopes are 100% free.
Ancient wisdom, now powered by AI. Truthful, authentic and 100% committed to the cause. Welcome to Astro Sadhana.
Terms of Service: https://astrosadhana.com/terms-privacy/
Privacy Policy: https://astrosadhana.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00100414:ios.name: Idle BitCoin Empire
bluejetty:00100414:ios.summary:
Step into the future of idle games with Idle Bitcoin Empire - the only game where you don’t just play… you earn.
Build, upgrade, and manage a massive crypto mining operation from scratch. Automate your production, unlock advanced mining rig
bluejetty:00100414:ios.description:
Step into the future of idle games with Idle Bitcoin Empire - the only game where you don’t just play… you earn.
Build, upgrade, and manage a massive crypto mining operation from scratch. Automate your production, unlock advanced mining rigs, and earn real digital rewards.
- Build Your Crypto Empire
Start with one humble rig and expand into a fully automated, high-tech mining powerhouse.
- Unlock dozens of mining stations
- Upgrade each rig for speed and efficiency
- Hire i level up managers to boost income
- Ship your mined crypto to collect virtual profits
Every successful shipment = more virtual money in your empire.
- Earn Real Bitcoin Micro-Rewards
Idle Bitcoin Empire isn’t just a simulation - it allows you to collect real-world micro-rewards through gameplay and achievements.
- Build your empire and get rewarded with actual rewards via a third-party platform.*
- Idle Tycoon Gameplay at Its Best
This game offers all the things you love about idle tycoon games, including:
- Automation
- Progression
- Strategic upgrades
- Offline income
- Satisfying growth
But with one big twist - this time, your factory isn’t building cars or toys. You’re building digital currency.
- From Basement Miner to Global BTC Tycoon
Level up your operation:
- Unlock new mining zones
- Upgrade transport networks
- Optimize your layout for max efficiency
- Exchange mined currency and reinvest profits
Everything you do moves you closer to becoming the ultimate Bitcoin mogul.
- Goals, Missions i Rewards
Complete daily tasks, long-term missions, and special events to earn more:
- Real digital rewards
- Boost items
- Upgrade tokens
- Rare managers
Every tap counts!
- Easy to Start, Satisfying to Master
Whether you’re an idle game fan, a crypto enthusiast, or both – Idle Bitcoin Empire delivers a fun, rewarding experience with strategic depth and real earning potential.
- Key Features:
Addictive idle gameplay with automation
Real digital reward system*
Dozens of stations and manager upgrades
Visually rich low-poly 3D world
Works offline - earn while you’re away
Frequent updates and new content
This isn’t just another tycoon game.
It’s your gateway to the future of gaming and earning.
So plug in, start mining, and build your Idle Bitcoin Empire today! 
*Note:
Rewards are subject to availability, terms, and region. Always read the in-game instructions for details.
- Idle Bitcoin Empire does not itself provide any cryptocurrency wallet or process any cryptocurrency transactions which are handled by a third-party
Privacy Policy: https://www.mobileesports.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.mobileesports.com/terms
Get quick assistance on our Discord server.
https://discord.gg/rHR9DN96kN

bluejetty:00065054:ios.name: Lincoln Financial Mobile
bluejetty:00065054:ios.summary:
Accessing your Lincoln account information from your favorite device is easier than ever on the Lincoln Financial Mobile app! 
Our all-inclusive mobile app allows you manage your retirement plan, employee benefits, and wellness tools, all
bluejetty:00065054:ios.description:
Accessing your Lincoln account information from your favorite device is easier than ever on the Lincoln Financial Mobile app! 
Our all-inclusive mobile app allows you manage your retirement plan, employee benefits, and wellness tools, all in one secure place. Safely access and adjust your retirement account, submit and manage claims, view dental ID cards, provide essential information to keep your claim on track, find a dentist, take advantage of financial wellness tools, and more! 
Here are some key features:
Retirement plan
My TargetSM:
The My Target retirement estimator lets you see how your account balance may translate into monthly income after retirement. With Click2ContributeSM integration, it’s simple to increase contributions to help meet your savings goals.
Click2Contribute:
Click2Contribute makes it simple to increase your contribution rate by selecting one of three preset percentages. Even before you make a change, the contribution planner also shows how an increase may affect your paycheck.
Contributions:
The Contributions tab lets you update deferral amounts and see a detailed breakdown of your year-to-date contributions. If you make Roth contributions, you’ll also see a lifetime cost basis versus earning breakdown.
Investments:
The Investments tab provides an interactive graph of your account balance over time.
My next steps:
This prioritizes actions on the road to retirement, like consolidating your assets or increasing your knowledge. (This feature may not be available for all plans.)
Employee benefits:
Everything you need to manage your benefits is in one place, letting you submit and manage a claim, download forms, upload documents and view payments. It’s also a convenient way to stay on top of administrative details like accessing your digital dental ID card and our network of dental providers. 
Financial wellness:
Our proprietary financial wellness solution provides tools and personalized steps to manage your financial life. From creating a budget, to building an emergency fund, to paying down debt, our easy-to-use online tool helps you turn information into action so you can focus on both short- and long-term goals, such as saving for retirement or providing protection for your loved ones.

bluejetty:00161921:ios.name: דומינו'ס פיצה - Domino's Pizza
bluejetty:00161921:ios.summary: דומינו'ס פיצה היא רשת הפיצריות המובילה בישראל, המציעה חוויית הזמנה דיגיטלית מתקדמת ומשלוחי פיצה חמים, טריים ומהירים עד לפתח ביתכם. עם האפליקציה החדשה שלנו, תוכלו להזמין פיצה בלחיצת כפתור, ליהנות ממבצעים בלעדיים ולעקוב בזמן אמת אחר המשלוח –
bluejetty:00161921:ios.description:
דומינו'ס פיצה היא רשת הפיצריות המובילה בישראל, המציעה חוויית הזמנה דיגיטלית מתקדמת ומשלוחי פיצה חמים, טריים ומהירים עד לפתח ביתכם. עם האפליקציה החדשה שלנו, תוכלו להזמין פיצה בלחיצת כפתור, ליהנות ממבצעים בלעדיים ולעקוב בזמן אמת אחר המשלוח – הכל בנוחות ובקלות.
למה לבחור בדומינו'ס?
משלוח מהיר במיוחד : אנחנו מתחייבים להביא אליכם את הפיצה החמה והטרייה ביותר, במהירות שיא.
תהליך הזמנה נוח וידידותי: האפליקציה שלנו מאפשרת לכם לבחור, להתאים ולשלם בקלות ובמהירות.
התאמה אישית מלאה: בין אם אתם מעדיפים בצק קלאסי, דק, כוסמין או ללא גלוטן – אצלנו תוכלו להתאים את הפיצה בדיוק לטעמכם.
תשלום מאובטח ונוח: שלמו באמצעות כרטיס אשראי או ארנק דיגיטלי, בביטחון מלא.
מעקב משלוח בזמן אמת: דעו בדיוק מתי הפיצה שלכם יוצאת לדרך ומתי היא צפויה להגיע.
מבצעים חמים והנחות בלעדיות: רק למשתמשי האפליקציה שלנו מגיעים הדילים השווים ביותר.
פריסה ארצית רחבה: מעל 60 סניפים, המבטיחה שירות מהיר ואיכותי ללקוחותינו ברחבי הארץ. מרבית סניפינו, הפרוסים מאילת ועד נהריה, פתוחים גם בסופי שבוע, כך שתוכלו ליהנות מהפיצה האהובה עליכם גם בשבתות.
מתאים גם לשומרי כשרות: אנו מציעים סניפים כשרים למהדרין בערים כמו פתח תקווה, תל אביב, גבעתיים, אשדוד, אשקלון, עפולה והקריות ועוד, כדי לספק מענה לציבור שומרי הכשרות.
איך זה עובד?
בחרו את הפיצה שלכם: משפחתית, אישית, טבעונית או עם תוספות מיוחדות – הבחירה בידיכם.
התאימו את ההזמנה לטעמכם: בחרו סוג בצק, תוספות ורטבים לפי העדפותיכם.
שלמו בצורה מאובטחת: השתמשו בכרטיס אשראי, ארנק דיגיטלי או שיטות תשלום נוספות.
עקבו אחר המשלוח: ראו בזמן אמת מתי השליח בדרך אליכם והכינו את עצמכם לפיצה המושלמת.
מה בתפריט?
דומינו'ס פיצה מציעה מגוון מנות טעימות ואיכותיות, המותאמות לטעמים והעדפות שונות:
פיצה משפחתית בהרכבה אישית: אפשרות לבחור את התוספות האהובות עליכם וליצור פיצה מושלמת.
פיצה אישית: מנה אישית אידיאלית לארוחה מהירה ומשביעה.
דיל משפחתי: כולל פיצה משפחתית, תוספת נלווית או קינוח ושתייה גדולה
מבצע זוגי: שתי פיצות משפחתיות מתאים למפגשים משפחתיים או עם חברים.
תוספות נלוות: מגוון מנות צדדיות כמו אצבעות מוצרלה ופופים שוקולד.
פיצה וולקנו: פיצה ייחודית עם "הר געש" במרכזה, המכיל לבת גבינות חמה ומבעבעת. הפיצה מוגשת ללא תוספות כדי להדגיש את טעם הגבינות העשיר, אך ניתן להוסיף תוספות לפי העדפת הלקוח. מומלץ לטבול את פרוסות הפיצה בלבת הגבינות לקבלת חוויית טעם מושלמת.
פיצות מיקסים חדשות: רוטב קאצ’ו אה פפה חרפרף עם גבינת מוצרלה, פטריות טריות ופרמז'ן, ורוטב רוזה קרמי עם גבינת מוצרלה, עגבניות טריות, זיתי קלמטה ופרמז'ן – חוויה איטלקית באפליקציה.
פופים: קינוח הכולל מאפים רכים, פריכים וחמים במילוי מטבעות שוקולד לבן, עם תוספת רוטב שוקולד חלב או רוטב פיסטוק ושוקולד לבן מעל. קינוח זה מציע חוויית טעם מתוקה ומפנקת לסיום הארוחה.
בנוסף, דומינו'ס מציעה אפשרויות נוספות כגון פיצות עם בצק כוסמין מלא, פיצות דקות, פיצות טבעוניות, פיצות ללא גלוטן, כריכים, קינוחים ומשקאות קלים. מגוון זה מאפשר לכל אחד למצוא את המנה המושלמת עבורו, בין אם מדובר בארוחה משפחתית, מפגש עם חברים או פינוק אישי.
התחייבות לאיכות ולשירות
בדומינו'ס, אנחנו מתחייבים לאיכות בלתי מתפשרת. הפיצות שלנו מוכנות מכדורי בצק טריים שנפתחים במקום רק ברגע ההזמנה, עם רוטב עגבניות משובח וגבינת מוצרלה איכותית. אנחנו הרשת היחידה בישראל המתחייבת למשלוח עד הבית בתוך 30 דקות, כדי להבטיח שהפיצה תגיע אליכם חמה וטרייה.
הורידו עכשיו את האפליקציה
הצטרפו למיליוני הלקוחות המרוצים של דומינו'ס והורידו את האפליקציה עוד היום ותיהנו מהפיצה המושלמת, במשלוח מהיר וממבצעים מיוחדים – הכל בלחיצת כפתור!

פריסה ארצית רחבה: מעל 60 סניפים, המבטיחה שירות מהיר ואיכותי ללקוחותינו ברחבי הארץ. מרבית סניפינו, הפרוסים מאילת ועד נהריה, פתוחים גם בסופי שבוע, כך שתוכלו ליהנות מהפיצה האהובה עליכם גם בשבתות.
מתאים גם לשומרי כשרות: אנו מציעים סניפים כשרים למהדרין בערים כמו פתח תקווה, תל אביב, גבעתיים, אשדוד, אשקלון, עפולה והקריות ועוד, כדי לספק מענה לציבור שומרי הכשרות.

איך זה עובד?
בחרו את הפיצה שלכם: משפחתית, אישית, טבעונית או עם תוספות מיוחדות – הבחירה בידיכם.
התאימו את ההזמנה לטעמכם: בחרו סוג בצק, תוספות ורטבים לפי העדפותיכם.
שלמו בצורה מאובטחת: השתמשו בכרטיס אשראי, ארנק דיגיטלי או שיטות תשלום נוספות.
עקבו אחר המשלוח: ראו בזמן אמת מתי השליח בדרך אליכם והכינו את עצמכם לפיצה המושלמת.

מה בתפריט?
דומינו'ס פיצה מציעה מגוון מנות טעימות ואיכותיות, המותאמות לטעמים והעדפות שונות:
פיצה משפחתית בהרכבה אישית: אפשרות לבחור את התוספות האהובות עליכם וליצור פיצה מושלמת.
פיצה אישית: מנה אישית אידיאלית לארוחה מהירה ומשביעה.
דיל משפחתי: כולל פיצה משפחתית, תוספת נלווית או קינוח ושתייה גדולה
מבצע זוגי: שתי פיצות משפחתיות מתאים למפגשים משפחתיים או עם חברים.
תוספות נלוות: מגוון מנות צדדיות כמו אצבעות מוצרלה ופופים שוקולד.
פיצה וולקנו: פיצה ייחודית עם "הר געש" במרכזה, המכיל לבת גבינות חמה ומבעבעת. הפיצה מוגשת ללא תוספות כדי להדגיש את טעם הגבינות העשיר, אך ניתן להוסיף תוספות לפי העדפת הלקוח. מומלץ לטבול את פרוסות הפיצה בלבת הגבינות לקבלת חוויית טעם מושלמת.
פיצות מיקסים חדשות: רוטב קאצ’ו אה פפה חרפרף עם גבינת מוצרלה, פטריות טריות ופרמז'ן, ורוטב רוזה קרמי עם גבינת מוצרלה, עגבניות טריות, זיתי קלמטה ופרמז'ן – חוויה איטלקית באפליקציה.
פופים: קינוח הכולל מאפים רכים, פריכים וחמים במילוי מטבעות שוקולד לבן, עם תוספת רוטב שוקולד חלב או רוטב פיסטוק ושוקולד לבן מעל. קינוח זה מציע חוויית טעם מתוקה ומפנקת לסיום הארוחה.

בנוסף, דומינו'ס מציעה אפשרויות נוספות כגון פיצות עם בצק כוסמין מלא, פיצות דקות, פיצות טבעוניות, פיצות ללא גלוטן, כריכים, קינוחים ומשקאות קלים. מגוון זה מאפשר לכל אחד למצוא את המנה המושלמת עבורו, בין אם מדובר בארוחה משפחתית, מפגש עם חברים או פינוק אישי.

התחייבות לאיכות ולשירות
בדומינו'ס, אנחנו מתחייבים לאיכות בלתי מתפשרת. הפיצות שלנו מוכנות מכדורי בצק טריים שנפתחים במקום רק ברגע ההזמנה, עם רוטב עגבניות משובח וגבינת מוצרלה איכותית. אנחנו הרשת היחידה בישראל המתחייבת למשלוח עד הבית בתוך 30 דקות, כדי להבטיח שהפיצה תגיע אליכם חמה וטרייה.

הורידו עכשיו את האפליקציה
הצטרפו למיליוני הלקוחות המרוצים של דומינו'ס והורידו את האפליקציה עוד היום ותיהנו מהפיצה המושלמת, במשלוח מהיר וממבצעים מיוחדים – הכל בלחיצת כפתור!

bluejetty:00178840:ios.description:
Classic Whist Card Game — play Whist offline against computer players.
No internet required. No sign-up. Enjoy a clean, traditional trick-taking card game with four-player partnership play, optional trumps, honours scoring, stats, trick review and hand replays.
Classic Whist is one of the great partnership card games. Follow suit, win tricks, work with your computer partner, and try to be the first team to reach the target score.
Why you’ll like Classic Whist
• Play Whist offline
• No account or sign-up required
• Four-player partnership gameplay
• Easy, Medium and Hard computer players
• Optional trumps
• Alternate or last-card trump selection
• Optional honours scoring
• Win target options
• Stats tracking
• Review previous tricks
• Replay completed hands
• Claim winning tricks
• AutoPlay options
• Show starting hands option
• Optional four-color deck
• Clear cards and smooth play
• Portrait and landscape support
Choose your rules
• Trumps: on or off
• Trump type: alternate or last card
• Honours: on or off
• Win target: 5, 7, or 9
• AI difficulty: Easy, Medium, or Hard 
• Replay hands after each round
Classic Whist gameplay
Whist is a classic four-player partnership trick-taking card game. Players must follow suit if possible. The highest card of the led suit wins the trick unless a trump card is played.
Your partnership scores 1 point for each trick won above six. With optional honours scoring, holding the top trump cards can add extra points. The first partnership to reach the target score wins the game.
Built for comfortable play
Classic Whist is designed for quick games and repeated play, with clear cards, smooth controls, adjustable speed, optional four-color suits, stats tracking, trick review and completed-hand replays.
Play offline anytime — no internet, no sign-up, just Whist.

bluejetty:00185231:ios.description:
Play the popular medieval MMOG and experience its Christmas setting! In the X-Mas Edition of Lords & Knights you lead your conquests throughout the snow-covered maps, accompanied by atmospheric Christmas music. Who says that the top of the rankings cannot be reached with candy canes, tinsel and Christmas candles? • Discover several Christmas animations and sound effects
• Ally yourself with other players
• Explore new technologies and complete exciting missions
• Experience the beautifully crafted and richly detailed medieval graphic style
 • Maximum fun - alone or in the community
Download the free app now and experience thrilling battles in X-Mas Edition von Lords & Knights - the Christmas-medieval MMOG for iPhone and iPad.
Lords & Knights - X-Mas Edition requires an active Internet connection.

bluejetty:00180593:android.description:
Smart Wallet is the fastest way to perform financial transactions anytime, anywhere. 
Smart Wallet transforms payment accessibility with a rapid, simple and secure payment experience.
Smart Wallet allows you to:
• Send and receive money to and from any wallet in Egypt
• Make in-store purchases from the merchant of your choice by scanning their QR code
• Issue a single-use/multi-use, virtual online card with your desired amount for any website or application worldwide
• Top up airtime on a prepaid phone with the Mobile Recharge feature
• Deposit and withdraw money from CIB’s Authorized Banking Agent Network and ATMs
• Load your wallet with cash by linking your CIB debit, credit or prepaid cards (up to two cards)
• You may pay your mobile, ADSL, or utility bills or donate to the charity of your choice 
• Check and export your transaction log to be able to print or use it in the future.
• Save all your usual payments, merchants, family, and friends to the Favorites feature 
• Use the Contact Us button to speak with our dedicated call center agent for support or to leave your feedback/complaint
• View the service fees and overview within the application 
You do not need to have a CIB bank account to have a CIB Smart Wallet. Register through one of the following channels: 
1. Any of CIB’s Authorized Banking Agent outlet
2. Any CIB branch 
If you are a CIB client, register now by texting your full National ID number and last 4 digits of your CIB card to 4435 or through your Online Banking account. 
*To register, you need a valid national ID number and a mobile number.
*You can unregister from CIB Smart Wallet via the application. 
In collaboration with Meeza Digital.
Terms & conditions apply.

bluejetty:00027795:ios.description:
Welcome to Barry World Adventure, a unique world for you to accompany Barry to explore new lands and rescue his princess.
In this offline adventure arcade game, you help Barry as he hunts treasure, overcomes tough challenges, and gets the princess out of the monster boss's castle!
HOW TO PLAY BARRY WORLD ADVENTURE:
- Tap the buttons to move, jump, and fire bullets.
- Consume the big potion to destroy bricks more easily.
- Collect coins to buy booster items.
- Avoid obstacles and defeat all the monsters.
- Clear the level to rescue our beloved princess!
EXCITING FEATURES:
- Suitable game for erveryones.
- Free and offline.
- Small download size.
- Simple manipulation, eye-catching design, and nostalgic music.
- Available multi-languages.
- Lots of trendy costumes.
- Free spins, achievements, daily quests, and surprise chests.
- More than 100 adventurous levels and secret places to explore!
You never know what will happen next in this action, adventure game! You can swim in the deep ocean, go through volcanoes full of hot lava, and ski on ice on your comfortable bed! Let this thrilling hero story distract you from the everyday stress of school and work!
So what are you waiting for? Download Barry World Adventure now to experience the best adventure with Barry!

bluejetty:00063875:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00063875:ios.description:
The easiest way to enjoy your own photos & videos on your TV.
Photo Video Cast is the #1 chromecast application in its category, with powerful features presented in a straightforward, simple interface.
*** App Requires a Chromecast, or a Chromecast-enabled TV ***
A REALLY BIG DISPLAY changes everything!
• Share your photos and videos on your bug screen TV with family and friends.
• Create your own custom slideshows by picking individual photos or entire albums, add songs from your music library to make a soundtrack .
• Multiple iPhones/iPads can beam photos & videos to a single screen.
• Start a slideshow, and keep it running in the background.
• Cast from any application that supports photo sharing. 
• 5 video resolutions available, up to 4K UHD with Chromecast Ultra!
• 4 photo framing modes to make the most of your large screen:
- Screen fit (resize photo to fit your TV frame)
- Full screen (centered)
- Full screen (pan)
- Full screen (centered on faces)
• Some great features for small businesses & events:
- Let the cloud take over: loop your slideshows uninterrupted without tying down your iPhone/iPad.
- Turn on multicast to cast slideshows to multiple TVs at the same time.
Note that the face detection feature works best when both eyes + mouth are visible, and does not currently work with cloud slideshows.
***** Compatibility *****
If your TV is compatible with chromecast, photo cast will work. In other words, all you need is an HDMI port on your TV.
The picture is optimized for your TV's resolution so you will be making the best of your TV. All resolutions are supported
***** Mobile HotSpot (MiFi) users *****
If your WiFi is powered by a Mobile HotSpot (MiFi), your MiFi device may need additional configuration to allow your chromecast dongle to request images from your iPhone/iPad on port 8081/8082 over HTTP. It may just work out of the box, but we recommend trying the following steps if it doesn't:
1. Port filtering should either be completely disabled, or if enabled, HTTP communication should be allowed on port 8081 & 8082
2. Privacy separation should be disabled
3. If all fails, enable port forwarding with these settings
- protocol: HTTP
- port range: 8081 to 8082
- destination ip: the ip address of the iOS device running photo cast
***** Important Notices *****
- Cloud-powered slideshows will automatically upload your photos to a private cloud.
- If you experience frequent buffering with videos, make sure that both your chromecast and your iPhone/iPad have a good wifi signal reception. Should all else fail, pick a lower resolution.
- If you are experiencing any issues, please contact us at photocast@swishly.com. We can't help you if we don't hear from you!

bluejetty:00127638:ios.name: Podcast Guru - App & Player
bluejetty:00127638:ios.summary:
Podcast Guru is a beautiful podcast app supporting the latest, cutting edge features of open podcasting!
Featuring elegant navigation and a beautiful interface, this app is also fully loaded. We offer real time cloud backups and are cross
bluejetty:00127638:ios.description:
Podcast Guru is a beautiful podcast app supporting the latest, cutting edge features of open podcasting!
Featuring elegant navigation and a beautiful interface, this app is also fully loaded. We offer real time cloud backups and are cross platform with iOS. It’s the ONLY app that is fully Podchaser integrated, so you’ll see reviews, show creator profiles, and all kinds of extra goodies! We are also full backers of open podcasting and the Podcasting 2.0 initiative with features like chapters, transcripts, etc. Discover new podcasts, leave reviews and ratings, browse curated lists and cross reference your favorite hosts and creators across multiple pods! 
Why are you going to love Podcast Guru?
A frustration-free experience
Podcast Guru is EASY to use, and we really mean it. Most other podcast apps have confusing interfaces and don’t prioritize user experience. Our app puts you first. We aim to delight you with a lightweight and beautiful design and not an overburdened clunky app.
Podchaser Integration
We were the first, and currently only app to have full podchaser integration! With Podchaser as our partner, we provide a rich experience, by showing you creator profiles, user lists, reviews and ratings. A free Podchaser account is not required, but if you’re already a Podchaser user, then this is the only app you’ll want to use.
Podcasting 2.0 Support
We are full backers of the latest Podcasting 2.0 standards, we currently support the majority of the new Podcasting 2.0 features and are always adding more! Currently this includes (when supported by the podcaster) :
* Transcripts - Full transcripts, or closed captions
* P2.0 search - Access to The Podcast Index's open podcasting directory
* Chapters - Podcaster included links, text and images on-screen as you listen
* Funding - Links to funding websites like Patreon to support your favorite podcasters
* Location - Extra information if the podcast is geographically relevant.
* P2.0 credits - Person, guests, hosts, etc 
* Podping - real-time episode notifications 
Other Amazing Features
* Offline support with Auto downloads for your favorite podcasts.
* Night Mode.
* Multiple Search Engine Support (iTunes, The Podcast Index, etc)
* Browse Podcasts by Category
* Podcast episode reviews / ratings
* Configurable playback speed
* Full playlist support
* Sleep Timer
* Home Screen Widget
* Accessibility and compatibility with screen readers.
* Modifiable Playback queue (Up Next, etc)
* Genre Filtering
* OPML import / export support
* Browse Popular and Trending Podcasts
* View podcaster, creator and guest profiles
VIP Tier Features
* Realtime Cloud Sync and backup across all your devices (including iOS)
* Advanced speed controls
* Advance disk/storage management automation.
Full Video Support
We support video podcasts like MacBreak and Ted Talks. You can also subscribe to Odysee RSS feeds! 
Great content
Easily find your favorite podcasts, or discover new shows from millions of episodes available for free online. Podcast reviews and ratings powered by Podchaser help you find the best content. 
Podcast Guru listeners are currently enjoying the latest episodes from popular podcasts including:
* Huberman Lab
* Critical Role
* No Agenda
* Crime Junkie
* Hidden Brain
* Hardcore History
* Lex Fridman Podcast
* The ALL-IN Podcast
Our mission is simple: Give listeners a powerful, reliable, and easy to use podcast manager - with only the minimum permissions required. Fun. Easy. Powerful. That's Podcast Guru.
Terms & Conditions: https://podcastguru.io/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://podcastguru.io/privacy/

bluejetty:00133598:ios.description:
Looking for a reliable way to measure the approximate weight of objects without using a traditional scale? With Weight Scale for Grams AI, you can now estimate weight directly from your phone. This innovative AI scale app uses the power of scale AI and camera technology to give you instant weight results in grams.
Our app works as a weight scale, weighing scale, or even a weighing machine, making it useful in everyday life when you don’t have access to physical tools. Just place the object, capture it with your phone camera, and let the AI instantly calculate the approximate weight in grams.
* Why Choose Weight Scale for Grams AI?
Unlike ordinary apps, this is not just a calculator – it is a digital scale powered by smart image recognition. The advanced AI works like a smart scale and gives you results that feel as easy as using a gram balance. You can even use it as a kitchen scale when cooking or baking, as an iScale alternative, or as a scale image and picture scale app for quick estimates. Whether you call it a digital kitchen scale or simply a smart tool, it’s designed to make measuring weight convenient and fun.
* Measure in Grams with AI
This app is perfect for anyone who wants to weigh grams quickly. Whether you need to check weight grams for recipes, a scale for grams while studying, or even a digital scale grams tool for small objects, our app makes it possible. It acts like a gram weight scale, helping you with weighing grams in seconds. Think of it as your personal scale master in your pocket.
The AI system uses camera AI to analyze objects, turning your phone into a photo scale or scale app that’s simple yet powerful. No extra tools are required – just your phone camera. Whether you need a pocket scale for quick checks or want a fun way to experiment with measurements, this app delivers.
* Scan and Detect Weight Instantly
With built-in smart features, the app can even be described as a weight scanner. It can scan weight from objects you capture, acting as a photo weight or camera weight tool. By combining advanced image processing, it functions as a weight estimator or weight detector, making it one of the most versatile weight apps available.
Key Features:
- Estimate weight in grams with AI camera
- Works as a digital and weighing scale alternative
- Can be used as a kitchen scale or pocket scale
- Simple design, easy to use, and user-friendly interface
- Uses smart AI scale technology for fast results
- Fun and practical for daily use
Download Weight Scale for Grams AI today and experience the future of smart measuring. Whether you need a quick gram balance, a digital scale grams tool, or just want to explore AI technology, this app is your go-to solution.
Disclaimer -
This app is designed to approximate weight using AI and camera recognition. It is not meant to replace professional measuring tools or certified weighing machines. Use it for educational, experimental, and fun purposes only.

bluejetty:00027462:ios.description:
*For New Brunswick Snowmobiling Only*
Out exploring on your snowmobile? Take your own mobile trail assistant for the ride!
The New Brunswick Federation of Snowmobile Clubs (NBFSC) brings an enhanced version of its web application to your pockets, making for a better riding experience than ever. Working both with and WITHOUT mobile data coverage, you will be able to enjoy the app’s functionalities no matter where you are on the trails.
This app gives you access to the following *OFFLINE* features, anywhere, anytime, even in areas without cell coverage:
► See your location on the map through your phone’s GPS signal
► View nearby restaurants, gas stations, hotels, parking, and other services
► Access the trail conditions as per the last data connection available
► See the distance between you and a specific point
► Easily access a list of curated snow tours
► Quickly save and load itineraries
► Enhance your driving experience with the drive mode function
Getting back to a zone with mobile coverage? Enjoy these additional *ONLINE* features :
► Keep an eye on updated trail statuses for the best riding experience
► Easily meet with friends by sharing your position with each other (no one else can see your location)
► Plan out an itinerary and share it with your group
Welcome to the GoSnowmobiling NB! mobile experience and enjoy the ride!
Notes:
►Continued use of the GPS and location sharing running in the background can significantly increase battery consumption. It is recommended to toggle it off when not needed to improve autonomy.
The Pro Version is a $3.99 CAD per year auto-renewable subscription. Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Link to our privacy policy: https://www.evtrails.com/privacy-terms-and-conditions/
Link to our terms of use: https://www.evtrails.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00033934:ios.name: Screw Inc: Nuts & Bolts
bluejetty:00033934:ios.summary: "Screw Inc: Nuts & Bolts" is an innovative puzzle game that involves moving screws and blocks to solve a variety of unique challenges. Each level takes you into a new world of mental challenges, allowing you to enjoy the fun of disassemblin
bluejetty:00033934:ios.description:
"Screw Inc: Nuts & Bolts" is an innovative puzzle game that involves moving screws and blocks to solve a variety of unique challenges. Each level takes you into a new world of mental challenges, allowing you to enjoy the fun of disassembling and reassembling! Push your intelligence to the limits!
Gameplay
Disassemble Blocks: By moving screws, make the blocks fall until all are removed to complete the level.
Strategy and Skills: Carefully observe the position of each screw and block, and use your wisdom and strategy to solve puzzles.
Simple Controls: Intuitive drag-and-drop controls make it easy to get started and enjoy the puzzle-solving fun.
Features
Rich Levels: Over 1000 carefully designed levels, each with its unique layout and challenges waiting for you to crack.
Ultimate Challenge: Levels range from simple to complex, gradually improving your puzzle-solving skills.
Join the leaderboard! Compete globally and showcase your puzzle-solving skills to the world.
Offline Mode: Without networking, you can play anytime and anywhere, becoming a good choice for your leisure and entertainment.
Whether you’re a puzzle game enthusiast or new to this genre, "Screw Inc: Nuts & Bolts" will bring you endless fun and challenges. Fans of puzzle games, screw puzzles, logical thinking, puzzle challenges, brain games, and casual entertainment, download now and start your disassembly journey!

bluejetty:00064015:ios.description:
Romantic Hidden Object adventure from the creators of Time Trap. Immerse yourself in a romantic story with its roots in the 18th century. 
Features of the game:
- Unique graphics with incredibly lovely Paris scenes!
- The game is TRULY FREE: you can download it for free and unlock every scene with no in-game purchases.
- Most of the hidden items are genuine antiques!
- A variety of tasks: finding hidden objects, finding differences, and pairs; all of this with a special romantic story as a backdrop.
 - Innovative system of photo hints.
- Our game have been translated to ten languages.
Guide a North American girl and a Frenchman through beautiful historic Parisian locales, putting together pieces of the detective puzzle as your proceed. Trips to real attractions in the city of love: Basilique du Sacre-Coeur, Pont des Arts, and the Louvre Museum.
At the end of the game you along with the other heroes will be able to re-invent the ancient chocolate recipe, which has been kept secret for more than 3 centuries.
Want to learn about our other games? 
See you at http://facebook.com/CrispApp

bluejetty:00160787:ios.name: tedee
bluejetty:00160787:ios.summary: How many times have you wondered: "Did I lock the door?", or tried to take the keys out of your pocket with hands full of shopping bags? With tedee smart lock you can forget about it. The app will lock the door when you leave and can unlock
bluejetty:00160787:ios.description:
How many times have you wondered: "Did I lock the door?", or tried to take the keys out of your pocket with hands full of shopping bags? With tedee smart lock you can forget about it. The app will lock the door when you leave and can unlock it automatically when you get back home! 
tedee is much more than a key: 
 • unlock and lock your door from anywhere using just your smartphone and tedee bridge 
 • share access to the lock with your family and friends 
 • enjoy auto-unlock feature: the door can be unlocked automatically when you come back home 
 • do not worry about leaving the door unlocked: the app will detect you’re out and lock it for you 
 • browse the logs anytime on your smartphone 
 • get notifications in real time when somebody unlocks the door using the app or a standard key 
 • finally, it looks great! 
****************** 
Why tedee? 
Convenience 
Control your door with a smartphone... wherever you are. Expecting visitors? Share access or unlock the door remotely. Hands full of shopping bags after a shopping spree? The lock will let you in... hands free! 
Efficiency 
You don't have to buy and replace the batteries! Thanks to an ultra-low energy consumption and a powerfull rechargeable battery you can operate your lock for months... and you can charge it overnight. 
Design 
The lock is eye catching. We break up with brick-shaped devices! Enjoy the sleek design that suits your apartment and office. It's small yet powerful. 
Strong cryptography 
The communication with tedee lock is based on the latest TLS 1.3 protocol with a 256-bit security key. The only people who can access the lock are the ones of your choice. 
Events log 
The log privides you with detailed information about all events, like charging, locking and unlocking (both manually and using the app). 
Auto-locking 
tedee lock detects if the mechanical lock was left in a semi-locked position and can finish the turn automatically. You may also want to keep it locked and it will do after a predefined time. 
****************** 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/tedee_smartlock
Questions? Suggestions? We'd love to hear them! Contact us at support@tedee.com or visit www.tedee.com

bluejetty:00045807:ios.name: ccbankil
bluejetty:00045807:ios.summary: ccbankil is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empow
bluejetty:00045807:ios.description:
ccbankil is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with ccbankil:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the ccbankil app, you must be enrolled as a Citizens Community Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00023393:ios.description:
Looking for fun party games to play with friends? Party Games brings 8 hilarious, revealing and entertaining games together in one app, with 800+ questions, challenges and conversation starters to keep everyone playing.
Whether you're hanging out with a few friends, having a party, going on a trip or just looking for something fun to do together, choose your favourite games, add your players and get started in seconds.
8 GAMES IN ONE APP
1) Would You Rather
Make impossible choices and find out which option your friends would pick. Expect plenty of debates!
2) Never Have I Ever
Discover things you never knew about your friends with funny, embarrassing and revealing questions.
3) Most Likely To
Who is most likely to do something ridiculous? Point the finger and see if everyone agrees.
4) Truth
Answer fun and revealing questions and find out how well you really know each other.
5) Dare
Take on hilarious challenges and see who is brave enough to complete their dare.
6) Finish the Sentence
Complete funny and unexpected sentences that can lead to some seriously entertaining answers.
7) This or That
Two choices. One answer. Pick a side and compare your choices with your friends.
8)Hot Takes
Share your opinion on controversial and hilarious topics, then see who agrees and who definitely doesn't.
CHOOSE HOW YOU PLAY
Keep things fun with Normal Mode, or turn things up with No Limits for bolder questions and wilder challenges.
With hundreds of cards and 8 different game modes, every game can be completely different.
Perfect for:
- Parties and nights out
- Game nights
- Couples and friends
- Group hangouts
- Holidays and road trips
- Breaking the ice
- Getting to know your friends better
No complicated rules or setup. Just add your players, choose your games and start playing.
What are you waiting for? Grab your friends and get the party started!
This app contains an auto-renewing subscription for $2.99 per week. You can try out the subscription first, with a 3 day free trial. Once subscribed, you can cancel your subscription at any point.

bluejetty:00079856:android.name: Scary Spider Train Survival 1
bluejetty:00079856:android.summary: Get ready for the ultimate Spider Train survival horror experience with Choo Scary Spider Train Survival 1! In this thrilling game, you'll be the conductor of a small yellow train equipped with a map, hunting machine gun, and an impressive
bluejetty:00079856:android.description:
Get ready for the ultimate Spider Train survival horror experience with Choo Scary Spider Train Survival 1! In this thrilling game, you'll be the conductor of a small yellow train equipped with a map, hunting machine gun, and an impressive collection of Charles-anti weapons also known as cho-cho weapons. But, initially, you won’t access to all the cho-cho weapons: you will have to prove your strength and finish multiple in-game missions in order to acquire more powerful anti-Charles weapons. Your ultimate goal is to eradicate the spider train monsters known as Charles-1X crew who has, with his fellow monsters even more powerful than mr meat or evil nun or huggy, terrorized the cho-cho islands and is preying on the flesh of humans. Get ready for exciting horror playtime!
As you navigate the vast open world of the island with your choo choo train, you'll be challenged with completing missions for the townspeople and collecting scraps from around the island to upgrade your train. With each upgrade, you'll increase your train's speed, armor, and firepower, making you better equipped to face the relentless monster train that won't stop until it catches its target. But be warned, there are several different types of spooky monsters roaming the island, each with its own unique abilities and strengths. Use your quick reflexes and strategic thinking to stay alive and keep the monster train at bay.
Join forces with your friends and take on the challenge of defeating "Charles" once and for all. With your hunting machine gun at your side and other choo choo weapons, you'll be able to take down this terror and restore peace to the islands. Don't let the creepy clown games and spider legs of Cho-Cho Scary Spider Train scare you. Prove your bravery and download Cho-Cho Scary Spider Train Survival 1 today!
In this game, you'll be able to fully immerse yourself in a survival horror experience like no other. With an open world environment and an amazing cho-cho train at your disposal, you'll be able to explore the island and discover its secrets. The train in the game has some amazing features, such as the ability to jump off and run away from the monster spider train, making it a challenging and exciting experience.
In this first chapter, you will have to join forces with the local villages who will help you out settle in the island and also become familiar with the restored cho-cho train that will be an indispensable tool in your battle with the Scary Spider Train to free the islands. The villagers will also you provide you with the help to increase your cho-cho yellow Train Speed, weapons Damage and Shield resistance to Scary Charles-Spider Train attacks. For that, you will need to gather as much metal plates and scraps as you could!
So, are you ready to take on the challenge? Download Scary Spider Train Survival today and see if you have what it takes to survive the terror of the monster train. Join the ranks of the brave and experience the ultimate survival horror game!

bluejetty:00091366:ios.description:
Pass Your NCLEX-RN & NCLEX-PN with Help That Works - Fully Updated for 2026
Preparing for the NCLEX can feel overwhelming, but you're not alone. This exam prep app is built by licensed nurse educators and NCLEX specialists. Practice NCLEX questions every day, take an NCLEX practice quiz or a realistic NCLEX practice test, and follow a personal NCLEX study plan - all aligned with the 2026 NCLEX standards and the Next Generation NCLEX. With adaptive learning tailored to your level, you'll get ready to pass on your very first try.
NCLEX PRACTICE QUIZZES & QUIZ GAME MODE
Start a quick NCLEX practice quiz between shifts or classes. Customizable NCLEX practice quizzes let you pick topics and test modes. Short NCLEX quizzes by topic help you review one concept at a time. Or try quiz game mode: play NCLEX RN and PN quizzes with limited lives.
NCLEX PRACTICE QUESTIONS
Practice with a question bank of 4,500+ NCLEX-style questions covering all key topics. Each of our NCLEX practice questions has expert-written answer explanations. Use these NCLEX model questions to review nursing concepts and understand the reasoning behind each answer. Question styles follow real NCLEX exam questions.
NCLEX PRACTICE TESTS & PRACTICE EXAM
Take a full-length NCLEX practice test that mirrors the actual NCLEX format. Mix topics in shorter NCLEX practice tests or sit a complete NCLEX practice exam. Every NCLEX exam practice test and NCLEX practice quiz ends with a clear report - review NCLEX practice test questions to see what to study next.
NEXT GENERATION NCLEX QUESTIONS
Prepare for the NCLEX next generation format with a focus on clinical judgment. Start with next gen NCLEX practice questions and review the explanations after each quiz. Include NCLEX next gen practice questions in your study plan, using next generation NCLEX practice questions to identify concepts that need more review.
NCLEX-RN
Start an NCLEX RN practice test or an NCLEX RN quiz, work through NCLEX RN practice questions and review NCLEX RN study questions. Take an NCLEX RN exam practice test or browse NCLEX RN sample questions.
NCLEX-PN (LPN/LVN)
Get practice questions for NCLEX PN built around the PN test plan. Take NCLEX PN quizzes, review NCLEX PN questions, work through NCLEX PN prep questions and try sample NCLEX PN questions.
"Where can I find sample NCLEX questions?"
Try sample NCLEX questions and NCLEX practice quizzes from every domain:
Safe and Effective Care Environment
Health Promotion and Maintenance
Psychosocial Integrity
Physiological Integrity
See how NCLEX test questions are structured.
YOUR NCLEX STUDY PLAN
Get a study path based on your strengths and improvement areas. Your NCLEX study plan mixes NCLEX practice quizzes, NCLEX exam practice questions, NCLEX study questions and NCLEX test prep questions. Studying outside the US? Take an NCLEX practise test or review NCLEX practise questions - same test plan.
FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE
- NCLEX practice quizzes by topic and quiz game mode
- Realistic exam simulations - an NCLEX prep test under actual test conditions
- Performance analytics and clear progress reports
- Study reminders to keep your NCLEX test prep on track
- Dashboard widgets for your pass rate and study progress
From nursing school to test day, join over 20,000 nursing students who have already prepared for their nursing exam with our app. This nursing app is free to download; some features require a subscription.

Download now and take control of your NCLEX prep - one NCLEX practice quiz at a time.

bluejetty:00149932:ios.description:
With the Seint app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-approved tools. You’ll have a vast array of marketing materials like videos, images, and more—all right at your fingertips! The powerful, yet beautifully simple design, along with compelling tools, makes growing your business simpler than ever.
Contacts: Choose how to sync and manage your contacts. Swipe to sort them by interest level. You can make connections, add notes, or check out the Contact Feed to see the tools you’ve shared and contact actions.
Tools: It has never been easier to share information about your products and opportunity via SMS text, email, or social media. Simply choose tools specifically designed to promote your business and share them with a contact. You’ll receive a notification when contacts view a tool so you know exactly when to follow up! You can even add your own tools. Record or upload short videos to share with prospects. You can even add actions to your videos so prospects can interact directly in the video. These smarter interactive tools are called a Brightool and they provide more data for follow up with ActionAlert notifications in the Feed. No data connection? No problem! Simply download tools such as videos in the app beforehand for offline playback.
Business: Access helpful links to build your business.
Settings: Our simple Share Setup will help you upload a profile picture, define your ‘why’ in your bio, and add other info that will help contacts connect with you and learn more about your business and products. You can also configure notification preferences, watch QuickTips to learn about the app, and more.
Learn: Empowering users by providing simple and effective training courses, lessons, quizzes, awards, and more. With videos, images, PDFs, quotes and more built into the lessons, you can learn more than ever and have fun while doing it.

bluejetty:00178074:ios.description:
Create moving photos for a unique type of photo art! Animate your photos & magically bring them to life with Motionleap. The newest addition to the award-winning Enlight Creativity Suite of apps, brought to you by Lightricks, takes photo editing to the next level. 
Motionleap brings life to images through animation, creating moving pictures that will wow anyone from your friends to Instagram followers. Animate one element or several, drawing attention to parts of your photo that YOU want to come alive. With the same ease of use brought to you in the rest of the Enlight Creativity Suite, including Photofox, Lightleap, and Videoleap (Apple’s App of the Year), Motionleap allows you to easily edit photos with powerful, precise, and easy to use animation tools. In just a few taps animate, add elements & overlays, adjust the speed and watch your image come to life. As a result you’ll get incredible videos that boomerang back and forth or flow like a GIF. 
Need inspiration? Follow #Motionleap, then tag your own creations and we’ll feature the best ones!
Get excited about the power of Motionleap features:
ANIMATED PHOTOS MADE EASY
- Animate a photo with a few taps and swipes
- Arrows will show motion direction
- Place anchor points to hold parts of image in place
- Freeze sections of photos with a Freeze brush
AI POWERED WATER ANIMATION
- NEW automated water animation
- Effortless water movement with a single tap
FANTASTIC SKY REPLACEMENT TECHNOLOGY
- Replace bland Skies with colorful sunsets or animated clouds
- Wide variety of automated Skies resembling timelapse
HYPNOTIC GEOMETRIC MOTION
- Geometric photo animation tool creates spinning towers and umbrellas 
- Move your favorite historical landmarks in a never before seen way
- Add patterned movement to iconic buildings
VIDEO EFFECTS & OVERLAYS IN A PHOTO EDITOR
- Control movement & animation including speed, direction, and style 
- Mimic cinematic movement with Camera FX
- Camera effects & movements include Tilt, Zoom, and ‘Dolly’ effects
- Add fun Overlays to bring movement, mood, & emotion to still photos
- Distort perspective & style with effects
MOVING ELEMENTS IN STILL PHOTOS
- Grab attention with a moving element - candle flickers, coffee steam, or a butterfly
- A new kind of animation between photos, videos, and GIFs
- Add a cinemagraph effect with a moving element in a still photo
INFINITE ARTISTIC POSSIBILITY
- Animate any photo element: hair, waves, clouds & clothing
- Push your imagination with Motionleap high-end & easy animation tools
- Create moving masterpieces that serve your social media presence, business, or personal brand
HIGH END PHOTO EDITOR
- Intuitive UI means anyone can animate & create professional results
- Animate with freeform drawn paths for intuitive, freehand-style  in unlimited areas
- Export to social media in multiple formats 
- Export as incredible Live Wallpaper
- Unlimited projects & Adjustments
Terms of use: https://static.lightricks.com/legal/terms-of-use.pdf
Privacy policy: https://static.lightricks.com/legal/privacy-policy.pdf

bluejetty:00073229:ios.summary: Welcome to Burger Please!, the ultimate restaurant simulation game where cooking becomes your path to building a global fast-food empire. Step into a lively kitchen filled with sizzling ingredients, satisfying meals, and endless challenges
bluejetty:00073229:ios.description:
Welcome to Burger Please!, the ultimate restaurant simulation game where cooking becomes your path to building a global fast-food empire. Step into a lively kitchen filled with sizzling ingredients, satisfying meals, and endless challenges designed for anyone who loves cooking. Whether you've dreamed of running a food shop, becoming a master of hamburger crafting, or expanding your own international franchise, this game lets you create that success story through nonstop cooking fun.
▶ Build Your Fast-Food Shop & Burger Empire
Start with a small restaurant counter and transform it into a world-famous restaurant. Each day introduces new customers, new cooking tasks, and new management challenges. You’ll prepare meals, side dishes, and even add pizza to your growing food menu. Every upgrade strengthens your brand and expands your burger empire across the globe.
▶ Cook & Serve a Variety of Food Items
Become the town’s rising cookmaster through nonstop cooking action! Grill burger patties, stack ingredients, and serve delicious food to hungry customers. As your menu grows, you'll handle hot pizzas alongside classic burger orders, balancing speed, creativity, and efficient cooking. Making everything from premium hamburger plates to fresh pizza variations creates the ultimate addictive loop for fans of fast-food management.
▶ Upgrade, Expand & Run the Perfect Restaurant Shop
Turn your humble counter into a full drive-thru shop by upgrading machines, equipment, and staff abilities. Faster service means more satisfied customers and more profit to reinvest. Open new branches, unlock new burger levels, and introduce additional food categories—including special pizza menus
▶ Hire, Train & Manage a Skilled Team
No chef grows alone! Recruit staff, train them, and improve their performance with smart management. A strong team helps you handle rush hours, maintain clean tables, and serve everything from fries and drinks to premium hamburger and burger meals. With the right strategy, your fast-food business scales faster than ever.
▶ Face Daily Challenges & Special Events
Delivery orders, VIP guests, sudden crowds, and special pizza events keep your cooking journey exciting. Every challenge tests your timing and fast-food management skills. Handle them well and earn bonuses, unlock upgrades, and push your burger franchise to new heights.
▶ Expand Your Menu Beyond Burgers
Why limit yourself to burger dishes? Add pizza, snacks, and more food varieties to become a true master of fast-food cooking. Each expansion introduces new levels, customer types, and opportunities to showcase your talent. With engaging gameplay and deep management mechanics,
Become the master chef who serves burger, fries, pizza, and every popular fast-food favorite to customers around the world. Download Burger Please! today and prove you can run the most iconic restaurant and build a legendary burger franchise!

bluejetty:00016861:ios.description:
-----------------------
■Vocacolle Features
-----------------------
Background playback support.
- You can playback audio while using other apps or the web
Sabi Medley"(*1)
- You can playback rankings and playlists of your choice in a medley of choruses, just like a music introduction program.
No need to register as a member to listen to music.
- If you have a NicoNico account, you can sync with your NicoNico MyList, and your MyLists that you follow will also be reflected.
Fast and Smooth Audio Playback
- Use the crossfade to switch between works and play them back smoothly and at high speed.
Cover Mix" (*2)
- You can play back multiple cover versions of a single song by connecting them together as if they were a single work of art.
Recommended autoplay" (*3)
- After a work is played, recommended works related to the work are played in succession, allowing you to enjoy related works as if they were an auto-playlist.
Continuous playback from Kiite
- Clicking the "Continuous playback from Vocacolle" button on the playlist screen in the mobile version of the music discovery service Kiite (https://kiite.jp/) allows background playback in Vocacolle.
--------------------------
*1: About Sabi Medley
- This service is made possible by receiving information on the chorus from Songle (https://songle.jp/), an active music appreciation service developed and made available by the Media Interaction Research Group of the National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST).
- The position of the chorus played by Vocacolle is automatically analyzed by Songle's music understanding technology. If it is incorrect, it can be edited/corrected from Songle.
- Video contributors can fix the correct chorus position in Songle (you need to login to Songle with your Nico Nico account)
- The idea of "playback chorus one after another" is inspired by Songrium's "Super History Player (http://doc.songrium.jp/chorekishi/)" and "Smart Player (https://smart.songrium.jp/)" functions.
2: About CoverMIX
- This is made possible by AIST's derivative work recommendation technology based on information on derivative works provided by Songrium (https://songrium.jp/), a music listening support service developed and released by AIST.
- The idea of "playback so that it sounds like a single song" was inspired by Songrium's "relay playback" function.

bluejetty:00115013:ios.description:
ZoomX: Super Zoom Camera transforms your iPhone into a powerful zoom lens.

Whether you’re exploring nature, documenting your adventures, or just having fun experimenting, ZoomX: Super Zoom Camera gives you the tools to zoom in, capture, and save memories with ease.
Take your mobile photography to the next level today with ZoomX.

bluejetty:00030184:ios.description:
'볼라고 (Vollago)'는 대한민국 유명 커뮤니티를 빠르고 편하게 눈팅할 수 있는 앱입니다.
자주 가는 커뮤니티 사이트를 빠르고 편리하게 이용하세요.
* '볼라고' 주요 기능 소개
- 자주 가는 사이트의 게시판을 즐겨찾기 그룹으로 따로 모아서 편하게 관리할 수 있습니다.
- 기억해두고 싶은 글을 북마크 해 두고 나중에 다시 찾아볼 수 있습니다.
- 늦은 시간까지 편하게 눈팅할 수 있는 나이트 테마가 지원됩니다.
- 모든 커뮤니티의 게시판을 검색할 수 있습니다. (초성검색 지원)
- 이미 읽은 글은 흐리게 표시되어 읽었는지 안 읽었는지, 댓글이 새로 추가되었는지 바로 알 수 있습니다.
- 즐겨찾기 그룹, 게시판 설정, 북마크 등의 데이터는 iCloud에 저장됩니다.
- 데이터 파일 업데이트로 항상 최신 상태를 유지할 수 있습니다.
* '볼라고' 사용 시 유의 사항
- 글/댓글 작성은 지원되지 않습니다.
- 글 작성 및 댓글 작성을 원하시면 '사파리에서 열기'를 이용하여 로그인 후 작성하실 수 있습니다.
- '볼라고'는 각 사이트의 공식 클라이언트가 아니며, 사용자가 선택한 웹페이지를 읽기 편한 형태로 표시하는 앱 입니다.
- 각 사이트에서 제공되는 콘텐츠의 권리와 책임은 원 작성자 및 해당 사이트에 있으며, 사용자는 각 사이트의 이용약관과 운영방침을 준수해야 합니다.
- '볼라고'에서 표시되는 모든 컨텐츠의 원문은 하단 툴바 또는 메뉴를 이용하여 언제든 해당 사이트에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

bluejetty:00171516:ios.name: Treasure Diving: Lost Atlantis
bluejetty:00171516:ios.summary: Discover a colorful world of adventure in Treasure Diving. The oceans hold many stories, mysteries and secrets: ancient cities that are under water, sunken ships, treasures and mythical artifacts. They have been waiting for their heroes for
bluejetty:00171516:ios.description:
Discover a colorful world of adventure in Treasure Diving. The oceans hold many stories, mysteries and secrets: ancient cities that are under water, sunken ships, treasures and mythical artifacts. They have been waiting for their heroes for many years, and maybe you will make outstanding discoveries!
Life on an underwater base is an amazing adventure!
- hundreds of exciting expeditions
- hundreds of unique treasures
- hundreds of unique quests
- hundreds of species of exotic marine life and pets
- more than 50 useful buildings and structures
- daily rewards for each player
Key features of Treasure Diving:
EXCITING STORY:
Help collect all the pieces of an old map and save Captain Jack from a terrible curse. Feel like a fearless explorer of the deep sea, go through all the tests and solve the mystery of the pirate curse!
JOURNEY:
Prepare your submarine for the journey, refill your oxygen tanks and embark on new expeditions. Enjoy the beauty of the deep sea and fantastic underwater landscapes. Outstanding discoveries await you in the game!
EXPLORE:
Explore the underwater world to meet the amazing inhabitants of the deep sea. Find a sunken fortress, unravel the mystery of the Bermuda Triangle, or discover the secret of a sunken city of an ancient civilization. Amazing adventures await you in the game!
CHARACTERS AND ENEMIES:
Only the brave conquer the seas! Somewhere, in the depths of the sea, greedy pirates and sweet-voiced sirens, a bloodthirsty kraken and an insidious sorceress are already waiting, but they will be defeated if you assemble a brave team! Meet the inhabitants of neighboring underwater stations, make friends and they will come to the rescue!
UNDERWATER PETS:
Get into farming! At your base, you can grow many types of fish and have unique marine animals. Do good, build a nursery to take care of marine life in trouble. Feed your pets and get resources to develop your station!
UNDERWATER FARM:
Develop your own garden! At your base, you can plant outlandish underwater plants, and when the fruits ripen along with the harvest on the beds, you will receive rare collectible items. It's time to equip your underwater farm!
COLLECTIBLES:
Exploring the depths of the sea, you can find many rare and unusual things. Collect the items you find and combine them into collections to get resources to develop your underwater station.
BUILDING AND CRAFTING:
Build buildings and upgrade constructions to unlock new types of crafting and create even more unique resources. Develop your underwater base and level up your submarine. Incredible adventures and the greatest discoveries await you in the game!
BASE DEVELOPMENT:
Set up decorations and build your own underwater park. Create a unique design for your station and earn extra experience points!
AMAZING FINDS:
Explore expeditions to unearth sunken treasures and mysterious artifacts. These finds promise wealth and good luck! Find out if the stories and legends that hide the depths of the sea are true!
GAME WITH FRIENDS:
Use social networks, add friends, visit the neighbors' underwater bases and help them with the housework. Make gifts, send resources and animals to please your buddies.
GAME FEATURES:
Fun 2d animations, funny characters, hundreds of colorful locations, daily events, intuitive controls and many unique game mechanics await you. Treasure Diving can be played offline, but you will need to connect to the game server to save game progress, receive and send gifts to friends.
Any questions? We will gladly answer your questions. Write to us at the support mail:
tdm-support-ios@mobitalegames.com
Subscribe to the latest news and game updates:
https://www.facebook.com/diving.mobile
Privacy Policy:
https://www.mobitalegames.com/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Service:
https://www.mobitalegames.com/terms_of_service.html

bluejetty:00089101:ios.description:
Play Time Travel: Escape Room Game and unlock secrets of the past and the future with a crystal in your hand! Participate in this escape room game challenge with a twist. This 100 room escape puzzle game enables you to sneak peek through time thanks to its broken time machine. Absurd right? You too can feel the thrill, just solve escape puzzles and find the missing piece for the time machine in 100 world famous locations in different times. The heart of the time machine beats with the power of a rare crystal. Simply play Time Travel: Escape Room Game, find the crystal and see what it feels like to be a real time traveler!
What’s the deal with Time Travel: Escape Room Game and its broken time machine?!
A revolutionary time machine is developed by a genius doctor in his lab. The main part of the machine that makes travel through time possible is a rare shimmering crystal. As time traveling is a very complex thing, the time machine breaks all the time which makes his time travelings unpredictable. Whenever the time travel machine breaks, the crystal falls out and disappears somewhere in the scene. Be a master of this 100 room escape game, solve demanding puzzles, find the key in the form of a rare crystal and escape the time you got stuck in. Start time traveling with Time Travel: Escape Room Game!
TIME TRAVEL: ESCAPE ROOM GAME CHARACTERISTICS
- Exciting puzzles with hidden objects and conundrums to solve
- Cool mechanics: move in time and space, combine objects, play brain games
- Lucky spin to get HINTS
- Skip the level if you get stuck
- Visit many world's famous locations in different times
- Takes up almost no memory on your device
Time Travel: Escape Room Game is a very complex 100 room challenge to be cracked. That’s why Doc needs your help in this time travel escape adventure, so he can find the lost time travel crystal, fix the machine and return to his lab and his time. Doc can’t continue his time travel without you, so help him. Play Time Travel: Escape Room Game.

bluejetty:00126181:ios.name: Daily Water - Drink Reminder
bluejetty:00126181:ios.summary: We all know that water is essential to our health, 2/3 of body is consists of water, yet most of us unknowingly suffer from chronic dehydration, this is a underlying cause of many illnesses. To most of us, we are always too busy to drink wa
bluejetty:00126181:ios.description:
We all know that water is essential to our health, 2/3 of body is consists of water, yet most of us unknowingly suffer from chronic dehydration, this is a underlying cause of many illnesses. To most of us, we are always too busy to drink water, or we only drink water when we feel thirsty, that’s too late if so, thirst is signal which our body warn us that our body have lost water balance, and the cells have already dehydrated to serious situation.
Water plays a very important role in our body, it transports nutrients and oxygen into cells, regulates body temperature, helps with metabolism and so on, drinking enough water can help us lose weight, look younger with healthier skin, less likely to get sick, helps in digestion and constipation, relieves fatigue, have a good mood, reduce the risk of cancer and more.
While it is not to say that the more water your drink, the healthier you will be, too much water will also hurt your health, especially for those who suffer from heart disease, hypertension, nephrosis, edema and so on, drinking a healthy amount of water and drink water in right time is vital to your health. 
To majority of us, we only know that we drink ‘a lot of’ water or ‘a little’ water, we don’t know exactly how much water we drink, is that quantity suitable for us?
Daily water is the app which helps us to track the quantity of water we drink and remind us to drink water in right time.
Features:
⁃ Set goal amount of daily drinking water and track it.
⁃ Log amount of daily drinking water. 
⁃ Touch to log each drinking.
⁃ Check glasses of water drunk each day.
⁃ Customize volume of each glass of water.
⁃ Customize how much of water you drink each time, 1/4 glass, 1/2 glass or A glass.
⁃ Plan drinking schedule and it will remind you when it’s time.
⁃ 10 free alert sounds to choose. 
⁃ Histogram to show the amount of your one day’s, recent one week’s and one month’s amount of drinking water.
⁃ Show amount of glasses of water you have drunk one day on the icon.
⁃ Email the data of date, amount of water to anyone you would like.
⁃ Supports transferring data to Health app.
⁃ Supports WiFi backup & restore. 
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Support oz and ml.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports Today Widget.
⁃ Supports both iPhone and iPad.
If you have any question or suggestion, please send email to our support userfeed@vip.tom.com.

bluejetty:00132080:ios.summary:
fDeck turns your iPhone or iPad into a working aircraft instrument panel - a graphically beautiful flight deck for your pocket, with live weather, real ADS-B traffic, a flight planner and a powerful radio-navigation trainer.
Trusted by 50,
bluejetty:00132080:ios.description:
fDeck turns your iPhone or iPad into a working aircraft instrument panel - a graphically beautiful flight deck for your pocket, with live weather, real ADS-B traffic, a flight planner and a powerful radio-navigation trainer.
Trusted by 50,000+ pilots, student pilots and flight-sim enthusiasts worldwide. 100% ad-free.
A FULL PANEL OF INSTRUMENTS
Every instrument is hand-crafted to look and behave like the real thing - responsive, animated, and controlled with intuitive touch. Mix and match any combination to build your own flight deck:
• Synthetic Vision (Vision PFD)
• Horizontal Situation Indicator (HSI)
• VOR receiver
• Automatic Direction Finder (ADF)
• Artificial Horizon
• Altimeter (GPS/Baro)
• Vertical Speed Indicator (VSI)
• Aircraft compass with heading bug
• Groundspeed indicator
• Chronometer with fuel totaliser
• Live weather & wind, with TAF/METAR in raw or decoded form
Every instrument has its own built-in video tutorial.
LEARN TO NAVIGATE
Pan your aircraft anywhere on the map and watch every instrument respond in real time. Tune any VOR, NDB or radio aid from a worldwide database - or build your own virtual navaids to practise tracking radials, intercepts and holds. The best radio-navigation trainer you can carry.
PLAN YOUR FLIGHT
Build a flight plan and slave any instrument to it. Waypoints transition automatically as you fly, so every needle keeps pointing exactly where it should - no re-tuning between legs.
FLY WITH CONFIDENCE
• Worldwide aviation database: 20,000+ airports and navaids, updated monthly
• Aviation moving map with airspace, airports and navaids
• Optional 5/10/20NM range rings and enhanced radial lines
• Live ADS-B traffic with a built-in traffic avoidance (TCAS) system
• Tag your own aircraft registration to silence alerts on yourself
• Export your tracks as GPX or KML
FOR YOUR HOME COCKPIT
Drive the instruments straight from X-Plane or Microsoft Flight Simulator via the flight simulation connection, and turn any device into a secondary instrument panel.
PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
No ads. No tracking across other apps. We never sell your data and collect only what is needed to run the app.
NEW IN VERSION 3.0
• Vision: a brand-new synthetic vision PFD (early access - 2D now, 3D coming soon)
• Now 100% ad-free
• Microsoft Flight Simulator support, alongside X-Plane
FDECK PREMIUM
fDeck is free to download and use. Become a Premium member to unlock:
• Premium and Early Access instruments (including Vision)
• Unlimited user navigation stations
• Monthly navigation database updates
• Map weather overlays & live virtual radar
• Live ADS-B traffic with TCAS alerting
• Live TAF & METAR reports
• Unlimited X-Plane & MSFS flight simulation connection
• Crazy fast support from the dev!
Premium is available as a monthly or annual subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase.
• Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends
• Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings
IMPORTANT
fDeck is a training aid and a supplementary/backup instrument. It is not a certified instrument and must not be used as a primary means of navigation.
Questions or ideas? I read every email personally - just use "Contact the developer" in the app, or the contact page on my website:
https://fdeck.app/support/#contact
Full details of our Terms of Service and Privacy policy can be found at the following URLs: 
Terms of Use: https://fdeck.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://fdeck.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00127035:ios.summary: Are you looking to create a safer browsing environment? Purified Porn Filter helps you and your family to be safe browsing the web in Safari, by blocking and filtering explicit content. Purified uses the blocking technology of the xBlock Po
bluejetty:00127035:ios.description:
Are you looking to create a safer browsing environment? Purified Porn Filter helps you and your family to be safe browsing the web in Safari, by blocking and filtering explicit content. Purified uses the blocking technology of the xBlock Porn Blocker app which is trusted by over 26,000 users.
PASSCODE PROTECTION AND ACCOUNTABILITY
To offer the safest browsing experience and best iOS integration, we make use of the iOS Screen Time restrictions. With the help of an accountability partner, friend, or family member, you can ensure that restrictions cannot be bypassed.
SAFE BROWSING IN SAFARI
Purified Porn Filter runs as a plugin in Safari and doesn’t slow down the browser. Since the browsing filter technology only works within Safari, we strongly recommend removing other apps and browsers that may be used to access inappropriate content. Once those apps are removed, by using iOS restrictions, the installation of other apps can be prevented and a safe browsing experience can be maintained.
FREE TRIAL
The Purified Porn Blocker app is available as a free download. You can try the app with a free 7-day trial period. Ongoing use requires an active subscription, available on a monthly or yearly basis. Yearly subscriptions are billed the total annual fee at the time of purchase. Monthly subscription users billed per month.
PERFECT FOR FAMILIES
Install Purified Porn Filter on all of your devices that share the same App Store account and let the blocker protect them. Subscriptions can not be shared via family sharing.
FILTERING EXPLICIT CONTENT
Search engine results (Google, Bing, etc.) and images are being filtered, offering you the safest browsing experience. On certain websites that do not support selective blocking (such as Reddit, Pinterest, and Tumblr), we block the site entirely for the best protection.
BLACKLIST AND SUPPORT
With the help of your accountability partner, you can add additional websites to be blocked within the iOS Screen Time settings. Also, you can contact our support team if you need further assistance blocking explicit content. We love to help you! Email us at support@purified-app.com.
Purified requires devices with a 64-bit processor.
http://purified-app.com
https://www.instagram.com/purifiedblocker/
SUBSCRIPTIONS & TERMS
Purified requires an active subscription. We offer two subscription options:
• Monthly with a 7-day trial
• Annual with a 7-day trial
You will not be charged until the free trial has expired. On the last day of the free trial period, unless you canceled your subscription, you will be automatically charged the applicable subscription fee. All subscriptions automatically renew if it is not canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for the next subscription period up to 24 hours prior to the current subscription expiring. It is not possible to cancel an existing in-app subscription. You can disable the automatic renewal function at any time by adjusting your account settings. 
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: www.purified-app.com/terms.html
DISCLAIMER: Purified Porn Filter is not guaranteed to block all pornography or adult content online. Although this is our goal, we cannot block everything while enabling a satisfactory web experience.
