bluejetty:00161491:ios.description:
The cutest pet salon is open for business! With so many fun activities to do this game will most definitely be your favorite game of 2023 so don't waste your time, hop in and take care of your pet friends, play with them, wash, manicure, dress up and groom the little animals.
You will be in charge of an amazing pet salon with a vast variety of mini games that will add even more fun to your experience.
Every animal in our pet salon for kids is fashionable and stylish. Pick from 4 adorable cats and dogs. We are planning a massive update which will include 20 cats, dogs and even bunnies!
Bath time
Wash the puppies and kittens in your bathtub – Grab a sponge, some shampoo and with lots of love, wash them up, give them some bath toys and make them happy and clean.
Nail Salon
Give your pet the cute manicure they deserve in a creative and colorful nail salon gameplay, Choose from different stickers, gems, polish colors and patterns to create the ultimate style.
Dress Up
Pick your favorite pet and assist them in becoming the most fashionable in the world! dress them up with over a 100 different clothing items!
The game’s engaging and fun gameplay teaches players important life skills, creativity, imagination and curiosity, and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.
Pet Salon is brought to you by Pazu Games Ltd, the publisher of popular kids games like Girls Hair Salon, Girls Makeup Salon, Animal Doctor and others, that are trusted by millions of parents worldwide.
Pazu games for kids are designed especially for children. It offers fun educational games for girls and boys to enjoy and experience.
We invite you to try out Pazu games for kids and toddlers for free and discover a wonderful brand for kids games, with a variety of educational and learning games for girls and boys. Our games offer a variety of game mechanics adapted to the kids’ age and capabilities.
This game is included in the Pazu subscription which offers access to 50+ Pazu’s games with full game versions, no ads, a child-friendly interface, and up to 3 devices for each subscription.

bluejetty:00015502:ios.name: My City Home - Sweet Playhouse
bluejetty:00015502:ios.summary:
Welcome to My City Sweet Home and explore your new house in the urban area! Play some fun city games for kids all day and enjoy creating your own stories!
Meet My City family members and role play with mom, dad, kids, their neighbors, and
bluejetty:00015502:ios.description:
Welcome to My City Sweet Home and explore your new house in the urban area! Play some fun city games for kids all day and enjoy creating your own stories!
Meet My City family members and role play with mom, dad, kids, their neighbors, and with many other dolls in this amazing dollhouse game for kids!
MY CITY FUN HOME GAME – COOL GAME FOR GIRLS AND BOYS!
Check all the rooms in this dollhouse! Each room offers many opportunities for you to play! You will need only your creativity and imagination to create your own doll story! the entire apartment the way you like and play dress-up games all day! Interact with almost everything as all the items can be moved! Visit your neighbors and check what they are doing and find more ways to have fun!
IMAGINE AND CREATE FAMILY STORIES YOU LIKE
Enjoy cool family home games: prepare food in the kitchen, decorate your new apartment, and choose funny hairstyles for all characters! Fun is everywhere in My City Home dollhouse!
My City Fun Christmas Home game allows you to create your own family life story! Win gifts and prizes daily! Everything is possible in our Apartment Dollhouse game as each room has different toys for you to play with!
MY CITY SWEET HOME FEATURES:
• Meet My City Home family and role play games all day! 
• 12 city locations including 2 apartments and a clothing store
• New characters: 2 families with kids, babies, neighbors, and others
• Play My City games with no stress! There is no competition, just fun
• Dress up games - customize characters and all dollhouse rooms as you like
• Explore My City Apartment and find a hidden treasure
• Make the best PARTY ever! Celebrate your birthday and invite your friends
• Meet your neighbors and play games on the street
• Buy ice cream for you and your friend
• Daily gifts and prizes
Can you find the two baby kittens hiding in this game? Will you fix the leaking water pipe? Adventure and fun can be found everywhere in the My City game! While playing this game kids will improve their creativity and imagination! There are no levels in this game only fun and endless opportunities for kids to create their own stories!
Let’s make the best birthday party ever in the living room! Simply throw the pizza in the oven, turn on the disco ball and let the music play. With so many rooms and characters, you will have a lot of fun!
Move objects, explore all rooms or go outside and play on the street! Discover hidden objects and win rewards! Choose a perfect dress or a shirt for all dolls! You can dress dolls the way you like!
MY CITY APARTMENT PLAYHOUSE – PLAY GAME FOR KIDS
Many new characters, rooms, clothing, and super cool accessories waiting for you! Choose a perfect outfit for your character to look nice! Invite your friend and play games on the same device! Yes, a multitouch option is available!
My City games are specially designed to foster kids' creativity and imagination as they have all the options in our games needed for creative expression. Kids need time for imaginative play and our games offer them the freedom to make their own decisions and ideas!
AGE GROUP
Kids games for 4-12 years old. My Town Family games are safe to play even when parents are not at home
MY TOWN GAMES
The My Town Games studio designs dollhouse games that promote creativity & open-ended play for all kids in the world. The company has offices all around the world. For more information visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00082349:ios.summary:
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. User
bluejetty:00082349:ios.description:
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”
Terms of Use:
https://www.medianewsgroup.com/terms-of-use/
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

阿瓦隆是不会死的狼人杀语音社交游戏。

和狼人杀相比，阿瓦隆最大的特点是平民不会死亡，好人和坏人双方根据规则透露的更多信息进行逻辑分析和推理，5局3胜投票决出胜负。阿瓦隆可玩性更高，更注重逻辑推理，游戏玩家需要更好的逻辑分析能力和语言表达能力。

阿瓦隆汇集了国内年轻的高智商群体，让你立即找到在线游戏对象，是一款智者的社交游戏平台。

-快速加入：一键即可以找到6-10人的游戏对象
-自建房间：可以和好友自建房间，私密游戏
-自动化流程：程序提供全自动化的流程，减少了线下游戏的繁琐流程，玩家可以专注于推理和表演


阿瓦隆官方微信：avalon11111，官方QQ：2103345349

bluejetty:00096754:ios.description:
DeepSearch – Your AI-Powered Answer Engine
DeepSearch turns every question into clear, reliable answers. Whether you're researching a topic, exploring a complex idea, or looking for fast facts, DeepSearch combines advanced AI with real-time web data to deliver concise, trustworthy results in seconds.
Just ask anything — DeepSearch finds the information, analyzes it, and summarizes the most important points so you don’t have to dig through endless pages.
Why DeepSearch?
• Ask Anything – From everyday questions to deep research, get precise, structured answers instantly.
• Real-Time Web Insights – AI searches trusted sources across the internet to bring you up-to-date information.
• Clear, Reliable Summaries – Only the key facts, explained simply.
• Follow-Up Questions – Keep the conversation going and dive deeper.
• Fast & Efficient – Ideal for studying, researching, and quick learning.
Powerful Features
• AI Web Search – Answers backed by live information from across the web.
• Deep Explanations – Complex topics broken down with clarity.
• Multi-Angle Insights – Understand concepts from different perspectives.
• Save & Organize – Access previous searches anytime.
• Smart Suggestions – Explore related topics and ideas.
Who Is It For?
• Students and learners
• Researchers and professionals
• Everyday users seeking reliable information
• Anyone who wants answers without digging through dozens of links
DeepSearch helps you get smarter answers faster through a streamlined, AI-driven experience.
Subscription
Subscribe for unlimited access. Plans renew automatically.
Disclaimer: DeepSearch generates AI-powered summaries based on publicly available information. It should not be used for decisions requiring professional, legal, or medical expertise.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/deepsearch-privacy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/deepsearch-terms

bluejetty:00063134:ios.name: City Island 5: Building Sim
bluejetty:00063134:ios.summary:

“City Island 5 - Tycoon Building”, a new city builder game from Sparkling Society, will make you the mayor of a small town starting on just one island. Send your airship to explore the world and unlock beautiful new
bluejetty:00063134:ios.description:
Build a city, your city
“City Island 5 - Tycoon Building”, a new city builder game from Sparkling Society, will make you the mayor of a small town starting on just one island. Send your airship to explore the world and unlock beautiful new islands to build your new cities on. In most city-building games, you are just managing one city, but in “City Island 5 - Offline Tycoon Building” you will be expanding your horizon and skylines to new islands, each with a different theme and surface to build a city on. This city game is also playable as an offline game, so you can build your city without internet or when you have no wifi connection. Join millions of players with the most popular casual city-building game series on mobile! 
From a town, to a city, to a metropolis
Your town will start small as a village, but your cities will grow larger by placing more buildings and unlocking new islands. Building games in the City Island sim games series are well known for their very rewarding free-to-play offline games, packed with quests and loads of content, with always something to do. Visit the towns and cities of your neighbours or visit my city.
City building with a goal, with a purpose
These simulation city builder games fall into the category: fun, casual, offline city building games for free. So this means that you’ll never get bored playing “City Island 5 - Offline Tycoon Building”! Next to the hundreds of buildings to unlock, this island city builder game has dozens of quests to earn treasure chests packed with very cool stuff. Design and build your island city the way you want, and play with friends to help each other. These casual tycoon simulation games come with a lot of cool buildings and islands to unlock and will definitely make you stick around for long sessions to collect loads of money to make your town and cities grow and design them however you want to build a city.
“City Island 5 - Offline Tycoon Building Sim Game” City Builder Games Features: 
* Collect, upgrade, decorate, and explore in this complete construction simulation game! 
* Collect rewards and earn treasure chests! 
* Play this game offline or online. No internet connection required to play
* City builder games made fun again with dozens of cool islands to build your city on! 
* Build your city and watch other players’ cities as well!
* Don’t forget to rate us or give us feedback!
Terms of Use: https://www.sparklingsociety.net/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00170916:ios.description:
패션, 뷰티, 라이프까지
내 취향의 모든 것을 담은 1등 스타일 쇼핑앱, 에이블리(ABLY)
에이블리만의 차별화된 추천 서비스로 내 스타일의 상품만 쏙쏙 골라 구경하세요.
[ 배송 속도는 빠르게, 배송비는 0원! ]
● 오늘 주문하면 내일 도착하는 "도착보장"
 - 이제 오래 기다리지 마세요. 급할 때 바로 사용 하세요!
● 에이블리는 365일, 누구나 "전상품 무료 배송"
 - 하나만 구매해도, 여러 마켓에서 구매해도 언제나 무료배송이에요.
[ 매일 쏟아지는 할인 프로모션 ]
● 신규회원 전용 혜택
 - 신규 가입 후, 첫 구매에 사용할 수 있는 30% 쿠폰팩을 드려요!
● 에이블리 등급 혜택 쿠폰
 - 모든 고객님을 위해 준비한 등급 쿠폰. 등급이 높아질수록 커져가는 혜택을 누려보세요.
● 매일매일 새로운 할인혜택
 - 인기 마켓 단독 할인, 균일가전, 신상특가, 요일특가… 셀 수 없이 다양한 혜택의 신세계를 느껴보세요.
[ 내 스타일은 전부 에이블리 ]
● 패션은 에이블리
 - 요즘 가장 트렌디한 쇼핑몰을 찾으신다면? 쇼핑몰관에서 내 스타일과 딱 맞는 쇼핑몰을 추천 받으세요.
● 브랜드는 에이블리
 - 스트릿·캐주얼 브랜드, 디자이너 브랜드, 스포츠 브랜드, 프리미엄 브랜드까지. 에이블리 브랜드관에서 어떤 브랜드가 있는지 살펴보세요.
● 뷰티는 에이블리
 - 인기 뷰티 브랜드 상품을 에이블리 뷰티 프로모션을 통해 합리적인 가격으로 쇼핑하세요.
● 라이프는 에이블리
 - 폰케이스, 홈데코, 전자기기, 달콤한 간식, 반려동물 용품. 가질 수록 행복해지는 다양한 라이프 상품을 에이블리에서 취향 따라 구경하세요.
[ 더 트렌디하고 재미있는 패션 꿀팁 ]
● 패션 트렌드를 발견하는 코디탭
 - 지금 제일 쿨한 패션이 궁금하다면? 에이블리 에디터가 직접 엄선한 콘텐츠를 만나보세요.
● 유저들과 실시간 스타일 커뮤니케이션
 - 재미탭의 요즘코디, 골라줘, 자유톡에서 에이블리 유저들과 직접 실시간으로 패션 정보와 취향을 나눠보세요.
지금 에이블리(ABLY)를 다운 받고 모든 혜택을 누리세요!
#쇼핑앱 #무료배송 #쇼핑몰 #브랜드 #패션 #라이프 #뷰티 #코스메틱 #핸드메이드
#폰케이스 #스타일 #콘텐츠 #세일 #쿠폰 #취향추천 #취향맞춤 #쇼핑모음앱
[필수적 접근 권한 안내]
- 기기 및 앱 기록 : 기기식별 및 앱 상태(버전 등) 확인
[선택적 접근권한 안내]
- 카메라/저장공간 : 사진 촬영 권한과 기기 저장소의 사진, 미디어 권한으로 상품 구매 후 리뷰 및 게시글 작성시 사진을 촬영하거나 기기에 저장된 파일을 첨부
- 알림 : 혜택, 이벤트, 서비스 내 이용자 활동 또는 관심기능에 대한 알림 제공
- 연락처 : 포인트 이체하기, 선물하기, 친구 등록 시 수신인, 친구 연락처의 간편한 등록
- 동작 및 피트니스: 만보기 서비스의 걸음 수 측정
* 선택적 접근 권한 허용에 동의하지 않아도 에이블리를 사용할 수 있습니다. 단, 선택적 접근 권한 허용에 동의하지 않으실 경우, 서비스 일부 기능의 정상적인 이용이 어려울 수 있습니다.
* 개인정보 처리 방침 : https://a-bly.com/privacy
[ 고객센터 안내 ]
- 이메일: support@a-bly.com
- 고객센터: 1833-8021

bluejetty:00035634:ios.description:
Ready to find your zen through puzzles? Zendoku is an all-new casual and relaxing block puzzle game.
Play this amazing free block puzzle game now. No Wi-Fi needed, so you can play anytime, for however long you want. A relaxing game that is calming and can help you wind down after a stressful day.
Enjoy a soothing block puzzle game where you fit blocks to clear rows and columns. Enjoy calming music, gentle colors and shapes, and stress-free gameplay as you challenge your brain and find your flow. Perfect for moments of peace and quiet!
=== Zendoku Features ===
Tranquil Gameplay
Enjoy a soothing, worry-free environment where the square blocks move at your own pace and with mindful intention. Perfect for unwinding after a busy day or for those quiet moments when you need to relax and have some fun.
Serene Soundtrack
Let the calming music and soft sound effects enhance your focus, mind, and relaxation. Each move is accompanied by tranquil melodies, helping you stay present and centered.
Endless Challenges
With an array of levels to explore, from simple puzzles to more complex layouts and logic, there’s always a new challenge waiting. Progress through various serene environments as you hone your problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
Play Anywhere, Anytime
Whether you’re looking for a quick break or a long, relaxing session, this game fits perfectly into your day. No Wi-Fi required – enjoy it online and offline, whether you're on the go or from the comfort of home.
Step into a world of calm and creativity, where solving puzzles is not just a challenge but a moment of mindfulness. Perfect for adults, teens, and seniors looking for a relaxing game. Let the soothing gameplay and serene visuals guide you through your next favorite puzzle adventure.
Send us your feedback—it helps us provide you with the best game experience!

bluejetty:00071103:ios.name: Snail Bob 1: Arcade Adventure
bluejetty:00071103:ios.summary: Meet Bob - a positive little snail on a mission who badly needs your help. Help him overcome all cunning levels filled with mind-bending puzzles and witty tricks! Find and collect the hidden stars to complete a fun collection of sculptures
bluejetty:00071103:ios.description:
Meet Bob - a positive little snail on a mission who badly needs your help. Help him overcome all cunning levels filled with mind-bending puzzles and witty tricks! Find and collect the hidden stars to complete a fun collection of sculptures and paintings. Can you guess who our lovely mollusk imitates? Passing the short levels in the Bob game, you will appear in various stories, each chapter with a new setting. To enjoy these offline games no wifi is needed, just head on!
CHAPTER 1. HOMECOMING
Start your snail run with a construction site. Poor Bob's house was destroyed, and he has to find a new shelter. Will you help him escape the dangers and create a new Bob world in this app? The snail run won't be easy, we warn you! You'll have to use your wits. Pull the levers, use the construction equipment, roll the stone balls to push the hard-to-reach buttons. During your journey, you will meet Hunter Hamster at times. Interact with him and pass the levels easier.
CHAPTER 2. GRANDPA'S BIRTHDAY
Grandpa has always been so kind to Bob, and now Bob wants to congratulate him on his birthday with a lovely gift! In this snail mail entertainment, you are expected to guide the animal through dangerous wildlife and help him avoid all the pitfalls he'll meet in the forest. Your new friend won't sit still, and you need to keep an eye on him! Use portals, raise the bridges, and solve the puzzles on the way not to let bean fall. Watch out for the caterpillars and the UFO. Blow the balloons to rise in the air and pass over the obstacles. Hide from the Eagle but let the Woodpecker help you. Your little friend will even appear at gunpoint of Hunter Hamster! You see, there's so much to do on this level!
Where's my water? It's just under the bridges and taking away the gift. Don't let it do that. Play that level again till you get the snail through!
CHAPTER 3. THE NILE MILE
The third chapter of this interactive fun will take you and your new friend, Bob, to ancient Egypt without a drop of water! There are so many obstructions to go through here! The Egyptian ants will block your way; the light will go off and leave you in darkness at some points. You'll need to hide from the sandstorm and escape from Anubis.
However, Egyptian frogs, the flying carpet, and Genie from the lamp will help you. The old mummy magician snail is the last to fight. Use his power against him and complete the chapter with a victory!
OFFLINE GAMES
Feeling ready for new adventures in these offline games? Then download the Snail Bob, tap Run Game, and enjoy level games for free! If you prefer free games without wifi or internet Super Bob is a wonderful choice! It promises such warm emotions for players! On the short way of the turtle the Snail game, players will feel kindness toward the small mollusk and will find it one of the best entertainment games! 
A LONG-AWAITED FREE VERSION
From Hunter Hamster Studio, the creators of remarkable series of games including Snail Bob: Love Story, Forest and Space Story, Island Story, Egypt Story, Winter and Fantasy Story, we are happy to present to your judgment the highly anticipated iOS version. Snail Bob is among the most enticing interactive story games! Yet, you needn't be a skilled player to enjoy the Bob pop free games. Your snail ride will be pleasant in any case!
SUPPORT
If you have faced any difficulties or simply want to leave feedback, please, message on snailbob.help@gmail.com
_____________________________________

WATCH US: youtube.com/herocraft

bluejetty:00155888:ios.description:
Henrico FCU Digital Banking is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Henrico FCU Digital Banking:
 - Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
 - Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 - Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 - Transfer money between your accounts
 - Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 - Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 - View and save your monthly statements
 - Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Henrico FCU Digital Banking app, you must be enrolled as a Henrico FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00096375:ios.description:
Inkvasion is a blocky 3D strategy-building game that fuses RTS, simulation, and tower defense (TD).
Take charge as your town’s leader—explore more tiles, arrange resources, rally troops, and set clever defenses. When night falls, waves of corrupted ink-born creatures rise from the darkness. Outsmart them with cunning tactics and stand firm—are you ready to protect them?
Strategy at Its Core
At its core, Inkvasion is both a strategy and town-building simulator—resource management, real-time strategies, and tactical planning shape every battle. Will you mine and farm to grow a stable economy, or rally your forces for war and conquest? Every clash demands sharp strategy and bold choices—hesitation means defeat.
Distinctive Blocky Adventure
With its unique blocky 3D art style, every construction feels alive. Grow your town, collect resources, and command your forces in an epic adventure filled with humor, challenge, and endless possibilities.
Multiple Game Modes
Conquer campaign stages for fast-paced strategy, test your tactical skills in survival tower defense, or join multiplayer and co-op modes to clash against overwhelming foes. From casual skirmishes to epic battles, there’s always a challenge to push your strategy further.
Ever-Changing Battlefields
Dynamic terrain, shifting weather, and random events ensure no two battles are the same. Train and grow your town by day, then stand firm against relentless nighttime waves. Face powerful bosses and elite enemies in defenses that turn every clash into a new adventure.
Multiplayer Fun & Co-op Survival
Team up with friends in co-op to defend your town from massive ink waves, or compete for supremacy on the leaderboards. Farm, grow, and protect your town together—or raid each other’s resources in playful rivalry. Strategy, teamwork, and laughter collide here.
The battle begins now. Grow your town, command your forces, and defend it—only true strategy can withstand the ink tide!

bluejetty:00023803:ios.description:
Finally, an app that understands YOUR kidney disease.
Managing a kidney diet is overwhelming. Every food label feels like a puzzle. Generic nutrition apps don't understand phosphorus additives, potassium limits, or why your dietary needs are completely different from someone at a different CKD stage.
KidneyPal changes everything.
PERSONALIZED TO YOUR CONDITION
Tell us your kidney condition—CKD stage, dialysis status, kidney stones—and KidneyPal sets personalized daily limits for sodium, potassium, phosphorus, and protein tailored specifically to you.
AI-POWERED FOOD SCANNING
Snap a photo of any meal or nutrition label. Our AI instantly analyzes it and gives you a kidney safety score based on YOUR limits—including hidden phosphorus additives that other apps miss. Get smart swap suggestions to make any meal safer, and chat with the AI to ask questions about what you just scanned.
LOG MEALS YOUR WAY
Scan photos, use voice or text quick-logging, browse our recipe library, or enter nutrients manually. Every method automatically tracks fluids too. No more juggling multiple apps.
KIDNEY-SAFE RECIPE LIBRARY
Browse delicious recipes with kidney safety scores and complete nutritional breakdowns. Each recipe shows exactly why it's safe for your kidneys, with ingredient-level guidance. Have questions? Chat directly with any recipe to get instant, personalized answers.
IMPORT ANY RECIPE
Found a recipe online you want to try? Just paste the URL and KidneyPal instantly analyzes it for your kidney diet — giving you a safety score and complete nutritional breakdown before you cook.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Track nutrient trends over time with beautiful charts. See your good days vs. bad days at a glance. Build streaks to stay motivated. When it's time for your doctor visit, export a complete report to share with your care team.
BUILT FOR REAL PEOPLE
Whether you're newly diagnosed with CKD, managing advanced kidney disease, on dialysis, or preventing kidney stones—KidneyPal meets you where you are.
---
Download free and finally feel confident about what you're eating.
Disclaimer: KidneyPal is for informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your doctor or dietitian before making dietary changes.
Questions? support@kidneypal.app
Privacy: https://kidneypal.app/privacy
Terms: https://kidneypal.app/terms

bluejetty:00120011:ios.description:
Enjoy total creative freedom over your next DIY project with Cricut Design Space™. Design, cut, or draw by connecting to Cricut Explore™ or Cricut Maker™ machines.
Start your project from scratch or browse thousands of images, ready-to-make projects, and unique fonts in the Cricut Image Library. 
Create from anywhere, any time inspiration sparks with cloud-based syncing across devices.
Make the most of every last scrap with the SnapMat™ feature.
Connect to your compatible Cricut cutting machine with a Bluetooth® connection.
Experience brand-new features like kerning, spell check, right-to-left text & more by upgrading your device to iOS 14 or above.
New to Cricut? Welcome! To use this companion Design Space app, first activate your new machine at cricut.com/setup
Existing members with Cricut Joy™ machines? For fun or functional projects in 15 minutes or less, use the companion Cricut Joy™ app. 
Features:
• Over 50,000 FREE images, fonts & projects
• Upload & edit your own compatible image files (jpg, .bmp, .png, .gif, .svg, and .dxf)
• Browse Cricut fonts or use your own system fonts
• Cut predesigned Make It Now projects quickly & easily
• Make cards, invitations, 3D models & more
• Design home & party decor, jewelry, and fashion accessories
• Get perfect cut settings for your material type
• Visualize & position artwork on scrap material with SnapMat™ feature
• Access images & projects and make purchases on cricut.com or Design Space with Cricut ID. 
• Setup & activate machine right from app
• Bluetooth® capability (Bluetooth adapter may be required, sold separately)
• Easily position, resize & rotate text
• Kerning for fonts
• Follow step-by-step project instructions 
• Ready-to-make mug designs 
• Auto-save projects
Cricut Access:

Welcome to the brand new bubble shooter free game - Bubble Shooter Kingdom! Shoot & pop bubbles, decorate the castle, and design the most amazing kingdom ever!
Play the new and addictive bubble pop offline game for free! A combination of bubble shooter plus home design gameplay will bring you more fun than ever! Unlike those classic bubble pop games, there is a castle ready for its makeover in Bubble Shooter Kingdom. So, what you need to do is not only to pop all bubbles and save cute animals, but also to renovate and decorate your home! Collect rewards for completing rooms, keep solving challenging puzzles, and restore the old kingdom to its former glory!

• Unique Gameplay. Match 3 bubbles to pop them, renovate and decorate your home, and give it a new look!

• Special Events. Join regular events and earn lots of treasures!

Are you a chess enthusiast looking to improve your skills and play against players worldwide? Look no further than Chess Universe+! Our app is the ultimate destination for chess players of all levels, providing a fun and engaging environment to learn and play chess.
With Chess Universe+, you'll have access to a vast library of tutorials, lessons, and interactive challenges designed to help you master the game of chess. From beginners learning the basics to advanced players honing their skills, Chess Universe+ has something for everyone.
But that's not all! Chess Universe+ also connects you to a community of chess players worldwide, allowing you to play against opponents from different countries and improve your skills. Whether you're looking for a casual match or a challenging competition, you'll find it all in Chess Universe+.
In addition to its comprehensive chess-playing features, Chess Universe+ also includes a fun and unique reward system. By winning games and completing challenges, you can unlock special chests that contain pets and character customization items. With a wide variety of pets to collect, from cute and cuddly to fierce, you can show off your personality and add a flair to your chess experience. And with a wide range of customization options, you can personalize your avatar and make your mark on the chess world.
Our virtual chessboard is easy to use and intuitive, with beautiful graphics and realistic sound effects that make every game an immersive experience. And with support for different time controls and ratings, you can find opponents that match your preferred style of play.
So what are you waiting for? Join Chess Universe+ today and start your journey to becoming a master chess player! 
Support
Are you having problems? Send us a message through support@chess-universe.net

myMentalPal turns ideas from bestselling nonfiction books into guided practices for a calmer mind. Each Growth Meditation combines a useful book idea with breathing and guided reflection, hel
bluejetty:00042612:ios.description:
GUIDED MEDITATION INSPIRED BY BESTSELLING BOOKS
myMentalPal turns ideas from bestselling nonfiction books into guided practices for a calmer mind. Each Growth Meditation combines a useful book idea with breathing and guided reflection, helping you explore how it applies to your thoughts, habits and daily life. Follow book-inspired paths focused on calm, stress relief and personal growth.
LEARN MEDITATION SKILLS
Develop skills such as breath focus, body scan, visualization and loving-kindness. Guided practices help you build awareness, improve concentration and become more familiar with your thoughts and feelings. Explore techniques that support relaxation and a regular mindfulness practice.
REDUCE ANXIETY & STRESS
Explore guided meditations and breathing exercises designed to help you calm your mind, ease anxiety and release tension. Practice returning your attention to the present and develop a calmer response to stress. Book-inspired sessions introduce useful perspectives on acceptance, worry and self-compassion.
SLEEP BETTER WITH GUIDED RELAXATION
Prepare for restful sleep with sleep meditations, body scans and Yoga Nidra. Follow guided breathing and relaxation practices that help you settle your mind, relax your body and build a regular bedtime routine.
BUILD YOUR DAILY PRACTICE
Follow a book-inspired meditation path or choose guided practices for calm, focus and sleep. Set aside 15 minutes for a Growth Meditation and track your progress with streaks, milestones and rewards. Stay motivated with friends as you build your meditation habit.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Book-inspired Growth Meditation paths
- Guided meditations for anxiety relief, stress, focus and relaxation
- Breathing exercises and mindfulness practices
- Sleep meditations, body scans and Yoga Nidra
- Meditation skills including breath focus, visualization and loving-kindness
- Streaks, milestones, rewards and friend streaks
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Try myMentalPal Pro free for 7 days. Get unlimited access to Growth Meditations and features designed to help you build a daily practice.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or when your free trial ends, as applicable. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Questions or feedback? nima@mymentalpal.com
Privacy Policy: https://mymentalpal.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://mymentalpal.com/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00100663:ios.name: hh2 AP Payments
bluejetty:00100663:ios.summary:
The only workflow you will need for invoices and credit cards. hh2 AP Payments.
Take control of your invoices, credit card expenses, reimbursements and your purchasing workflow with hh2 AP Payments. With tools that let you capture and code
bluejetty:00100663:ios.description:
The only workflow you will need for invoices and credit cards. hh2 AP Payments.
Take control of your invoices, credit card expenses, reimbursements and your purchasing workflow with hh2 AP Payments. With tools that let you capture and code invoices and credit card transactions, intuitive reimbursement workflows and a multitude of approval options, AP routing and approving never flowed so smoothly. All combined with expert accounting integration.
Intuitive Invoice Coding and Approval
Apps for smartphones and tablets, along with a fully-featured website, makes the process extremely mobile friendly.
Bring in invoices through email, over your network or directly over your mobile device.
Code the invoice to a job, commitment, commitment item, cost code, category, expense account, AP account or tax group.
Distribute the cost between multiple jobs or coding practices.
How it works:
Bring your invoices into hh2 AP Payments with intuitive ways that won’t interrupt your day-to-day business activities. Email capture will take in PDFs from monitored email accounts and import them straight into our system. Network capture allows you to setup a folder on your network that will bring over all documents submitted to them. Mobile capture will take documents that have been scanned in using native mobile apps and deliver them to the hh2 AP Payments app.
Invoices that are brought into the system can easily be assigned an approval path. The approval paths can be based on a job, a group, manually submitted or you can create custom approval paths to suit your approval needs.
Once the invoice has reached the final approval, it will automatically sync back into your accounting system.
Credit Card & Reimbursement Transaction Coding
Your employees can capture photos of their receipts and code them on their smartphone or tablet at the time of purchase. Most receipts will automatically associate with the credit card invoices when they are imported into AP Payments. If your receipt does not tie to its associated invoice, take advantage of our easy-to-learn tools for manually linking your documents. Take the hassle out of credit card transactions and reimbursements with elegant coding and tracking features that AP Payments brings to your accounting processes.
Revolutionary Credit Card Receipt and Reimbursement Approval and Routing
Capture photos of the receipt at the time of purchase, eliminating the need to keep the receipt.
Easily code the receipt to a job, cost code, category, commitment, commitment item or account.
Distribute the cost between multiple jobs or coding practices.
Reimbursements are coded similar to receipts and can go through the same approval paths or can be setup to their own approval path.
How it works:
Your employees will be able to take photos of their receipts at the time of purchase. They can code them to jobs, cost codes, commitments, commitment items, categories or accounts. They also will be able to place a comment for the receipt if needed.
Your on-staff accountant imports the credit card expenses into AP Payments, and each expense will create an invoice that is automatically routed to the credit card holder. The invoices will automatically connect to the receipt if the date and expense match up with each other. Some receipts may not link due to the date or the amount entered for the receipt being incorrect. The user can easily associate these receipts with the invoices in a simple process.
Once each invoice and receipt are linked and coded correctly, the credit card user approves the invoice and it is routed, by default, back to the on-staff accountant for their approval. You can give your users the ability to manually route the invoice to another person, such as a project manager, as well. The invoice is then brought back into the accounting system once the accountant gives the final approval.

The invoices will automatically connect to the receipt if the date and expense match up with each other. Some receipts may not link due to the date or the amount entered for the receipt being incorrect. The user can easily associate these receipts with the invoices in a simple process.
Once each invoice and receipt are linked and coded correctly, the credit card user approves the invoice and it is routed, by default, back to the on-staff accountant for their approval. You can give your users the ability to manually route the invoice to another person, such as a project manager, as well. The invoice is then brought back into the accounting system once the accountant gives the final approval.

bluejetty:00153605:ios.description:
PROBLEM SOLVED: Turn that drawer full of forgotten plastic gift cards into digital cash. Tired of losing track of your gift card balances and expiry dates? Wish you had all your shopping vouchers, store coupons, and digital gift codes neatly organized and ready when you are at the register?
Look no further! Gift Card Balance Checker is your ultimate, all-in-one digital wallet designed to manage, track, and secure every gift card, voucher, pass, and promo coupon you own. Stop letting free money expire and start tracking your balances like a pro.
ONE-TAP OFFICIAL BALANCE LOOKUP
No more searching the web or typing long URLs to check what’s left on a card. Our smart lookup feature connects you directly to the official merchant balance-check pages for hundreds of top global and regional brands.
Supported major brands include:
Retail & Grocery: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Home Depot, Lowe's, Costco, Sam's Club, Best Buy, eBay, Macy's, IKEA, Nordstrom, TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Lidl, Aldi, Albert Heijn, Carrefour, REWE.
Coffee & Dining: Starbucks, Dunkin', McDonald's, Subway, Chipotle, Domino's, Pizza Hut, Panera Bread, Tim Hortons.
Gaming & Entertainment: Apple, iTunes, App Store, Google Play, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Steam, Roblox, Fortnite, Epic Games, Netflix, Spotify, Hulu, Disney.
Fashion & Beauty: Sephora, Ulta, Nike, H&M, Zara, Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic, Zalando, Primark, Next, Marks & Spencer.
Prepaid Cards: Visa, Mastercard, American Express (Amex).
WHY YOU’LL LOVE GIFT CARD BALANCE CHECKER:
EFFORTLESS GIFT CARD ORGANIZER
Add all your physical and digital gift cards into one clean, intuitive interface. See your entire collection at a glance and clear the plastic clutter from your physical wallet.
TRACK BALANCES & DETAILS
Keep a digital ledger of your funds. Record card names, card numbers, secure PINs, and manually update your current balances every time you shop. Always know your exact purchasing power before you reach the checkout line.
SMART EXPIRATION REMINDERS
Never let another voucher or promo code go to waste. Set custom push notification alerts for expiring cards anywhere from 1 to 30 days before they run out.
FAST CHECKOUT ACCESSIBILITY
Store high-quality images of your physical cards and their barcodes. Need a PIN or card number at the register? Just open the app and tap to copy it instantly. The cashier can scan your screen directly—no more fumbling through emails or bags.
SEAMLESS CAM-SCAN ENTRY
Easily import vouchers. Snap a quick photo using your device’s camera or upload screenshots directly from your photo library for instant integration.
100% PRIVATE & SECURE
Your financial data belongs to you. All your sensitive card numbers, images, and PINs are stored locally on your device. We do not store your data on external servers, ensuring complete privacy.
STOP WASTING FORGOTTEN MONEY
Whether you are tracking a Vanilla Visa, an Amazon gift code, or local store coupons, Gift Card Wallet is built to save you money, time, and hassle. Say goodbye to expired balances and hello to stress-free shopping.
Privacy Policy: https://www.jojo-apps.com/gift-card-wallet-privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00068985:ios.description:
Award Winning Weight Tracker App developed as a tool mainly to help motivate a person following a diet and/or exercise program to reach their desired target weight within a predefined period. 
* Best App developed in Kuwait - Annual Informatics Awards *
* Winner of 7th Annual Best App Ever Awards under Health Category *
As the name indicates, you will be able to enter your weight on a regular basis and monitor your progress accordingly through means of statistics and graphs. You may also enter and track multiple profiles as well - monitor the progress of your family members, spouse, friends, colleagues - or simply create more than 1 profile for yourself to set partial targets until you reach your ultimate goal.
This app will also suggest your ideal weight and recommend the amount of time needed to reach that target based on your current weight, height, body frame, gender and age. You may, of course, choose to alter the suggested targets based on your own plans.
Main Features:
- Tracks single or multiple profiles
- Track various Body Measurements in addition to weight
- Option to synchronize your data between multiple devices or backup to our server
- Measurements may be represented in Kilos, Pounds, Stones, Meters or Feet
- Calculates ideal weight based on age, height, gender and body frame
- Full screen graph that shows your overall weight loss progress over time
- BMI (Body Mass Index) calculated
- Calculates daily calorie intake
- Calculates percentage body fat
- Total Weight Loss calculated
- Remaining amount of weight calculated
- Average Daily Loss calculated
- Average Weekly Loss calculated
- Overall progress calculated
- Possibility to enter new weights at earlier dates
- Displays an indicator to show the quality of your daily progress
- PIN lock to secure your privacy
- Show the remaining weight on the App Icon
- Multiple Language localisation supporting over 15 languages
- Possibility to export all your recorded data
- Integration with Digital scales: Garmin, Withings, Aria, WiT
- Integration with HealthKit to share data with Apple Health app

bluejetty:00165305:ios.name: Am I Secure? Forensic Scan
bluejetty:00165305:ios.summary: Am I Secure? performs forensic analysis of your iPhone or iPad to find signs of compromise. If you are a journalist, activist, executive, lawyer, government official or anyone with reason to think you may be of interest to a sophisticated a
bluejetty:00165305:ios.description:
Am I Secure? performs forensic analysis of your iPhone or iPad to find signs of compromise. If you are a journalist, activist, executive, lawyer, government official or anyone with reason to think you may be of interest to a sophisticated adversary, this app is built for you. The same applies if you hold digital assets in self-custody. The device holding your keys is the target, and that device is what Am I Secure? examines.
WHAT A COMPROMISED DEVICE MEANS
Your whole life is on your phone. Private messages, email, photos, contacts, financial information. If you can read it, so can someone who has compromised the device. Encryption protects your messages in transit; it does not protect anything once the device itself is under someone else's control. An attacker in that position can read your messages before they are encrypted and after they are decrypted, see your location, take your stored credentials, and reach any account you are signed in to. They can listen through the microphone to conversations in the room, record through the camera, and follow your movements. There is generally no way to tell from using the device.
WHY THIS REQUIRES A DIFFERENT APPROACH
iOS is among the most secure consumer platforms available. iOS does not let any app, including security apps, look outside its own container or "sandbox". No security app on your device can inspect the processes, the filesystem, or the behavior of the rest of the system. That is a deliberate security property of the platform, and it is why an app running on your phone can only report on your settings, not on what is actually running.
Am I Secure? works differently. You generate a system diagnostic "sysdiagnose" file using the tool built into iOS. That file is produced by the operating system itself, not by us, and it contains a detailed record of processes, logs, and system state. You share that file with the app, which uploads it to our servers. We analyze it and report what we find.
The diagnostic file is end-to-end encrypted on your device before it is uploaded and stays encrypted until it reaches hardware we own and operate in our own facilities in Canada and the European Union (EU). It is not decrypted or accessible by any third party, including intermediary data center and network operators. Once analysis is complete the file is deleted.
A HUMAN REVIEWS ANYTHING UNUSUAL
Where our automated analysis flags something, our team examines the results by hand before anything is reported to you. The same automated analysis pipeline is used by our government clients via our on-premises Private Protection suite.
WE LOOK FOR ANOMALIES, NOT JUST KNOWN INDICATORS
Most detection tools match against published indicators of compromise. The moment those indicators become public, the operators behind commercial surveillance tools change their software to avoid them, and signature matching stops working against the new version. We compare your device against a baseline of expected iOS behavior instead. That can surface anomalies that do not match public indicators.
MEDIA COVERAGE
Reviewed by Forbes cybersecurity contributor Davey Winder in December 2024, who wrote he was "very impressed with the capabilities of this app."
WHAT ELSE THE APP CHECKS, FOR EVERYONE
• Whether your iOS version is current, overall and for your specific device
• Lockdown Mode status 
• Lock screen, passcode, and biometric configuration
• iCloud Private Relay and VPN status
• Whether connections to well-known sites are being intercepted or inspected
• Third-party keyboards installed on the device
• Device integrity 
• Your processor's security features, network details, and diagnostic information
SUBSCRIPTION
The Advanced Security Scan requires a subscription, available as an in-app purchase (monthly or annual).
For the Government & Enterprise Edition, search for Am I Secure? Endpoint Security here on the App Store.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Most detection tools match against published indicators of compromise. The moment those indicators become public, the operators behind commercial surveillance tools change their software to avoid them, and signature matching stops working against the new version. We compare your device against a baseline of expected iOS behavior instead. That can surface anomalies that do not match public indicators.

MEDIA COVERAGE
Reviewed by Forbes cybersecurity contributor Davey Winder in December 2024, who wrote he was "very impressed with the capabilities of this app."

WHAT ELSE THE APP CHECKS, FOR EVERYONE
• Whether your iOS version is current, overall and for your specific device
• Lockdown Mode status 
• Lock screen, passcode, and biometric configuration
• iCloud Private Relay and VPN status
• Whether connections to well-known sites are being intercepted or inspected
• Third-party keyboards installed on the device
• Device integrity 
• Your processor's security features, network details, and diagnostic information

bluejetty:00030301:ios.description:
Take a journey into a dream world and embark on a treasure hunt in Cat Trip! 
This magical world hides countless treasures, and you can become a master treasure hunter. As you progress through the game, you will explore different scenes and meet adorable cats of various shapes and sizes. However, you must first find those hard-to-find target items. This game is far from simple! You need to focus and concentrate, and accurately search for treasures hidden in every scene.

You need to search for small props and treasures in these scenes, and gradually unlock new locations. This game will definitely get you hooked!

-Share treasures with friends: If you have played this game, you can share treasures with your friends and make the game more interactive and engaging.
Cat Trip will stimulate your desire to discover and ability to think, allowing you to experience the special feeling of exploration and adventure. 
Join this wonderful adventure and commence your treasure hunt now!

bluejetty:00081280:ios.description:
Make time for your pelvic floor with guided Kegel exercises for women. Pelvic Gym brings short workouts, clear exercise cues and simple progress tracking together so you can build a routine at your own pace.
START WITH YOUR ROUTINE
Choose your goals, share your exercise experience and set your reminder preferences. Select a comfortable difficulty level to get started.
FOLLOW EACH EXERCISE
Use the workout timer and animated visual cues to follow the contraction, hold and relaxation phases. Optional haptic cues help you follow the rhythm of your session.
CHOOSE YOUR DIFFICULTY
Pick from five levels, from Easy to Master, with clear descriptions and easy-to-recognize icons. Change your level whenever you want.
EXPLORE YOUR EXERCISE LIBRARY
Practice different contraction patterns with exercise guides. Discover a collection of 12 exercises and unlock more as you complete training days and workouts.
SEE YOUR CONSISTENCY
Review completed workouts and training days in your progress history. Keep track of the practice you have put in, one session at a time.
MAKE SPACE FOR PRACTICE
Set workout reminders that fit your schedule and return to a short session when it suits you.
Whether you are starting out or already have a routine, Pelvic Gym helps you keep your Kegel practice organized and easy to follow.
PELVIC GYM PRO

bluejetty:00082757:ios.description:
Maximize your workout routine with our Interval Timer – the ultimate tool for creating personalized timers that cater to your fitness needs. Whether you’re doing circuit training, Tabata, boxing, running, or HIIT, our timer provides full customization options across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch to help you achieve your fitness goals with ease.
◆ FEATURES
◉ Create custom interval timers for any workout
◉ Start your interval timers with just one tap
◉ Apple Watch app with real-time iPhone sync
◉ Live Activities & Dynamic Island support
◉ Home Screen & Lock Screen Widgets
◉ Workout streaks & Apple Health integration
◉ Siri & Shortcuts support for hands-free control
◉ Voice, beep, or silent modes for every workout
◉ Customizable initial countdown
◉ Dedicated Countdown timer & Stopwatch with laps
◉ Full iPad support (Portrait & Landscape)
◉ Supports Dark and Light mode
◉ Works in the background – great with headphones and your music
◆ APPLE WATCH & REAL-TIME SYNC
Control and track your workouts right from your wrist! Start, pause, or reset your interval timers, countdowns, and stopwatch on your Apple Watch with instant two-way sync to your iPhone.
◆ LIVE ACTIVITIES, DYNAMIC ISLAND & WIDGETS
Keep an eye on your active work and rest phases directly from your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island without unlocking your phone, or launch your favorite timers straight from your Home Screen widgets.
◆ WORKOUT STREAKS & APPLE HEALTH
Stay motivated by building your daily workout streak! Completed interval and countdown workouts automatically sync with Apple Health to help you close your rings and track your fitness journey.
◆ SPEAKS | BEEPS | SILENT
Know the resting and training times with loud voice prompts or crisp beep sounds. Don’t want any sounds? Choose silent mode and watch the progress ring on screen with the prevent auto-lock feature enabled.

DIG FOR VICTORY! TRENCHES II wants you to join the fight! Wage a whole new war, as the Russians join the struggle. Fight an epic campaign through an expanded world map that now includes the entire Eastern Front. The Great War has arrived and it’s time to take to the trenches again!

Lead the charge with strategic placement of military units and weapons. Crush your enemies with flamethrowers, cluster bombs, rail guns, and the ultimate World War I vehicle – the tank. 
BATTLE IN MULTIPLE GAME MODES
Dominate your opponents online in Deathmatch, King of the Trench and more – or go solo in a variety of Skirmish modes!
Fight the good fight! Enlist in TRENCHES II now!

bluejetty:00085086:ios.description:
NOUVEAU! Complétez vos heures de formation continue directement dans l'app Inf. de poche.
Réussir l’examen de l’OIIQ, de l’OIIAQ, le NCLEX et vos études en soins infirmiers devient plus facile avec Inf. de poche. Notre app regroupe tout ce qu’il vous faut pour une prépa efficace.
Exercez et mettez à l'épreuve votre jugement clinique, révisez la matière apprise dans vos cours, mémorisez les concepts clés et réactivez vos connaissances en soins infirmiers grâce à des centaines de questions pratiques et de cartes-éclair – au bout de vos doigts, au moment et à l'endroit qui vous conviennent le mieux.
Inf. de poche vous offre la flexibilité d'étudier régulièrement et efficacement, en fractionnant vos sessions d'étude plutôt que de vous contraindre à de longues séances. Que ce soit pendant les temps d'attente, les trajets en transports en commun, les pauses repas ou tout autre instant disponible, vous pouvez tirer le meilleur parti de chaque moment opportun.
--
Les modules disponibles comprennent les suivants:
• Préparation au NCLEX-RN (NNG)
• Préparation à l'examen professionnel de l'OIIQ
• Préparation à l'examen professionnel de l'OIIAQ
• Calculs de dose
• Cartes-éclair
• Et plus encore!
Ajoutez les modules à votre planche, et commencez à vous entraîner!
--
Notre matériel d'apprentissage est conçu pour vous aider à réussir vos études et vos examens, à l’aide de questions pratiques réalistes basées sur les compétences évaluées pendant votre formation et lors de l’examen professionnel.
Que vous soyez étudiant·e ou stagiaire en soins infirmiers/sciences infirmières ou en SASI, CEPI, CEPIA, infirmier·ère ou infirmier·ère auxiliaire, nous sommes là pour vous aider à atteindre les résultats souhaités, à chaque étape de votre parcours.
Rejoignez notre communauté de pros en soins. :)
À votre succès.
--
Pour plus d'informations sur nos conditions d'utilisation et notre engagement en matière de confidentialité, veuillez consulter les liens suivants :
Conditions d'utilisation : https://infdepoche.com/conditions/
Politique de confidentialité : https://infdepoche.com/confidentialite/

bluejetty:00073478:ios.description:
Draw Closer to God in 4 Simple Steps — Start Your Day with Blessed
Looking for a simple, meaningful way to stay connected with God every day? Blessed is your spiritual companion — it guides you into a daily routine of prayer, Scripture, and community in just four simple steps. Whether you're starting your faith journey or seeking deeper connection with God, Blessed makes it easy and personal.
Your Path to Deeper Faith: The 4-Step Blessed Journey
Step 1: Recive Your Personalized Morning Blessing
Each morning, begin with a unique blessing tailored to how you're truly feeling. Whether you’re joyful, anxious, or overwhelmed, you'll receive a matching Bible verse and a prayer designed to speak directly to your heart. It's your immediate, personal connection with God's word, setting a Spirit-led tone for your day.
Step 2: Start Strong with Daily Verse
After your personalized blessing, dive into a Daily Verse and guided prayer to firmly establish your faith for the day. Want to reflect deeper? Share your thoughts in the comments or respond to others’ stories. Pray with brothers and sisters who understand — because faith grows best in a supportive community.
Step 3: End Your Day in Peace with Night Prayer
Before bed, end your day with peace. Receive a fresh evening Scripture and prayer prompt to quiet your mind, restore your heart, and remind you of God’s presence — even in the dark.
Step 4: Connect Through Live Streams
Can’t make it to church? No problem. Join our daily live streams where real pastors share encouragement, answer questions, and lead prayer. It’s like having a church in your pocket — anywhere, anytime.
More Ways Blessed Supports Your Faith
Bible Chat: Have questions about Scripture? Feeling unsure? Ask anything, anytime — and get a Biblical response. Like one user said, “It’s like having my own personal counselor in my pocket.”
Audio Bible: Listen to God’s Word wherever you go. Choose from NIV, KJV, and ESV translations. Play Bible stories, daily devotionals, and meditations to nourish your soul on the move.
Faithful Community: You're never alone. Share your prayer requests. Comment on verses. Celebrate victories with others walking the same road.
Stay On Track: Get daily reminders, track your prayer streak, and see your spiritual growth unfold. Add a beautiful Bible verse widget to your home screen to stay inspired.
Who Is Blessed For?
Whether you're seeking spiritual growth, struggling with anxiety or addiction, or simply looking for deeper connection, Blessed is here for you. Get daily support through personalized prayers, Scripture, and live community. Feel peace, find purpose, and grow closer to God — one day at a time.
Go Premium for Deeper Growth
Curated Audio Plans: Customize your spiritual growth with guided meditation, life remedies, Bible stories, and more. Let God’s word uplift your daily life.
Unlimited Bible Chat: Deepen your faith with unlimited questions and personalized insights. No limits, just growth!
Ad-Free Experience: Stay fully focused on your time with God.
Start for Free. Grow for Life.
Whether you’re struggling, searching, or growing — Blessed helps you walk with God one day at a time.
Download now and discover how simple it can be to stay close to God — every day, in every season.
Subscription Information:
Choose between 1-week or annual auto-renewing subscriptions for unlimited access to Premium features. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at purchase confirmation. Manage or cancel subscriptions anytime via your account settings. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled 24 hours before the period ends. Free trials, if offered, will be forfeited upon subscription.
Experience Blessed today! Download now and start your journey toward a deeper relationship with God!

bluejetty:00063702:ios.description:
We are happy to release the Mathrubhumi Integrated Edition to Malayalees around the world 
Latest Kerala News in Malayalam and English, Politics, Sports News, Movie News, Movie Reviews, Entertainment News, International News, Lifestyle, Malayalam News
With a refreshing new design, the iOS edition of the Mathrubhumi Newspaper now delivers the power of journalism directly to your phone with latest news, regional news, cartoons, videos and photos streamed live 24X7. Read all the news from Kerala's favourite Newspaper now on the move anywhere anytime! 
The new reader-friendly layout allows users to read their favourite news on all smart phones with ease. Mathrubhumi App keeps you updated on the latest Malayalam News and English News from all over the world.
The App consists of various sections such as Latest News, Sections, Districts, Gallery and Other News, containing all news categories covered by the Newspaper. All the news stories are locally stored in your device for off-line viewing as well. The Gallery consists of Daily Cartoons, Kakadrishti - the front page cartoon, Photos and Videos streamed from Mathrubhumi servers and are updated regularly. 
The various news categories covered are Top News, District news feeds from the 14 districts of Kerala, World News, India News, Kerala News, Science and Technology, Movies, Health, News Specials, Travel, Agriculture, NRI News, Books, Women's affairs, Sports, Business etc. 
An easy Bookmark saving option is also provided to the user to save favourite news items on the device. 
All news items, images and videos can be shared with your friends and family through email, social media or by any wireless connectivity option supported by your device.
An App user guide is also provided along with the Application to enable users to navigate the app easily.

bluejetty:00069757:ios.summary:
ACE Money Transfer – Send Money Worldwide
Send money internationally—fast, secure, and stress-free. With ACE Money Transfer, you can send money to over 75 countries with just a few taps. Whether you're supporting family, paying bills abroad
bluejetty:00069757:ios.description:
ACE Money Transfer – Send Money Worldwide
Send money internationally—fast, secure, and stress-free. With ACE Money Transfer, you can send money to over 75 countries with just a few taps. Whether you're supporting family, paying bills abroad, or helping in an emergency, ACE offers the speed, transparency, and reliability you need. ACE is authorised and regulated by the FCA (UK), AUSTRAC (Australia), and FINTRAC (Canada)—so your money is always in safe hands.
Enjoy bank deposit, cash pickup, or mobile wallet transfers with competitive exchange rates and low fees. The ACE app is designed to make global money transfers easy and accessible for everyone, anytime, anywhere.
We’ve upgraded the entire experience for iPhone users—now faster, smoother, and more secure than ever. From signup to delivery, the ACE app is your trusted partner for international money transfers.
What’s New:
Faster Onboarding: Create your account and send your first transfer in minutes.
Social Login: Instantly log in with your Apple ID. (Support for other login options available.) - no need to remember passwords.
Redesigned Interface: Clean, modern design for smooth navigation and easy transactions.
Simplified Verification: Get verified quickly with fewer steps.
Performance Boosts: Faster app performance and quicker access to everything you need.
Why iPhone Users Love ACE Money Transfer:
Real-Time Exchange Rates: Get the best value with live currency updates.
No Hidden Fees: See exactly what your recipient will get before you send.
Flexible Delivery Options: Choose between bank deposit, cash pickup, or mobile wallet depending on your recipient’s location.
Live Transfer Tracking: Stay updated from send to delivery with real-time tracking.
24/7 Customer Support: Multilingual support is always available when you need help.
How It Works:
Download the app from the App Store.
Sign up and verify your identity in a few simple steps.
Select a country, enter the amount, and choose a delivery method.
Pay using your debit/credit card or bank transfer.
Track your transaction in real time and get instant delivery alerts.
Transfers are typically delivered within minutes, with full transparency at every stage. The app uses secure encryption and complies with global financial regulations, so your money is always protected.
Send Money to 75+ Countries
We support money transfers to countries across Asia, Africa, Europe, and beyond—including the Philippines, Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Ghana, Morocco, Nepal, and Sri Lanka. Choose from thousands of payout locations worldwide for cash pickup or direct deposit.
Whether you’re a student, worker, small business owner, or family supporter, ACE Money Transfer gives you an easy, fast, and cost-effective way to move money globally.
Why ACE?
Trusted by millions of users
Compliant with international money transfer regulations
Safe, encrypted, and secure app environment
Great rates and low transfer fees
Exclusive offers, rewards, and seasonal promotions
User-friendly app made for both beginners and regular users
Download ACE Money Transfer now and send money internationally with complete peace of mind. Fast transfers, great rates, and global coverage

bluejetty:00015875:ios.description:
Word to Word®, the original and popular word association game is now on the App Store! Created by fellow word-game-loving people like you. 
Use your knowledge of synonyms, antonyms, crossword puzzle clues and answers, fun trivia facts, idioms, riddles, popular sayings, history, movies, hangman, word search, and more!
GAME HIGHLIGHTS:
* Simple puzzles
* No time limit
* Offline play
* Fun for the whole family
* 1000s of puzzles!
Word to Word®: Fun Brain Games, Offline Puzzle Game spells fun for the whole family. Play with your kids, play with your parents, play with your siblings and friends. The more you have gathered around you, the more you can solve our cool puzzles.
Learn connections you may have forgotten, search for words that are hidden, unscramble letters to find the answer! Teach students euphemisms or etymology. Show your brain power with this fun word and brain game. Play, learn, and teach at your own pace.
SIMPLE PUZZLES
No complicated gameplay, just a simple interface so you won’t have to waste any brain cells or precious time figuring out how to play the game.
NO TIME LIMIT
Our games are made to test your brain, but not rush you. Take as much time as you want. Ask your family! Ask your friends. Ask your enemies! 
OFFLINE PLAY
Once you download our game, you can access all unlocked puzzles anytime you want. Play it on the road, on the plane, on the subway, or on the way to the moon!
FUN FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Word to Word® has a simple set of clues to work so family fun and group play is easy. Enjoy puzzles that stretch back to your childhood memories and nursery rhymes. Feel nostalgic as you go through clues about your favorite cartoon characters, fictional heroes, fantasy books, television shows, and many more!
1000s OF PUZZLES
You can unlock hundreds more puzzles as you complete the free packs.
GAMES INCLUDED:
* Word to Word®
* Spell n Link
* Definitionado®
* 4 Words
* Word Link
* Word to Word Themes
* Word to Word Seasons
Your feedback and suggestions are welcome. We improve and change our puzzles based on great input from fellow wordsmiths like you.
We’ll be adding more kinds of word games soon.
Download and start exercising your brain now!
Privacy Policy - http://www.mochibits.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service - http://www.mochibits.com/terms-of-service
Email us hello@mochibits.com for any questions.

Adventure Academy is the new interactive learning program for kids from the creators of ABCmouse! The Founders of this prestigious school have created one of the world’s largest collections of educational games, books, learning challenges, and more, all designed to help strengthen children’s skills across thousands of key elementary and middle school learning objectives.

Discover and play thousands of learning activities to help boost key skills and abilities across many subjects, including math, language arts, reading, science, social studies, and more 
Share amazing experiences with your best friends in a safe and secure environment 
Play simultaneously with up to three other scholars within the same account on your individual smartphone, tablet, or computer 
Crafted by teachers and early learning education experts with a curriculum-first approach for 2nd-5th grade

Great for homeschoolers and learning on the go

Trusted by teachers and designed by early learning education experts, Adventure Academy provides a safe learning environment for students. Parents can monitor progress, control the level of interaction through filtered chat, or block in-game communication entirely. 
Welcome to Adventure Academy. Your endless adventure awaits!

Rotate your device to hit notes as you soar through the stars. Drop into your headph
bluejetty:00023383:ios.description:
Rotaeno is a heart-pounding, thumb-tapping, wrist-flicking rhythm game that fully utilizes your device's gyroscope for an unprecedented musical experience.
Rotate your device to hit notes as you soar through the stars. Drop into your headphones and immerse yourself in the kick beats and stellar synths of this astronautical adventure!
=A Revolutionary Way to Experience Music=
What sets Rotaeno apart is all in the name - rotation! Building on the basic controls of more traditional rhythm games, Rotaeno includes notes that require smooth turns and rapid rotations to hit, making it feel like you're drifting in a highspeed interstellar stunt race. It's a real arcade experience - in the palm of your hand!
=Multi Genre Music and Beats=
Rotaeno is loaded with exclusive tracks from renowned rhythm game composers. From EDM to JPOP, KPOP to Opera, the stylistically diverse song collection contains a future favorite song for every music lover! More songs are already planned for future updates and will be released on a regular basis.
=A Journey to Find the Promised Land, Love, and Ourselves=
Follow Ilot, our heroine, on a cosmic journey through the stars, and witness her growth as she sets out on her own. Follow in the footsteps of a friend, meet locals on different planets, and save the future of Aquaria!
*Rotaeno will only function properly on devices that feature gyroscope or accelerometer support.
Concerns or feedback? Contact us: rotaeno@xd.com

Whether you train at the gym, at home, or on the go, enjoy access to an on-demand library of 1,000+ workouts, personalized workout programs, classes, the Wellness Magazine, individual and community challenges, and more to stay on track with your goals and boost your performance. 
GET A PERSONALIZED PRECISION PROGRAM

Browse workouts for any goal, muscle group, and level, whether you want self-guided exercises, to work out on equipment with instructor-led classes, do bodyweight workouts at home, or train outdoors. 
CREATE YOUR OWN WORKOUTS 
Decide your own training journey with the workout builder feature, whether your focus is on weightlifting, cardio, or bodyweight exercises. Create, save, and edit your own workouts for specific days, training needs, and goals, and track your progress over time. 
GET WELLNESS TIPS & NEWS

bluejetty:00131193:ios.description:
Meet Readict
Readict is a virtual library of completely addicting novels that will get you reading like never before! Whether you're a romance fanatic, a paranormal enthusiast, or just looking for something fun to do, you'll always find a story to enjoy on Readict.
Readict has many in-app features to cater to your reading preferences. There's a variety of menus and pages to help you find your next book, such as Editor's Choice, Hot Genres, New and Trending, and Popular on Readict. And, in addition to saving your progress in a personal library, once you start reading, the app will suggest more stories based on the titles you've liked. Readict tailors your reading recommendations to your tastes so you can make the most of our large library of fantastic books. Read anytime and anywhere with Readict!
There's something for everyone on Readict! Some of our top stories include:
Not Rejected Just Unwanted
All Raine Andrew wanted was a mate. She wanted a mate to love her and make her feel wanted. And when she turns 17, she gets her mate: soon-to-be-Beta Elijah Woods. He's a great guy. He's loyal to his pack, a straight-A student, and a very hard worker.
He sounds like the perfect mate, right? Raine thought so too, but there's just one problem: He doesn't want her.
Mated to My Bully
Amanda Stevens thought her problems were over when she got to college. No longer the shy, awkward teen she was in high school, Amanda felt this was her chance at making new friends and experiencing life. That was until she found out her high school Bully was attending the same college she was. Hudson Harlow. 
The moment that Hudson Harlow looked into the hazel eyes of Amanda Stevens, his wolf started to howl MATE! Why in the world would the Moon Goddess mate him to a human? But Hudson started to notice that this was no longer the girl that he tormented in High School. She'd changed. 
Hudson, knowing how awfully he treated Amanda in high school, had to now convince her to forgive him and accept him as her mate. 
Not only did Amanda have to deal with Hudson, but she also had to juggle her classes, a new job, and strange animal attacks on campus. All Amanda wanted was a normal college life.
His Broken Luna
Battered, abused, and broken, Sophia Alden is resigned to living the rest of her life as a slave to Alexander, a powerful Alpha who considers her his property and is dangerously obsessed with her. 
But when the Alpha of the most powerful pack comes to claim his true mate, hearts are broken, dangerous enemies are made, and Sophia finds herself thrust into a world of lies, lust, secrets, and desires that threatens to douse her in its burning flame, consuming her entire being.
All of these and more will be at your fingertips. Download Readict today!
Subscription Terms
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renew by going to your iTunes account settings after purchase. You can read our privacy policy at https://cdn.readictnovel.com/default/webpage/readictnovel/privacyPolicy/ios/index.html and our terms of use at https://cdn.readictnovel.com/default/webpage/readictnovel/privacyPolicy/ios/userLicense.html
Readict is committed to our readers and their reading experience. Feel free to reach out to us if you have any questions about or suggestions for Readict at readict@vitaltekinc.com

Turn your ultrasound photo into a baby face
Upload an ultrasound photo and let our baby AI generator create a clear, realistic baby image you can save and share. It is the magical "see your baby before birth" moment, reimagined as an AI keepsake.
Future baby generator from parents

AI maternity photoshoot

- Ultrasound photo to baby image in seconds

1. Upload your ultrasound photo or parents' photos
2. AI analyzes the image automatically
3. Your baby face image appears in seconds

bluejetty:00045511:ios.description:
Welcome to the ACCU Staffing app—your go-to resource for unlocking exciting career opportunities! Designed specifically for job seekers, our app empowers you to take control of your job search and connect with employers looking for talent just like yours. Whether you’re seeking a temporary position, a permanent role, or a career change, ACCU Staffing is here to support you every step of the way.
Key Features:
User-Friendly Job Search: Effortlessly browse a wide array of job listings tailored to your skills and preferences. Filter results by location, job type, industry, and more to find the perfect fit.
Personalized Job Recommendations: Based on your profile and preferences, receive curated job recommendations that align with your career goals. Our intelligent matching system ensures you never miss an opportunity.
Easy Application Process: Apply for jobs directly through the app with just a few taps. Upload your resume and cover letter, and track the status of your applications in real-time.
Professional Profile Creation: Build a standout professional profile to showcase your skills, experience, and achievements. Highlight what makes you unique to attract potential employers and stand out in the job market.
Notifications for New Opportunities: Enable notifications to receive alerts about new job postings that match your interests. Be among the first to apply and increase your chances of landing that dream job!
User Support: Our dedicated support team is here to assist you. Whether you have questions about the app or need help with your job search, we are just a message away. 
Why Choose ACCU Staffing?
At ACCU Staffing, we understand that finding the right job can be challenging. That’s why we’re committed to providing personalized service, industry expertise, and a wealth of resources designed to facilitate your job search. Our mission is to connect you with employers who value your talents and experience, helping you land a position that fulfills your career aspirations.
Join thousands of job seekers who have successfully found employment through ACCU Staffing. Download now and take the first step toward your future career today!
Whether you are a recent graduate, an experienced professional, or someone looking to make a career shift, the ACCU Staffing app is your key to unlocking the door to new possibilities. Your next job is just a tap away—start your journey with us now!

Assemble a squad of your favorite Transformers! Battle your way through the ranks of competitive arenas in this free-to-play* real-time PvP strategy game developed by Red Games Co. Unlock new characters, master their unique abilities, and evolve your strategy to gain a competitive advantage.
