• Real-Time 1v1 Battles: Compete against players worldwide in real-time PvP strategy games.
• Collect and Upgrade Transformers: Collect and level up your favorite characters and master their unique abilities.
• Customize Your Gameplay: Unlock new cards, structures, and tactical support to evolve your play style and turn the tide of battle.
• Daily and Weekly Challenges: Earn rewards and stockpile advantages with daily and weekly challenges.
• Battle through competitive arenas, including Cybertron, Chaar, Jungle Planet, Arctic Outpost, Sea of Rust, Orbital Arena, Pit of Judgement, Velocitron, Prehistoric Earth, and more! 
Build and evolve the ultimate team, including all of your favorite Transformers: Optimus Prime, Megatron, Bumblebee, Optimal Optimus, Airazor, Cheetor, Starscream, Grimlock, Bonecrusher, Blurr, Mirage, Wheeljack, and more! 
Implement unstoppable tactical support strategies with Neutron Bombs, Ion Beams, Proximity Minefields, Orbital Strikes, Drop Shields, E.M.P., T.R.S., Gravitron Nexus Bombs, Healing Pulse, Stun, Sidewinder Strike, and others.
Drop powerful structures into battle like the Plasma Cannon, Laser Defense Turret, Fusion Beam Turret, Inferno Cannon, Railgun, Plasma Launcher, Sentinel Guard Drone, Trooper and Minion Portals, and more.
Limited-Time Events
Events give players an opportunity to earn special items through fast-paced, limited-time gameplay. In the Weekly Turret Challenge, players set out to destroy enemy turrets in ranked battles to earn rewards. Win as many battles as you can over ten matches in the Weekly Collector event, and earn a different character each week!

bluejetty:00123859:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00123859:ios.description:
********************
This grand adventure, unfolding over three generations, is now available to play in the palm of your hand!
Take your place among a family of heroes, sharing in all the triumphs and tragedies of their storied lives!
Enjoy three generations’ worth of adventure in one standalone package!
There will be a fee to download the game but download it once, and there’s nothing else to buy, and nothing else to download!
*In-game text is available in English only.
********************
◆Prologue
Our hero begins the story as a small boy, travelling the world with his father, Pankraz.
Over the course of his many adventures, this lovable lad learns and grows.
And when he finally becomes a man, he resolves to continue his father’s unfinished quest—to find the Legendary Hero...
This thrilling tale on a stunning scale can now be enjoyed on pocket-sized devices!
◆Game Feature
・Make Friends with Mighty Monsters!
The fearsome monsters you face in battle can now become your friends, giving you access to unique spells and abilities—and a whole host of strategic possibilities!
・Converse Freely with your Fellow Party Members!
The party chat function allows you to converse freely with the cast of colourful characters who will accompany you on your adventure. So don’t hesitate to turn to them for advice and idle chit-chat whenever the urge assails you!
・360-Degree Views
Rotate your viewpoint in towns and villages through a full 360 degrees to make sure you don’t miss a thing!
・AI Battles 
Tired of giving orders? Your faithful companions can be instructed to fight automatically!
Use the various tactics at your disposal to see off even the toughest enemies with ease!
・The Casino
With slot machines, poker, the monster arena and the exciting slime races of the slurpodrome, the casino is sure to provide you with a little light relief when the pressures of adventuring prove too great.
Better still, you can exchange the tokens you earn for all kinds of exciting items, making taking a break well worth your while!
・Treasures ‘n’ Trapdoors
Take dice in hand and roll your way around specially designed game boards, enjoying a whole range of exciting events as you go!
Some of the things you’ll see won’t be available anywhere else, and if you manage to make it to the end, you can win some really great rewards!
・Bruise the Ooze is Back!
Bruise the Ooze, the slime-smashing minigame introduced in the Nintendo DS version, is back with a bang! Tap the slimes within the time limit to earn points in this super-simple yet fiendishly addictive goo-splatting extravaganza!
・Simple, Intuitive Controls
The game’s controls are designed to work perfectly with the vertical layout of any modern mobile device, and the position of the movement button can be changed to facilitate both one- and two-handed play.
・Experience the legendary RPG loved by millions in Japan and worldwide! Created by a legendary trio with the master creator Yuji Horii, the revolutionary synthesizer score and orchestration by Koichi Sugiyama, and art by master manga artist Akira Toriyama (Dragon Ball). 
--------------------
[Supported Operating Systems]
iOS11.0 and above.
[Supported Devices]
iPhone 5S/iPod touch (6th Generation)/iPad (5th Generation) and above.

bluejetty:00174423:ios.summary:

Expenses focuses on what matters: tracking your money simply and privately. Log expenses and income in any currency, scan receipts to enter details faster, organize spending by category and merchant, and u
bluejetty:00174423:ios.description:
Track your spending with Expenses
Expenses focuses on what matters: tracking your money simply and privately. Log expenses and income in any currency, scan receipts to enter details faster, organize spending by category and merchant, and understand your habits with intuitive stats and spending trends. With iCloud, your data stays in sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. You can also share a sheet with others to manage expenses together seamlessly.
• Featured by Apple on the App Store
• Used by people in 100+ countries
Start effortlessly
There is no learning curve and no account to create. Just open the app and start adding your expenses or income in seconds. When you travel, you can add expenses in different currencies. Exchange rates update automatically for major currencies, and you can set custom rates whenever you need.
Scan receipts faster
Capture receipts and turn them into expense entries with less manual typing. Expenses helps you keep accurate records while staying focused on your spending, not data entry.
Organize with categories and merchants
Create and customize categories that fit your life, then track where your money goes by merchant. Whether you want to review grocery trips, subscriptions, restaurants, or travel costs, merchant support makes your spending easier to understand.
Discover where your money really goes
See the bigger picture with visual trends over time and detailed breakdowns by category and merchant. Turn your spending data into actionable insights that help you make smarter financial decisions.
Share and collaborate
Planning a trip? Managing a household? Invite others to share a sheet and track expenses together in real time.
Privacy built in
Expenses is private by design. No sign-ups and no personal data collection. Your information stays on your device or in iCloud, always under your control.
Import and export your data
You can export your expenses as a CSV file anytime for backup or further analysis. Expenses also supports importing existing data from CSV, making it easy to migrate from other tools or bring in previous records.
Designed for everyone
Expenses works beautifully on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro with:
• Dark Mode for comfortable viewing
• Widgets for quick expense entry
• Shortcuts automation support
• Full accessibility features
• Instant sync across all your devices
Download Expenses today and see where your money goes.
Terms and Conditions: https://bluecometlabs.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://bluecometlabs.com/privacy/
Contact: https://expenses.cash/contact/

bluejetty:00165652:ios.description:
Ultrahuman helps you measure your health performance by creating a unified dashboard of your health. Using metrics from the Ultrahuman Ring, such as Sleep, Activity, Heart Rate (HR), Heart Rate Variability (HRV), Skin Temperature, and SPO2, we generate actionable scores for sleep quality, physical activity, recovery, and cardiovascular health. This empowers you to decode and effectively improve your health and lifestyle. Additionally, Ultrahuman integrates with continuous glucose monitors, helping you track your glucose control and overall metabolic health in real-time through a daily Metabolic Score.
**World-class product design & unmatched comfort**
Awarded the renowned Red Dot Design Award, the Ultrahuman introduces the Ring AIR— the world’s lightest smart ring. It's not just a statement of style, it's your all-in-one health tracker.
**Key features**
1. Health monitoring with elegance
Monitor your sleep, movement, and recovery with the compact and comfortable Ultrahuman smart ring.
2. Innovation in movement
Introducing the Movement Index, which redefines moving for better health by tracking steps, frequency of movement, and calorie burn.
3. Sleep decoded
Dive deep into your sleep performance with our Sleep Index, analysing sleep stages, nap tracking, and SPO2.
4. Recovery—on your terms
Navigate through stress by understanding your body's response with metrics like heart rate variability, skin temperature, and resting heart rate.
5. Harmonised circadian rhythms
Align with your circadian clock to enhance energy levels and productivity throughout the day.
6. Smart stimulant use
Optimise your stimulant consumption with dynamic windows that aid adenosine clearance and minimise sleep disruption.
7. Real-time fitness tracking
Engage with your workouts through live HR, HR zones, calories, and a running map.
8. Group tracking through Zones
Stay engaged with friends and family through Zones, sharing and viewing sleep, recovery, and movement data seamlessly.
9. Deep metabolic insights
Gain insights into your glucose control and understand the deep-seated impact of food on your body.
**Global availability & seamless integration**
Get your Ring AIR shipped anywhere in the world and enjoy hassle-free data syncing with Apple Health, keeping all your essential health information centralised and accessible.
**Contact info**
For any queries or support, please reach out to us at [support@ultrahuman.com]. We are glad to help you.

Ultrahuman provides products and services designed for general fitness and wellness purposes. Ultrahuman's products and services are not intended to treat or diagnose any disease, and should not be any substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

The products and services are not intended for disease management, treatment, or prevention, and should not be relied upon for any diagnostic or treatment decision. We do not intend to substitute professional medical opinion on the treatment, diagnosis, prevention or alleviation of diabetes or any other disease or disability. Always consult with a doctor or qualified healthcare professional about any health condition and/or concerns, that you may have. Please do not disregard/delay seeking professional medical advice or treatment because of information read on or accessed through our products and services. Please work with your healthcare professional during the use of the third-party continuous glucose monitoring device (CGM) if you have a health condition. Abbott's CGM sensor has regulatory clearance in select countries, including but not limited to India, UAE, US, UK, EU, Iceland, and Switzerland.

FACT-CHECK ISLAMIC VIDE
bluejetty:00145626:ios.description:
The AI built for Muslims.
Daleel helps you check what you hear about Islam. Ask a question, share a video link or just speak, and get an answer with its daleel: the ayah or hadith, the exact source and its grading.
FACT-CHECK ISLAMIC VIDEOS
Saw a hadith in a reel or a TikTok? Share the link with Daleel. It finds the claim in the video and checks it against the Quran and authentic hadith, so you know if it's sahih, weak or fabricated before you share it.
CHAT IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Type or use your voice in English, Arabic or French. Daleel answers clearly and shows the full reference, like Sahih al-Bukhari 6114, with the Arabic text and translation.
TRAINED ON REAL SOURCES
The full Quran: all 114 surahs, every ayah
40,000+ hadith from Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Jami' at-Tirmidhi, Sunan Abu Dawud, Sunan an-Nasa'i and Sunan Ibn Majah
8,000+ scholarly works from Al-Maktaba al-Shamela and Dorar
Every answer cites its source, so you can always check it yourself.
AYAHS FOR HOW YOU FEEL
Tell Daleel how you're feeling and its AI finds the ayah your heart needs. Anxious, sad, grateful or hopeful, there's a verse for every feeling.
QURAN LOCK
Trade the scroll for Quran. Pick the apps that distract you, like Instagram or TikTok, and Daleel locks them until you read Quran for 30 seconds. Quran Lock uses Apple's Screen Time framework, and your Screen Time data never leaves your device.
A SAHIH HADITH EVERY DAY
Start each morning with an authentic hadith on your lock screen.
ALSO INCLUDED
Quran verse finder: type any phrase in Arabic or English to find the surah and ayah
Favorites: save the hadith and ayahs you want to come back to
Complete hadith collections in Arabic with translations
SUBSCRIPTION
Daleel requires an active subscription to access its features. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

Support: https://daleel.app/contact

bluejetty:00022009:ios.summary:
Mural Maker by Da Vinci Eye is the ultimate app for artists who want to create massive drawings and paintings on various surfaces including walls, canvases, sidewalks, buildings, streets, signs, chalkboards, and even rugs.
Compatibility
B
bluejetty:00022009:ios.description:
Mural Maker by Da Vinci Eye is the ultimate app for artists who want to create massive drawings and paintings on various surfaces including walls, canvases, sidewalks, buildings, streets, signs, chalkboards, and even rugs.
Compatibility
Before you read any further, note that to use Mural Maker, artists will need two iOS devices: one to function as a video camera and the other to display the live video feed in their hand. The app works with any combination of iPads and iPhones.
Customer Support
If you have any trouble setting up Mural Maker, we offer complimentary concierge customer service and will even video chat with you to help you with your project.
Why is Mural Maker better than a Projector and Grids?
Mural Maker offers several advantages over traditional art projectors and time-consuming grids/doodle grids. Unlike projectors, which can be bulky and require a dark room and a power cord, Mural Maker functions perfectly well outdoors, in bright daylight, away from power outlets, and doesn't even need Wi-Fi. Plus, the app allows artists to accurately compare colors and shades on their canvas to the reference image, making it easier to create more precise and accurate artwork... something that no grid or projector will ever be able to do.
In addition to simply tracing, Mural Maker offers a suite of tools and features such as...
Breakdown Mode
Enables artists to break down their image into stencils by color value. Artists can then print out a color palette, allowing them to mix their paints to the exact colors they need before they begin. The app then shows artists where to paint each color with augmented reality stencils.
Multiplayer mode
Multiple people can paint at the same time as the camera device can stream to multiple drawing devices. This makes it a perfect tool for group projects, workshops, and community mural painting events.
AR Tracking
Artists can get back to work in seconds instead of trying to re-align their overlay image back with their work. Mural Maker remembers their project's exact position, making it super easy for artists to work on their mural over multiple days.
Second Set of Eyes
Mural Maker is also your second set of eyes for any project. It allows artists to stand up close next to their giant artwork while simultaneously letting them look at it from far away.
Key Feature Recap:
- Requires two iOS devices to use
- AR Tracking feature remembers the project's exact position, making it easy to get back to work or re-set up the drawing.
- Breakdown feature enables artists to break down their image into different colors and print out a color palette
- Multiplayer mode allows multiple people to paint at the same time
- Functions well outdoors and in daylight
- Enables artists to create artwork of any size
- Includes the same great tools found in the original Da Vinci Eye app, including Strobe and filters
- Allows artists to record a time-lapse of their artwork
Try Mural Maker by Da Vinci Eye today and see how easy it is to create stunning artwork on any surface, without the hassle of traditional projectors or time-consuming grids!

Dive into the Splashtastic World of Learning with Pinkfong 123 Numbers!
Calling all parents, preschoolers, and curious kids who are ready to embark on an unforgettable educational journey! 
Introducing Pinkfong 123 Numbers – the ultimate number games app crafted by the wizards of education to transform learning into a captivating adventure.

Get ready to witness your little ones giggle with glee as they not only learn how to count 1 to 20 but also master the art of tracing numbers. 
Through a whimsical blend of vibrant animations, interactive fun games, and mesmerizing coloring activities, your kids will be enchanted as they explore the magical world of numbers.

Unleash the power of math with the help of none other than the beloved Baby Shark and Pinkfong! 
Brace yourselves for a sensational medley of catchy tunes and engaging games that not only teach counting but also ignite passion for mathematics for kids. 
It's like a math party where fun and learning dance hand in hand!

Prepare to be amazed as your kids belt out their favorite nursery rhymes alongside Pinkfong's captivating animated videos. 
With Baby Shark leading the way, these enchanting tunes effortlessly weave counting into the fabric of learning. 
Say goodbye to rote memorization and hello to natural number 123 mastery!
TRACE, COLOR, AND CREATE LEARNING MAGIC
Unleash your child's inner artist and watch as they trace and color their way to numerical triumph! 
The adorable animals and delightful numbers will soon become their partners in the fascinating journey of discovering the world of math. 
ALL ABOARD THE NUMBERS TRAIN ADVENTURE!
Join the adorable animal crew as they hop aboard the numbers train. 
Your little conductors will count, color, and feed these cheerful critters while developing an unbreakable bond with numbers 123 games. 
Counting, tracing, and reading – it's all a delightful ride!

bluejetty:00071393:ios.name: Nihongo Lessons
bluejetty:00071393:ios.summary:
A new app for people serious about becoming fluent in Japanese, from the maker of Nihongo: a modern Japanese dictionary.
Nihongo Lessons is based off the excellent Japanese Level Up (Jalup) series, and is made to help all levels of learner
bluejetty:00071393:ios.description:
A new app for people serious about becoming fluent in Japanese, from the maker of Nihongo: a modern Japanese dictionary.
Nihongo Lessons is based off the excellent Japanese Level Up (Jalup) series, and is made to help all levels of learners. 
* If you're a complete beginner, the app starts you off by teaching you to write the Japanese alphabets hiragana and katakana, and then quickly starts building your vocabulary and grammar fundamentals.
* If you're at an intermediate level, you can jump into content that will help you grow your Japanese grammar, vocabulary, and listening skills more efficiently than ever before.
* If you're an advanced learner diving into the world of native content or studying for JLPT N1, Nihongo Lessons can help fill in the gaps in your knowledge with vocabulary and grammar pulled directly from real manga.
Instead of a traditional textbook, everything in Nihongo Lessons is in a flashcard format. Flashcards are easier to take in, easier to know how much to learn and how often to review, and simplify the mountain of information you need to absorb. Each flashcard introduces one new sentence for you to understand, and every new sentence introduces exactly one new word, grammar point, or concept. This keeps you constantly moving forward in your learning journey - never bored, never overwhelmed.
* Learn to write hiragana and katakana, the main alphabets of the Japanese language.
* Progress from beginner to fluent across 7000 handcrafted sentences, each introducing a single new word or concept.
* Listen to sentences spoken out loud by a professional voice actor.
* Advanced Spaced Repetition (SRS) to help you retain everything you've learned for the long-term.
* Nihongo Lessons doesn’t just plop a fun game on top of the language. It engages the brain’s natural urge to solve problems by making learning the language itself the game.

bluejetty:00165460:ios.description:

What you’ll get with Highsnobiety:
Fashion and Culture News
From breaking news alerts to in-depth editorials, Highsnobiety keeps you plugged into the people, brands, and trends shaping the global fashion landscape. Our editors bring daily round-ups, style guides, and expert takes across luxury, streetwear, sneakers, and cultural touchpoints.
Exclusive Content
Go deeper with long-form stories, insider interviews, and cultural analysis you won’t find anywhere else. From emerging voices to legacy houses, we spotlight the ideas and creators moving style forward.
React and Express

Built for the Mobile Experience
Enjoy a fast, distraction-free design optimized for browsing and shopping. Clean, intuitive, and seamless.

Join the app built for those who live and breathe style. Discover what’s next in fashion and get closer to the zeitgeist.
Download the Highsnobiety app today and never miss the latest in style.

bluejetty:00069362:ios.summary: Leverage the power of your smartphone or tablet by turning it in to an amazing handheld controller for your URC® Total Control® 2 home automation system. Right from your mobile device easily control and monitor things such as entertainment,
bluejetty:00069362:ios.description:
Leverage the power of your smartphone or tablet by turning it in to an amazing handheld controller for your URC® Total Control® 2 home automation system. Right from your mobile device easily control and monitor things such as entertainment, lights, security systems, thermostats and more in fast, new ways. Swipe, tap and rotate your way to securely control your equipment! 
This app gives you full control of all the features and full functionality afforded by a Total Control 2 system installation and more from multiple locations! Your main home and your vacation home can all be accessed from within one app. 
This version of URC Mobile requires a Wi-Fi connection to the local area network that is host to the Master Base Station / Central Processor and other system devices. Control is possible within the home or from anywhere in the world where internet or cell phone access is available. 
PLEASE NOTE: An installed Total Control 2 system is required to enjoy and access the features above. A new app installation or reset of the app requires the iOS device to be on-site with the Total Control Base Station. 
For more information please visit: https://www.urc-automation.com

bluejetty:00093869:ios.name: MyKCCU
bluejetty:00093869:ios.summary: MyKCCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empower
bluejetty:00093869:ios.description:
MyKCCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with MyKCCU:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
Transfer money between your accounts.
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
View and save your monthly statements.
Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the MyKCCU app, you must be enrolled as a Kimberly Clark CU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00164983:ios.description:
Stop Motion by Life Lapse lets you create your own stop motion movies and animations at home. 
- Create stunning stop motion animations with ease.
- Download, share, and post to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and other social media.
- 4.8/5 from 35,000+ ratings in the App Store, App of the Day in 2024 and 2021. 
Unleash your creativity with Life Lapse: the ultimate EASY stop motion maker. Craft captivating animations, from mesmerizing stop motion to engaging social media content that will stop the scroll. Download Life Lapse now and experience stop-motion animation like never before. 
Our Features:
~ Stop Motion Camera: Shoot and film in 4K UHD resolution with our ghost overlay and hands-free tools like an interval timer
~ Stop Motion Editor: Life Lapse auto-stitches everything for you, making the stop motion process quick and easy
~ Easy to use + beginning friendly: Intuitive interface for all animators, even a beginner!
~ Stop Motion tutorials: dozens of tutorials to learn different stop motion techniques
~ Blend stop motion with live action from a single shot! Select "Life Lapse" project to shoot truly magical videos by using layers & masking. 
~ Edit stop motion videos in seconds! 20+ Pro editing on-click stop motion tools (freeze, boomerang, reverse, filters and re-align after you've shot & more)
~ Easy to animate perfectly with our ghost/onion skin layer in camera. See your previous photo so you know how to move your animation next.
~ Add music and sound effects: Add and change the music soundtrack and sounds in your video.
~ Filters to make your video look amazing: Add video filters to control how your video looks and feels.
~ Easy to share on Social Media: Easily prepare your videos for Instagram or TikTok using our built-in guidelines.
~ Make your animations looks smooth and professional: Speed controls help make your animations smooth and silky!
~ Download to your phone: Save videos to your phone so you can send them to friends and family. 
Try PRO for Free:
If you want to make more professional animations, experience the best stop-motion tool that is made for video content creators for FREE with a 7-day trial. After the 7 days is up, unless canceled before the 7 days, you will get access to Life Lapse with the annual subscription rate.
Find us on Instagram/TikTok and share your work!
See how others are using Life Lapse on Instagram at @LifeLapse_App or by searching #LifeLapse. We also feature Life Lapse video creators on our Instagram. For a chance to have YOUR stop motion videos featured share your Life Lapse video on Instagram & tag #LifeLapse or @LifeLapse_App.
Send us your Feedback - support@lifelapseapp.com
Have some feedback for us? Suggestions for new features? Or maybe just some questions on how to use the app? We’d love to hear from you! E-mail us at support@lifelapseapp.com with any questions and feedback you have and we’ll answer within 48 hours.

bluejetty:00184660:ios.description:
Join Thomas and his friends on exciting racing adventures! Race as your favorite engine on incredible tracks filled with twisty rollercoasters, splashy waterslides and epic jumps! Play against rival engines or challenge a friend in the 2-player mode! Use speed boosters to help you race your fastest and to upgrade your engines. Full steam ahead!
Fun Train Racing Kids Game Adventures! For Boys, girls and children of all ages! 
READY, SET, GO! 
• RACE as Thomas and his fantastic engines friends: Percy, James, Emily, Toby, Rebecca, Nia, Yong Bao, Spencer and more! 
• PLAY in either “1-Player” or “2-Player” mode to challenge a friend!
• TAP the green button as fast as you can to get going at blazing speed! 
• PERFORM special abilities, such as the Whirly Wind or the Wheelie Surf, to get a speed boost and puff even faster!
• USE the stunts button to flip, twist and barrel roll!
• EXPLORE new exciting race tracks, from the countryside to the castle!
• COMPLETE a full golden cogwheel to evolve your engines’ speed, boost or acceleration!
• BUILD your collection of classic and newcomer engines friends!
RACE TRACKS TO EXPLORE!
• FUNNEL TUNNEL: Race around the windmills and jump over a mountain in the countryside of Sodor!
• DARING DOCKS: Plummet through containers and jump off the biggest ship in Sodor! It’s a pulse pounding race to the finish line!
• FRANTIC FORTRESS: Rocket though tunnels and jump off the stained-glass window inside the castle! This is a real rollercoaster of a race!
• ROARING FALLS: Venture in this majestic mountain in the shape of the Lion of Sodor! Only the most courageous engines race on its tracks! Come make a splash at the Roaring Falls!
PRIVACY & ADVERTISING
Budge Studios™ takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps are compliant with privacy laws. This application has received the “ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board) Privacy Certified Kids’ Privacy Seal”. For more information, please visit our privacy policy at: https://budgestudios.com/en/legal/privacy-policy/, or email our Data Protection Officer at: privacy@budgestudios.ca
Before you download this app, please note that it is free to try, but some content may only be available via in-app purchases. In-app purchases cost real money and are charged to your account. To disable or adjust the ability to make in-app purchases, change your device settings. This app may contain contextual advertising (including the option to watch ads for rewards) from Budge Studios regarding other apps we publish, from our partners and from third parties. Budge Studios does not permit behavioral advertising or retargeting in this app. The app may also contain social media links that are only accessible behind a parental gate.

Budge Studios was founded in 2010 with the mission to entertain and educate children around the world, through innovation, creativity and fun. bluejetty:00134872:ios.name: Arachnifiles: Pet Tracker
bluejetty:00134872:ios.summary:
Are you an invert enthusiast—or an all-around exotic pet keeper—looking for a better way to track, learn, and grow as a keeper?
Welcome to Arachnifiles, the ultimate all-in-one tracking, learning, and community app for invertebrates and bey
bluejetty:00134872:ios.description:
Are you an invert enthusiast—or an all-around exotic pet keeper—looking for a better way to track, learn, and grow as a keeper?
Welcome to Arachnifiles, the ultimate all-in-one tracking, learning, and community app for invertebrates and beyond.
Arachnifiles goes far beyond basic pet tracking. Built with a beautiful, Pokémon-style card system, the app lets you collect, customize, and manage detailed cards for each of your pets in a visually engaging and highly organized way. Whether you keep tarantulas, true spiders, scorpions, mantids, isopods, millipedes, or even non-inverts like reptiles and amphibians, Arachnifiles adapts to your collection.
Track Everything That Matters
-Stay on top of your husbandry with powerful, flexible tracking tools:
-Feeding schedules with custom feeder types
-Molts, growth measurements, and size history
-Substrate changes, rehousing's, and maintenance logs
-Notes, reminders, and to-dos for each pet
-Individual measurement preferences per animal
-You can even create custom feeders to make logging feedings faster than ever, and custom groups to organize your collection exactly how you want.
Learn & Become a Better Keeper
-Arachnifiles isn’t just about tracking—it’s about education.
-Access 70+ professionally written care guides
-Watch supporting videos to reinforce best practices
-Explore the built-in Library to continually expand your knowledge
-Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced keeper, Arachnifiles gives you the tools to improve your care and confidence.
-Top 50 species profile breakdowns. True stats no one else has!
Wishlist & Collection Planning
-Dreaming about future additions?
-Use the Wishlist feature to track species you want to own, research them ahead of time, and plan your collection responsibly.
Connect With Keepers Worldwide
-Join a growing community of keepers from around the world:
-View other users’ public profiles and collections
-See how others house, feed, and care for their animals
-Share your own setup, experience, and progress
-Customize your public profile, showcase your collection, and connect with like-minded hobbyists who share your passion.
Built for Serious Keepers
-Arachnifiles was designed from the ground up to be the most complete keeper app available:
-Highly customizable tracking
-Powerful organization tools
-Educational resources
-Community interaction
-Beautiful, intuitive design
Whether you keep one spider or manage an entire collection, Arachnifiles gives you everything you need to be the best keeper you can be.
Download Arachnifiles today and take full control of your collection, your learning, and your passion.
Available app languages are: English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Korean, and Italian.

bluejetty:00114530:ios.name: Jigsaw Solitaire Nova
bluejetty:00114530:ios.summary:
Ready to unwind with a brand-new puzzle-solving experience?
"Jigsaw Solitaire Nova" brings you a refreshing twist: puzzle pieces fall from above, and you need to place each one in its correct spot, completing multiple beautiful images in a
bluejetty:00114530:ios.description:
Ready to unwind with a brand-new puzzle-solving experience?
"Jigsaw Solitaire Nova" brings you a refreshing twist: puzzle pieces fall from above, and you need to place each one in its correct spot, completing multiple beautiful images in a row. It masterfully blends the satisfaction of jigsaw puzzles with a light, gravity-driven drop mechanism, creating a relaxing yet brain-teasing fingertip meditation. Watch the scattered pieces drift down and be precisely placed by you — each completed image is a little healing journey.
How to Play – Simple & Addictive!
Linear levels, progressive challenge – The game uses a linear level design, starting easy and getting harder.
Pieces fall from above – Puzzle pieces constantly drop from the top of the play area. Each piece belongs to a specific image in the current level.
Drag & drop precisely into place – Hold a falling piece and drag it to the correct spot on its matching image. If the position is right, the piece snaps into place!
Complete multiple artworks in a row – Your goal is to finish all the images in the current level one after another, enjoying the sense of accomplishment as each full picture is unlocked.
Standout Features
Smooth dragging, silky feel – The intuitive drag-and-drop of falling pieces is incredibly satisfying. Every perfect placement brings a sense of joy.
Linear levels, growing challenge – No more static difficulty. As you advance, the number of images and the complexity of pieces gradually increase, keeping things fresh.
Huge image library, updated weekly – Landscapes, animals, art, healing scenes… hundreds of high-quality images, with new ones added every week across different levels.
Smart hint system – Stuck? Use a hint – it will highlight where the current piece should go, without placing it for you, so you keep the sense of achievement.
No timer, no pressure – No countdown, no penalty for mistakes. Start and pause anytime – this is your personal stress‑free space.
100% offline play – No internet required. Enjoy a round on a plane, on the subway, or tucked in bed.
"Jigsaw Solitaire Nova" is more than just a game – it's pocket‑sized yoga for your mind.
Watch the pieces fall, place them one by one, and turn chaos into complete, beautiful artworks. Every drag is a little moment of healing.
What are you waiting for? Download now, start with the first piece of the first level, and embark on your linear jigsaw journey!

bluejetty:00186455:ios.description:
Available in many languages, Maths Formulas is a perfect app on App Store that provides all basic and advanced formulas in mathematics. It's very convenient for all students in high school or university and engineers to look for any easy or complicated formulas. It includes: 
- Geometry 
- Algebra 
- Trigonometry 
- Equations 
- Analytic Geometry 
- Differentiation 
- Integration 
- Matrix
- Probability and Statistics
- Units Conversion
- Math tricks
This app also has a number of tools to calculate the geometry shapes or find the roots of equations. Users can also share any formulas to friends by many ways: email, print, or Facebook. 
New features of the app:
- Multiple languages supported: English, French, Vietnamese, Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, German, Korean, Russian, Portuguese, Italian, Greek, Thai, Indonesian, Arabic, Malay, Hindi, Bengali, Turkish, Dutch, Polish, Romanian, Farsi, Ukrainian, Azerbaijani, Hungarian, Swedish, Serbian, Khmer, Hebrew, Bulgarian, Czech, Kazakh, Uyghur and Uzbekistan (36 languages totally). Users can download other languages by setting in the language button. More languages to come soon. 
- Favorite folder: users can save frequently used formulas into this folder. 
- Search function: in each category, type on Search bar to quickly get a formula. 
- Tools to convert measurement units, including: Weight, Length, Area, Volume, Speed, Time, Temperature, etc.
- Add your own notes or formulas in "Favorite".
- Add your own customised tools in "Tools" section.
Not only for smartphones, this app is also suitable for tablets with compatible interfaces. 
A must-have app for your smartphones and tablets.

bluejetty:00033386:ios.summary:
For USA Weather only:

bluejetty:00033386:ios.description:
For USA Weather only:
wXL23 is a free, no-ads, and open-source ( GNU GPLv3 / APL2.0 ) advanced weather application that is geared towards storm chasers, meteorologists, and weather enthusiasts. NWS ( National Weather Service ) data is optimized for mobile format and provided for divisions not normally covered together in the mobile space: SPC, WPC, NHC, OPC, etc. Level 3 Nexrad radar (single, dual, quad pane). This weather app is not affiliated with NOAA or the National Weather Service. 
If you *only* need current conditions and your local 7 day forecast then this app is probably more then you need although it will easily provide those 2 things as well. If you are looking for wasted screen real estate or fancy graphics this app is not for you. Given the depth of information covered there is a steep learning curve if you seek to use the program in it's entirety, help information is available and touched on below. Common weather acronyms are used throughout so you should be familiar with those as well. Currently United States locations are supported. 
- Current forecast, 7 day conditions, sounding data for an unlimited number of locations from NWS.
- Customizable home screen
- Metal based Nexrad radar interface with numerous options. 2 pane and 4 pane version also available in MISC tab.
- Optimized text product viewer for easy access to AFD, HWO and others from any NWS WFO.
- Vis/IR/WV/Radar mosaic viewer ( with animations ).
- SPC products (such as Watches/MCDs/Convective Outlooks/Mesoanalysis)
- WPC products
- Weather models
- NHC products
NOTE: iPhone 5s or newer required for Nexrad radar viewer.

bluejetty:00095301:ios.description:
Dinosaur City Smash is a fun and action-packed game where you play as a brave mother dinosaur. The story begins when her baby is taken away by the Wildlife Organization and brought to the city. Now, the mother dino must go on a wild journey to rescue her child and bring it back home safely.
As you move through the city, you can smash buildings, break through obstacles, and face many challenges. What makes the game even more exciting is that the mother dino can transform into different animals like a lion, tiger, bear, buffalo, and more. Each animal helps in different ways during the missions.
With a mix of adventure, fun, and emotion, Dinosaur City Smash gives players a chance to explore a big city, enjoy cool transformations, and complete missions in a creative way. It’s a game full of surprises that kids and animal lovers will enjoy from start to finish!

bluejetty:00137676:ios.description:
Get ready to embark on an exciting matching adventure like never before in Goods Sorting: Match 3 Puzzle! This Pair matching puzzle game offers a unique twist on the classic match 3 genre, combining strategic sorting, and rearranged challenges with thrilling puzzle gameplay.
FEATURES:
- Challenging Sorting Gameplay: Dive into a world of goods and engage in addictive sorting puzzles. Swap and match 3 or more identical goods to clear them from the board & earn points.
- Unique Goods and Abilities: Encounter a wide variety of goods with different properties & special abilities. Some goods may explode, while others can clear entire rows or columns. - Strategize your moves to make the most of these abilities and create powerful combos.
- Exciting Power-Ups and Boosters: Unlock & use a range of power-ups & boosters to enhance your sorting abilities. These useful tools can help you overcome obstacles, clear difficult levels & achieve high scores.
- Engaging Levels & Stories: Explore different stories on this 3D sorting adventure, each with its own set of challenging levels. From bustling marketplaces to serene gardens, the visually stunning environments will keep you captivated.
- Obstacles and Limited Moves: Face various obstacles and limited moves as you progress through the game. Plan your moves carefully and strategize to overcome these challenges and complete objectives within the given limit.
HOW TO PLAY:
- Swap & rearrange adjacent goods to create matches of 3.
- Match 3 goods to create powerful combos & earn bonus points.
- Utilize the special abilities of certain goods to your advantage.
- Use power-ups and boosters strategically to overcome obstacles & clear levels.
- Achieve high scores & complete objectives to progress through the game & unlock new levels & stories.
Embark on this sorting adventure & challenge yourself with the unique gameplay of Goods Sorting: Pair Matching Puzzle. Get ready to sort, match, rearrange & conquer the exciting puzzles that await you!

bluejetty:00027055:ios.summary:
TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS OF INGREDIENT-CONSCIOUS SHOPPERS
Is your "clean" beauty actually clean? "Clean" and "nontoxic" are often just marketing. Switch Natural puts the power back in your hands by decoding what's inside.
WHY SWITCH NATURAL I
bluejetty:00027055:ios.description:
TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS OF INGREDIENT-CONSCIOUS SHOPPERS
Is your "clean" beauty actually clean? "Clean" and "nontoxic" are often just marketing. Switch Natural puts the power back in your hands by decoding what's inside.
WHY SWITCH NATURAL IS DIFFERENT:
• No Barcodes: Most apps fail if a product is new or if you're shopping online. Switch Natural reads the ingredients on the bottle or on your screen.
• Always Up-to-Date: Brands reformulate constantly. We scan what's on the label right now, not what was in a database six months ago.
• Research-Backed: We don't use arbitrary "safety scores" or confusing color codes. We identify potentially harmful ingredients and link you directly to peer-reviewed research so you can decide for yourself.
• 100% Independent: We have zero brand partnerships and no investor influence. Our only loyalty is to you.
• Human-Curated, Never AI: No AI-generated ratings and no paid verifications. Every ingredient is researched and written by a real person, not an algorithm.
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Snap: Take a photo of the ingredient list (in-store, at home, or a screenshot online).
2. Scan: Our proprietary tech (Patent Pending) instantly identifies flagged ingredients.
3. Learn: Tap any flagged ingredient to see the "why" and access the scientific research.
4. Switch: Find a safer alternative in our shop of over 4,000 vetted products. Filter by retailer, brand, price, or popularity.
PERFECT FOR:
• Navigating the world of non-toxic living.
• Checking products for your kids and family.
• Deciphering long, unpronounceable chemical names in seconds.
• Shopping with total confidence at Sephora, Target, or your local boutique.
Join a growing community of informed shoppers who've stopped trusting marketing and started reading labels.
Please note: Switch Natural is designed for personal care items like cosmetics, cleaning products, and kids' products; it is not intended for food or supplements.

bluejetty:00173996:ios.description:
Experience the thrill of a brand-new post-apocalyptic zombie shooter. Step into an infested world overrun by the undead and fight to survive in the most intense zombie battle yet!
ZOMBIE STATE is a mobile survival game that seamlessly blends the FPS and roguelike genres together. 
Fight your way through hordes of zombies, discover random weapon drops with each run, and tackle a variety of scenarios that will make each playthrough feel fresh and unpredictable. 
Dive into this Zombie FPS game and enjoy dynamic zombie-shooting gameplay, where you can:
- Blast your way through zombies with incredibly detailed 3D weapons
- Enjoy a one-of-a-kind experience combining FPS with Roguelike elements
- Discover diverse regions and game modes, exploring unique locations
- Tackle fresh challenges to unravel the secrets of the apocalypse
- Immerse yourself in FPS gameplay with stunning visuals
___
UNIQUE FUSION OF FIRST-PERSON SHOOTER AND ROGUELIKE
Each run has the potential to unlock the most powerful version of your hero. Experiment with each character’s abilities and talents to discover new synergies. Find new weapons along the way and customize your loadout to maximize your power. With endless builds, you’ll never take your finger off the trigger!
RICH ARSENAL OF WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT
Complete missions to obtain a vast collection of powerful weapons and unique gear. Blast and shoot through zombies with meticulously detailed 3D guns. Boost your strength with exclusive equipment and become the ultimate survivor.
A WORLD FULL OF MONSTERS
Along the way, you will encounter zombies with all sorts of mutations. Study their habits, find their weaknesses, and face off against terrifying boss monsters to earn valuable rewards. 
EXPERIENCE THE DIVERSITY OF EACH REGION
No two levels are the same — explore a variety of regions and game modes, each with unique locations plagued by zombies.
CHOOSE YOUR HERO
Step into the action with a roster of heroes, each equipped with a special set of skills. Whether you’re a tactical sniper or prefer the excitement of close combat, there's a hero to match your style.
THE SECRETS OF THE APOCALYPSE
This world is full of mysteries. Take on new challenges to uncover the story behind the post-apocalyptic state.
Download ZOMBIE STATE now and experience the ultimate FPS zombie shooting adventure!
___

Spend less time in lines so you can get to your destination quicker! Our free Hertz App has added flexibility, to make sure that your car rental experience is quick, easy, and always meets your needs!!
Download the Hertz® App to get immediate access to:
• Search for rental cars and Hertz locations in popular cities.
• Use the Map-view to browse rental car availability at multiple Hertz locations.
• Skip the hassle of other car rental apps with Hertz’s one-touch log-in and easy browsing experience.

• Enjoy effortless mobile navigation with menus.
• Pick up where you left off, by using your previous searches.
• Get access to exclusive offers and content with Hertz Gold Plus Rewards®.
• And much more…

• Earn Hertz Rewards points, unlock perks, and score exclusive benefits to earn free rental car days, free upgrades, and more.
• Sign up is 100% free, helping you start earning rewards faster.
• Enjoy a personalized in-app experience with your name, member number, status, and rewards points balance all in one convenient location.
• See upcoming reservations at log-in or access your complete Hertz car rental history to make new bookings and help you complete expense reports.
• Easily review or modify upcoming car rentals with a few swipes.
• Redeem, request, and exchange Hertz Rewards points to pay for your car rental directly from the app.
• Save, modify, and update your preferred payment method with ease - Store work and personal credit cards to make everything super easy!
Did You Know?

Additionally, Hertz Gold Plus Rewards was awarded Platinum status for Customer Loyalty Innovation and Transformation, and Silver status for Technology and Trends by Loyalty360 in 2021.
Thank you for being the motivation for Hertz to achieve these great awards:
• Women’s Choice Award – Best Car Rental Loyalty Program
• Ethisphere Institute Award - World’s Most Ethical Company - 2020
• Recommend Readers’ Choice Award – Best Car Rental Company (9x Winner)

• Bitacora Award – Best National Car Rental Company (7x Winner)
• Annual World Travel Awards – Favorite Car Rental Company
• And many more.

Hertz is much more than a car rental company. Our business prides itself on dedication to customers' changing needs by offering a wide variety of vehicles and services. We boast a rich history of significant first steps, ambitious ideas and innovation that has formed our company into the reputable brand it is today.

bluejetty:00169362:ios.description:
HyNote (AI Notebook) is your all-in-one AI note taker that captures, understands, and transforms everything into clear, actionable output.
From meetings and lectures to PDFs, videos, and web content—HyNote turns scattered information into structured knowledge you can instantly use.
Capture Everything 
- Record Audio & Phone Calls: Capture meetings, lectures, and calls with one tap.
- Apple Watch Notes: Record ideas instantly from your wrist, synced in real time.
- YouTube Summaries: Paste any video link and get instant summaries.
- Upload PDF & Text: Import documents and extract key insights automatically.
- Save Web Pages: Capture online articles and web content with one tap.
Understand Instantly
- AI Summaries: Get clear, concise summaries in seconds.
- Chat with ALL Your Notes: Ask anything and get answers across all your content.
- FAQ Generator: Convert notes into structured FAQs for easy review and sharing.
- SWOT Analysis: Instantly generate strategic insights from your content.
- Lecture Summary: Turn long lectures into quick, digestible summaries.
Meetings Made Easy
- Meeting Notes & Minutes: Auto-generate structured meeting summaries.
- Transcription & Speaker Identification: Convert conversations into organized, speaker-labeled notes.
- Live Translation: Translate conversations in real time, making multilingual meetings seamless.
- Follow-Up Emails: Draft ready-to-send emails from meeting discussions.
- To-Do List & Action Items: Extract tasks and next steps automatically.
Study Smarter
- Quiz & Flashcards: Turn notes into study tools for better retention.
- Study Notes: Simplify complex materials into clear summaries.
- Study Plan: Create personalized learning plans.
- Reading Notes: Summarize books and articles into key insights and takeaways.
- Problem Solver: Break down problems step by step with AI-guided solutions.
Create & Publish
- Slides (PPT): Turn notes into presentations.
- Blog & Articles: Generate polished, publish-ready content instantly.
- Podcast: Convert notes into audio overviews and deep-dive discussions.
- Infographics: Transform information into visual summaries for quick understanding.
- Brainrot Video: Generate short, engaging videos from your notes.
Stay Organized
- Auto Tags & Folders: Organize notes effortlessly.
- Snippets: Save and reuse key pieces of content for faster workflows.
- Merge: Combine multiple notebooks into one unified workspace.
HyNote isn’t just an app; it’s your personal note-taking assistant designed to adapt to your preferences and enhance your information capturing experience. Embrace the future of note-taking and make HyNote your go-to app for organizing your thoughts, notes, and life.
Term of Services: https://hynote.ai/terms

bluejetty:00033050:ios.description:
Подпишитесь, тренируйтесь и выигрывайте умные весы или поездку на Мальдивы с «FitStars»! И ваши тренировки дома станут настоящим приключением! 
«FitStars» рад приветствовать новых участников — и готов стать вашим путеводителем в мире фитнеса, который сделает заботу о здоровье лёгкой и увлекательной!
Неважно, хотите ли вы похудеть за 30 дней или просто поддерживать форму — у нас вы найдёте: упражнения для похудения, программа тренировок на любой вкус и для разного уровня подготовки.
Главный бонус нашего приложения: вы можете сохранить тренировки прямо на телефон — и оставаться мобильным в любой ситуации!
И — мы сделали это! — и с нетерпением ждём вас в разделе с полезными и вкусными рецептами! Это долгожданная опция с идеями перехода на здоровое питание и похудение.
А также у нас есть отличные новости!
Теперь в приложении «FitStars»:
Вы можете воспользоваться нашим «сезонным событием» — бесплатной ежемесячной программой: доступ к 30 тренировкам на 30 дней! Так вы легко попробуете весь наш контент. И это отличный способ познакомиться со всеми возможностями «FitStars»!
А чтобы вы могли выбрать интересные упражнения — первая тренировка из каждой программы доступна любому участнику совершенно бесплатно! Начните путь к лучшей форме вместе с нами!
Главное: все наши тренировки проводятся под руководством настоящих экспертов — супертренеров FitStars. Это профессионалы мирового уровня, мастера спорта, чемпионы России и Европы, которые с удовольствием помогают другим правильно и эффективно идти к своим спортивным целям. С ними вы не просто тренируетесь, а успешно меняете свою жизнь к лучшему!
Какие возможности дарит приложение, чтобы сделать ваш фитнес дома лёгким и увлекательным?
Очень важно, чтобы домашние тренировки были доступными и удобными. Поэтому у приложения «FitStars» для тренировки дома понятный интуитивный интерфейс, с которым подружится каждый.
Интересует новая программа тренировок, чтобы похудеть за 30 дней? С нашим приложением это легче лёгкого! Всего пара кликов на вашем смартфоне — и вы уже начинаете тренировки для похудения. Просто выбираете программу, нажимаете на видео — и фитнес онлайн меняет вашу жизнь!
Также легко подобрать упражнения под свои цели: в «FitStars» есть список самых разных программ для каждого уровня подготовки. Нужны тренировки для похудения, растяжка или йога? Всё это — в специальном разделе «Программы».
Ещё на главной странице есть специальный фильтр — по удобному времени тренировок: утро, день или вечер. Выбирайте подходящее время для своих фитнес занятий.
А как важно сохранять мотивацию и верный настрой, не так ли? Поддержать интерес к тренировкам помогут новые и уникальные варианты занятий — их легко найти в «карусели» с нашими эффективными и популярными программами.
Чтобы отслеживать свой прогресс было проще — в вашем профиле есть лента выполненных тренировок, достижения и информация о текущем весе — весь фитнес дома в одном разделе!
Кроме того, приложение «FitStars» предлагает синхронизацию выполненных и текущих тренировок и программ с сайтом. Это удобно для тех, кто хочет быть в курсе своего фитнес прогресса всегда и с любого устройства.
Как не пропустить новые акции и события? Красочные сторис в «шапке» приложения будут держать вас в курсе — интересных новостей, свежих статей и актуальных советов про эффективное похудение и фитнес-онлайн.
Статьи из Блога — теперь в удобном формате внутри приложения. Интересные материалы про питание и упражнения для похудения всегда под рукой.
И мы рады пригласить вас на наши сезонные события — только в мобильном приложении. Похудение бесплатно, новые тренировки и курсы, полезные подарки и супер-акции — всё это ждёт наших подписчиков каждый месяц!
Присоединяйтесь! И пусть наш фитнес онлайн сделает ваши домашние тренировки яркими и зажигательными!

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/clubfitstars
Instagram: @fitstars.ru

Tenha sua carteirinha digital sempre à mão e aproveite uma ampla variedade de serviços e vantagens exclusivas, que vão desde orientação médica por telefone 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, até programas de saúde e bem-estar, tudo em um só lugar. bluejetty:00064224:ios.description:
Life is stressing you out? We know a way to keep you sane!
Tease your senses with over a hundred triggers designed to relieve stress and anxiety. A perfect distraction to escape the dullness of reality and dive into a sensory paradise.
TeaseEar is based on ASMR — the most progressive relaxation method that leaves meditation and white noise far behind.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a texture
2. Touch the screen. You can tap, slide, and even scratch. Let your fingers loose!
3. Listen to the soothing sounds of the most pleasant textures and relax.
You’ll find 100+ textures that emulate a realistic tactile experience.
OUR FAVOURITES
Yogurt – a classic creamy texture mixed with raspberry jam
Honey – jelly-like, amber-coloured thingie
Confetti – tutti-frutti merry-go-round
New slimes every week!
Want to create your own virtual slime? It’s easy-peasy! And FREE!
Simply choose the foundation, add consistency agents, decorations, and set a vibration level. Voila! Your custom slime is good to go.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
TeasEar offers auto-renewing subscription options for "Premium TeasEar Features":
$7.99 - per week (with a 3-days trial period)
$24.99 - per month (with a 3-day trial period)
The "Premium TeasEar Features" subscription allows you to get access to all the triggers, and features.
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://smertrios.net/application-usage-terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://smertrios.net/application-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00076617:ios.description:
Days Since helps you count the days that passed since you last did the things that matter most to you! Create memories of important life events like starting college or a new job, keep track of when you last went to the dentist or took your dog to the vet, form new habits like a daily workout or quit old ones such as smoking. 
You can create a new counter for each event, which will display the days that passed since you last did it. You can reset the counter at any time or choose to receive reminders and display it as a widget to stay motivated. 
Features:
- Unlimited event cards to count the days since you last did something.
- Reminders in the form of daily, weekly, or monthly notifications. 
- Customizable categories to organize your events. 
- Widgets to display your events on your home screen. 
- Custom color themes
- 5 different app icons
- Great for habit tracking, ADHD routines, sobriety milestones, and productivity goals
Whether you're trying to build better habits, track emotional progress, or stay motivated through life changes—Days Since is your personal time tracker.
Download now and take control of your habits, streaks, and memories!
Apple's standard Terms of Use apply: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00142747:ios.name: GeoLoc - GPS Location Tracker
bluejetty:00142747:ios.summary: Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc is a iPhone or iPad app that helps to track your child's movements every day, and helps the family keep each other informed of their geolocations. With Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc you can see on the map where y
bluejetty:00142747:ios.description:
Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc is a iPhone or iPad app that helps to track your child's movements every day, and helps the family keep each other informed of their geolocations. With Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc you can see on the map where your child and the rest of your family are.
Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc is a hybrid self-learning system that prevents false alerts in places where GPS is not available.
Advantages:
• Accuracy in tracking
• No chaotic movements of markers on the map
• Low energy consumption
• Minimum radius of safety zones
• Without registration
Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc allows determining the location of a child and family members with a maximum accuracy to track their safety.
Capabilities:
• Always know where your child and family are
• Walkie Talkie. Turn your phone into a walkie talkie! The new function works like a regular walkie talkie, but via the Internet. Conversations with the help of a walkie talkie are fascinating and almost as fast as real communication
• Exchange messages with family members in your own chat
• Track safety of family members and receive real-time notifications
• Be aware of entering and leaving safety zones by family members
• Call your child back home by one touch
• Call your relatives not quitting the app
• Create a route to the location of your family members with the help of the navigation system
• Install a child mode on your child’s cell phone
• Connect the web version and watch the family directly from the computer [NEW]
All you need is an iPhone with the installed Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc app.
Who uses the Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc app?
Parents whose children aged 5—17 walk in the city streets to a kindergarten, school, visit relatives, walk with friends and family members every day.
For proper work of the Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc app you should activate:
• Internet connection
• Location Services (GPS)
• Wi-Fi
Important! All family members should be aware of the installed and launched Family GPS tracker by GeoLoc app on the device and they should agree to be tracked.
Tip! We recommend you to disable notifications on your child's phone to avoid distraction in school.
GeoLoc offers Premium service as a recurring subscription.
Subscription information:
- There are two types of subscription to GeoLoc Premium. The duration of the subscription can be a month or a year. In a premium subscription, you can add an unlimited number of zones and family members. Also in the Premium subscription is available a history for the month.
- Payments will be credited to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews if automatic renewal is not turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period and determine the cost of renewal
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and automatic updating can be disabled by going to the user account settings after purchasing
- Any unused part of the free trial period, if offered, will be confiscated when the user purchases a subscription to this publication, if applicable.
Privacy Policy https://geoloc.app/main_privacy_policy.html
Terms of Service https://geoloc.app/main_terms_of_use.html
Your reviews are very important for us!
Please send your offers upon possible improvements and new functions to q@geoloc.app
Your cooperation will be appreciated,
GeoLoc team.

bluejetty:00026959:ios.description:
Fishbox – the ultimate fishing companion, combining interactive fish maps, forecasts, expert guides, pro expertise, and cutting-edge AI to help you land more—and bigger—fish. Whether you’re targeting bass in freshwater lakes or trolling for salmon offshore, our app gives you everything you need to plan your perfect fishing trip.
Interactive Maps & Spot Finder:
 • Browse detailed bathymetric and satellite maps covering 50,000+ U.S. lakes, rivers, reservoirs, and coastal areas.
 • Filter by species, depth, structure, and access type to unearth secret honey holes near you.
 • Save unlimited “Favorites” and download offline map tiles for fishing in remote locations without cell service.
Real-Time Weather, Tide & Bite Forecasts
 • Precise hyperlocal forecasts for wind, barometric pressure, temperature, precipitation, solunar times, and tide charts.
 • Bite-time predictions calibrated for each species, based on AI analysis of historical catch data and current conditions.
 • Push notifications when conditions turn hot—never miss a feeding frenzy again.
Bait & Lure Finder
 • Discover proven baits—soft plastics, jigs, crankbaits, live bait—optimized by AI for each species and season.
 • Learn how to rig Texas, Carolina, drop-shot, and other setups for maximum hook-ups.
 • View curated “Top 10” lists from pros to stay on the cutting edge of new patterns.

bluejetty:00122269:ios.name: Video Collage Maker & Editor
bluejetty:00122269:ios.summary: Video Collage Maker & Editor lets you put photos and videos in one collage. Drop a video clip next to a still photo and both keep playing together in the same grid. Choose from 100 layouts, edit every cell, add music, and share your video c
bluejetty:00122269:ios.description:
Video Collage Maker & Editor lets you put photos and videos in one collage. Drop a video clip next to a still photo and both keep playing together in the same grid. Choose from 100 layouts, edit every cell, add music, and share your video collage in a few taps. Free to download.
WHAT IS VIDEO COLLAGE MAKER & EDITOR?
It is an iPhone and iPad collage maker and video editor for combining pictures and clips into a single frame. Use it as a photo grid maker, a pic stitch tool, a side by side video maker, a photo and video combiner, or a pic jointer and collage creator. There are no modes to choose: select your media and the layout tray previews every collage with your own photos and videos.
PHOTOS AND VIDEOS IN ONE COLLAGE
• Mix photos and videos in the same layout, in any order
• Merge clips and pictures into one video collage
• Side by side, split screen and stitch layouts for before-and-after, reactions and travel stories
• Pick several photos at once, or use limited photo access
100 COLLAGE LAYOUTS AND TEMPLATES
• Classic grids to stylish cut-out templates
• Drag any divider to resize cells
• Canvas ratios, including 9:16 for Reels and Stories
• Adjust the frame to create even more collage and grid options
EDIT EVERY CELL, NOT JUST THE WHOLE COLLAGE
• Trim and crop each video or photo on its own
• Change speed and volume per clip, or mute one clip and keep another
• Add music with a waveform range editor to pick the exact section
• Apply filters, effects and adjustments to a single cell
• Add text, 33 sticker packs and emoji
• Undo and redo while you work
A SIMPLE MONTAGE AND MUSIC VIDEO CREATOR
Build a video montage in minutes: choose a layout, add your clips, pick a song, then save. Great for Reels and Stories, travel diaries, birthday and family photo collages, before and after comparisons, and photo dumps.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your library stays on your device. Photos and videos are not uploaded to build a collage, and rendering happens on your iPhone or iPad.
SAVE AND SHARE
• Save your collage to your camera roll
• Share online to social apps, messages and email
• Create video collages of up to 180 seconds
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Can I put a video and a photo in the same collage? Yes. They play together in one frame.
How many layouts are there? 100 photo grid and video collage layouts.
Can I add my own music? Yes. Choose the section with the waveform editor and set per-clip volume.
Does it work as a foto collage and pic stitch app? Yes. It stitches, merges and combines pictures and clips side by side or in a grid.
Is my media uploaded? No.
Subscription Terms
- Subscribe to get unlimited access to all video collage app features.
- Upon confirmation of purchase, payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
- The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can turn off auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase.
- The renewal amount will be charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings; access continues until the end of the current period. Refunds are handled by Apple.
Terms of use - https://www.outthinkingindia.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy policy - https://www.outthinkingindia.com/privacy-policy/
Download the video collage app now.

bluejetty:00144173:ios.description:
Are you a separated parent? 
2houses is the ideal co parenting app, for all types of separated parents (with one child or more).
2houses is a set of tools that helps separated parents to communicate and become better organized for the well-being of their children. 2houses removes the emotional stress in the family.
What does 2houses propose to simplify your co parenting life?
CALENDAR: 2houses offers an interactive shared calendar with many opportunities for sharing and synchronization, which is needed for a modern family. We have also set up specific features for separated parents who can, through our interface, set a co-parenting app calendar and manage changes without any time clashes. Becoming organized in a simple way is no longer impossible for a separated family.
FINANCE: We offer a simple and effective financial management system for parents. For example, you can view reports by specific categories or periods. What other features does it have? For separated parents, 2houses manages shared expenses and continuously displays the balance to ensure equilibrated and healthy accounts.
MESSAGES: 2houses offers a simple messaging tool that is efficient and secure. Keep track of all your communications, whether with the other parent, with one of your children, or even with your mediator. You can archive your conversations or print them out, but under no circumstances can they be deleted!
INFO BANK: Are you looking for the tennis coach's contact details? Need the doctor? Stop looking everywhere for your child's information!
You will certainly find all of this in the information bank: Clothing sizes, Social Security numbers, school documents... 
JOURNAL: The journal is your quick family social network. You can share all information, news, photos, videos, and even your children’s funny quotes in a simple way. The family is never far away, no matter where you are.
ALBUMS: The photo album gives you the opportunity to share or download optimal resolution photos in a closed and secured environment. Even more memories to watch without moderation.
NOTIFICATIONS: Stay informed about your 2houses account’s activities via email and push notifications. Configure, at your leisure, the type of notification with the type of activity and do not miss a single thing.
PRIVACY & SECURITY: The information provided by you is used only to supply your account and is not used for any other purpose.
Information about children is added to the account by you without any obligation.
Your account is protected by an encrypted password that only you know. Each parent has their own access protected by a login and password. The private information of each parent (email address, credit card, phone number, etc.) is not accessible by the other.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
You need to subscribe to a paid plan to access all features after your 14-day free trial. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Your 2houses subscription can be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Apple Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of the free trial period, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to that publication.

● “It allows to change the thinking and unlock crisis.” Alice Coopter - Mediator
● "The 2houses co-parenting website makes single parenting easier." Yahoo Shine
● "Split families will avoid a lot of personal tension, stress, and discussions." Techcrunch
Contact us at contact@2houses.com with any questions or comments; 2houses would love to make your co parenting life simple !

Solve fun match 3 puzzles to help design, customize and decorate the perfect dream home with beautiful decor. Perform amazing home makeovers throughout the major Hawaiian islands for the families who took a leap to the island life. Transform their dreams into reality, your clients are waiting for you!
Meet your assistants, Luana and Mark, who will help throughout your interior designer career.

* Design and renovate different rooms: Zen bathrooms, rustic kitchens, master bedrooms, backyards, luscious gardens, and luxurious tropical getaways.
* Choose your own decor style. Farmhouse, modern, family-friendly or just for singles. You decide you choose.

Download and play Home Design: Waikiki Life now. Weekly updates are guaranteed.

Supreme Saberman is fun, gentle and equally attractive stickman fighting 3D game. With extremely simple game mechanic, you can control your warrior to defeat your enemy easily.
Coming to this lightsaber stickman 3D game you will become a Supreme Saberman to fight, eliminate enemy and evil monsters in the universe to protect your planet.

In Supreme Saberman: you will experience becoming a true warrior, you will stand between the boundary of victory and defeat, become either a winner or a loser.
HOW TO PLAY
With Supreme Saberman you only need to use basic game mechanic to be able to control the accuracy of each Supreme Saberman's fight to deal huge damage to the monster. Use the shield to help your warrior defend against those huge amount of damage from the monster. In addition, there are a number of other buffs that make the warrior stronger to quickly defeat the enemy.
Use resources and energy accumulated through stick fight with monster to upgrade strength, unlock lightsaber weapons and shields that help the stickman warrior become stronger. With this, the Supreme Saberman can defeat all monster and gain more resources. In addition, you can also upgrade to a new source of power to help the Supreme Saberman becomes more and more powerful and possesses an extremely attractive warrior.
FEATURES
Simple but addictive
With a simple style of play by choosing the center point when the clock hand runs back and forth where the Supreme Saberman can cause the greatest damage. And use the other support to help lightsaber stickman hero smoothly defeat the enemy.
Attractive Hero
With 100 attractive skin and extremely familiar to your like Captain stickman, iron stickman, SS Dragon stickman, ...
Thousands of new power with different looks and effects are waiting for your stickman hero to upgrade
Increase power
The lightsaber stickman warrior meet a enemy that is too strong and can not defeat? Increase the power and health of your stickman warrior to better withstand and deal greater damage to enemy. Also, upgrade lightsaber weapon and shield to make your Supreme Saberman stronger 
Upgrade new power and skin to make your stickman warrior stronger and more attractive
Relax and fun
with beautiful 3D graphics and vivid sound, Supreme Saberman will give you wonderful relaxing moments
Supreme Saberman
Break through levels to collect beautiful supreme skins
Stick fight to accumulate the keys to unlock the most powerful lightsaber weapon
You can stick fight with the monster to collect spin, which helps unlock the best shields so Supreme Saberman can block all the damage from monster
Energy can be collected by making your stickman hero stick fight and destroy the monster. Energy will help your hero upgrade to supreme sources of power.
With mutiple camera for you to experience Supreme Saberman better
Lightsaber stickman hero can use supports like to shield to block damage from monster, strength to increase the power of the next attack, health to heal
Use the money gained from stick fight with enemy to upgrade the blood and power of the stickman warrior to quickly possess the ultimate power to overcome all enemy
Start represent your planet to become the Supreme hero to fight against all evil monster with the SUPREME SABERMAN – LIGHTSABER STICKMAN 3D!

Digital wealth solutions

Everyday banking features
• Digital account opening - Open a Savings account with mobile banking registration.

• View your accounts - View your accounts with real time credit card transactions.

• Global Money Transfer - Send money to over 50 countries/territories in their local currencies faster with lower fee.
• 3D Secure Mobile Approval - Approve online transactions made with your HSBC Credit Card/-i and Debit Card/-i.
• Push Notification - Receive notifications to keep track of your banking activities.
• Travel Care - Purchase a travel insurance with your HSBC debit/credit card.
• Mobile Chat - Chat with us when you need help.
• Optimised for accessibility.
Credit card features
• Rewards redemption - Redeem HSBC TravelOne credit card points for airline miles and hotel stays.
• Cash Instalment Plan - Convert your available credit card limit into cash and pay at affordable instalments.
• Balance Conversion Plan - Split your credit card spending into instalment payment plans.
• Block/Unblock - Temporarily block/unblock your credit card if you have lost or misplaced it.
• Wallet Provisioning - Authenticate provisioning of credit card on digital wallets.
• Card Activation and Set PIN - Activate and set/change your Credit Card/-i PIN.
