bluejetty:00053386:android.name: Xabber
bluejetty:00053386:android.summary: Open source Jabber (XMPP) client with multi-account support, clean interface. Free (as in freedom!) and ad-free, Xabber is the best and most popular Jabber client for Android. It is built to provide users with a simple, fast and secure mess
bluejetty:00053386:android.description:
Open source Jabber (XMPP) client with multi-account support, clean interface. Free (as in freedom!) and ad-free, Xabber is the best and most popular Jabber client for Android. It is built to provide users with a simple, fast and secure messaging based on interoperable open standards. Xabber is also available for a browser, with an iOS version coming soon.
Features
★ Modern material interface and great user experience
★ Device synchronization
★ Dynamic history loading
★ Multiple account support
★ Compatible with all standard XMPP servers
★ Sending Images and Files
★ End-to-end encryption to protect your privacy
★ Rich notification settings, including key phrases (with regular expressions, no less!)
★ Efficient power management
With Xabber, you are free to customize the interface to a great extent, search and organize your contacts and even export your chats.
XMPP Features
Xabber supports many extensions to XMPP protocol, called XEPs (XMPP Extension Protocols): 
RFC-3920: Core
RFC-3921: Instant Messaging and Presence
XEP-0012: Last Activity
XEP-0030: Service Discovery
XEP-0045: Multi-User Chat (partial)
XEP-0048: Bookmarks
XEP-0054: vcard-temp
XEP-0059: Result Set Management
XEP-0078: Non-SASL Authentication
XEP-0085: Chat State Notifications
XEP-0091: Legacy Delayed Delivery
XEP-0115: Entity Capabilities
XEP-0128: Service Discovery Extensions
XEP-0138: Stream Compression
XEP-0147: XMPP URI Scheme Query Components
XEP-0153: vCard-Based Avatars
XEP-0155: Stanza Session Negotiation
XEP-0184: Message Delivery Receipts
XEP-0191: Blocking Command
XEP-0198: Stream Management
XEP-0199: XMPP Ping
XEP-0203: Delayed Delivery
XEP-0221: Data Forms Media Element
XEP-0224: Attention
XEP-0237: Roster Versioning
XEP-0280: Message Carbons
XEP-0297: Stanza Forwarding
XEP-0313: Message Archive Management
XEP-0333: Chat Markers
XEP-0359: Unique and Stable Stanza IDs
XEP-0363 HTTP Upload
Xabber is under active development and is regularly improved. Check Xabber Beta for early access to new features. 
Support policy
Let’s get the record straight: unless you are using our paid services, we don’t owe you anything. The software is provided as is, with no warranty and no guarantee to work with all ill-configured servers/networks on every device with non-stock Android crippled by phone manufacturers.
We do, however, have great sympathy for any decent person who requires support, and we do try to help. You just have to ask nicely. If you are rude, make demands, feel entitled to premium service or lecture us how to behave, we kindly ask you to uninstall our app and be gone for good. We won’t be saddened by 1-star review and we’ll likely leave a sarcastic reply.
Getting support
☆ Read F.A.Q. on our website, https://xabber.com/faq/ 
You’ll be amazed how many issues are already covered!
☆ Email info@xabber.com
This is the best way to get tech support. Be nice, and we’ll do our best to provide you help. Please, describe your issue in detail. If possible, attach screenshots and debug logs that would help us understand what went wrong.
☆ Please, DON’T ask for support in Google Play reviews!
Reviews are by far the worst way to reach out to us for tech support. XMPP is a federated protocol, which means the network consists of thousands of servers with different settings, and that there are multiple points of failure. We can’t conceivably know what went wrong from a short message, our replies are limited to 350 characters and the medium does not support back and forth exchange of information.
Source code of Xabber is available at https://github.com/redsolution/xabber-android under GNU GPLv3 license.
For more information visit https://xabber.com or follow @xabber_xmpp on Twitter.

bluejetty:00026856:ios.description:
FAX from iPhone: Fax App
Sending a fax today is an inconvenient task you face on almost a daily basis: sending paperwork gets really annoying as looking for a fax machine nearby takes much time. But it’s not a problem with a FAX from iPhone — a fax app that works as a powerful tool for sending fax online just from your iPhone. 
The fax app that makes your life easier
Our fax app can become your ultimate solution for online faxes. FAX from iPhone offers such features as: 
Advanced document scanner. Turn a paper document into a digital one effortlessly. 
Support of multiple file formats. This fax app supports all common and uncommon file formats to send and receive faxes.
Tracking a fax’ status. You can ensure your fax has reached the recipient. 
Electronic signature feature. If you need an electronic signature for a digital document, it can be easily done with our fax app! 
Convenient file import. With this fax app, importing files isn’t bothersome at all. 
Fast fax sending on previously used numbers. No need to enter one and same numbers over and over again as they’ll get saved in your faxing history. 
Reliable online fax service

bluejetty:00098801:ios.description:
Truck Maps: Trucker GPS is the all-in-one navigation tool designed specifically for professional truck drivers. Whether you're hauling across states or navigating city routes, this app helps you drive smarter, safer, and more efficiently with features tailored to the trucking life.
Key Features Built for Truckers:
• Truck-Safe Navigation
 Plan your routes with confidence. Avoid low bridges, restricted roads, and tight turns with truck-optimized GPS directions. Choose routes based on your rig’s weight, height, and type.
• Real-Time Traffic & Smart Routing
 Stay ahead of slowdowns. Get live traffic updates and automatic re-routing to save time, fuel, and stress. Never get stuck in unnecessary delays again.
• Fuel Stops & Diesel Stations
 Quickly find nearby fuel stops, diesel stations, and truck-friendly refueling points along your route. Save money and time with optimized stops.
• Truck Parking Made Easy
 Find secure truck parking any time—day or night. View real-time availability, rest areas, and locations suitable for your truck’s size.
• Repairs & Services
 Easily locate nearby truck repair shops, towing services, tire stations, and maintenance facilities when you need them most. Stay road-ready at all times.
• Live Weather Conditions
 Drive prepared with real-time weather alerts and forecasts along your route. Avoid storms, snow, and poor driving conditions with early warnings.
• Truck Stops & Weigh Stations
 Discover trusted truck stops, food options, and weigh stations in real time. Plan rest breaks and inspections without unexpected detours.
• Bridge Heights & Road Restrictions
 Avoid costly mistakes with automatic alerts for low-clearance bridges, restricted roads, and load-specific regulations on your route.
Why Choose Trucker GPS?
Unlike standard GPS apps, Truck Maps: Trucker GPS is built specifically for truckers—not cars. Every feature is designed around your daily challenges, from tight delivery windows to regulatory compliance and route planning.

bluejetty:00156585:ios.description:
GUNTRACK is a firearm inventory and gun collection management app designed to help firearm owners organize important firearm records in one secure, convenient place on iPhone and iPad.
Track firearms, ammunition, accessories, shooting activity, maintenance history, photos, costs, and collection value from your iPhone or iPad. Whether you manage a few firearms or a larger collection, GUNTRACK helps keep your firearm inventory organized and accessible when you need it.
Firearm Inventory and Records
Create detailed records for handguns, rifles, and shotguns. Store manufacturer, model, caliber, serial number, purchase information, photos, value, and other important firearm details together.
GUNTRACK works as a digital firearm inventory and gun collection management system, helping you organize your firearms without relying on scattered notes, photos, receipts, or spreadsheets.
Ammo Inventory and Caliber Tracking
Track ammunition inventory by caliber and quantity. See rounds remaining, recorded costs, and ammunition totals across your collection.
The built-in ammo tracker works alongside your firearm records so you can quickly understand what ammunition you have on hand and how it relates to the firearms in your collection.
Accessories and Equipment
Keep firearm accessories, equipment, optics, and related gear organized alongside your firearms and ammunition.
Create detailed accessory records and keep important equipment information together inside your GUNTRACK inventory.
Shooting and Range Logs
Log shooting activity and range sessions with dates, range information, firearms used, calibers, and rounds fired.
Review your shooting history and range logs to maintain a useful record of when and how firearms in your collection have been used.
Maintenance and Malfunction History
Keep firearm maintenance records organized with your collection and review maintenance history for individual firearms.
Document cleaning, service, repairs, and malfunction records to maintain a more complete history for each firearm over time.
Inventory Intelligence
Go beyond a simple gun list.
GUNTRACK Inventory Intelligence helps you understand the numbers behind your firearm collection.
View recorded investment, estimated current value, category totals, ammunition quantities, caliber information, and collection composition from one streamlined dashboard.
See where your money is invested and gain a clearer picture of the size and value of your firearm inventory.
Search, Filter, and Sort
Find firearm records quickly with search, filtering, and sorting tools.
Switch between detailed and compact record views to make browsing larger firearm, ammunition, accessory, and shooting inventories faster and easier.
Photos and Collection Details
Keep firearm photos and important record information associated with the correct inventory item, making it easier to maintain a detailed digital record of your collection.
Organize purchase details, values, calibers, accessories, ammunition, shooting activity, and maintenance history from one connected mobile experience.
Genesis 2.1.2
Genesis 2.1.2 introduces a completely redesigned GUNTRACK Mobile Edition experience for iPhone and iPad.
The Genesis release includes redesigned navigation, faster access to firearm records, improved inventory views, guided record creation, enhanced search and filtering, and the new Inventory Intelligence experience.
GUNTRACK brings firearm inventory records, ammo tracking, accessories, range logs, shooting history, maintenance records, photos, costs, and collection information together in one organized mobile app.
Whether you are building your first firearm inventory or managing a larger gun collection, GUNTRACK gives you the tools to keep your records organized and understand your collection.
Build and manage your firearm inventory with GUNTRACK Mobile Edition for iPhone and iPad.

bluejetty:00180564:ios.description:
Shared Calendar (formally Custody Calendar) is a simple one entry per day shared calendar application.
You can store a daily pattern against each Shared Calendar to store your work shifts, child custody days or any other repeating pattern.
Once added a calendar can be shared with as many people as you like. You can email or SMS invites to others who can view the calendar on the web or iPhone App. You can set permissions for people you invite to read only, read-write or read-write and invite others.
Shared Calendar can be used by anyone who needs to share a calendar ( but is especially useful for managing a childs schedule when the parents are no longer together).
• background app refresh keeps always up to date
• push notifications when entries are changed
• annotate each day with a repeating schedule (child with mum / dad, working days, nights etc...)
• full audit trail, see who changed what, no more misunderstandings!
• web interface, use the shared calendar even without an iPhone
• search your calendars
• optimised for all iPhone screen sizes

bluejetty:00151331:ios.description:
Download Melo App on your phone and receive personal beauty services at your home!
With the renewed interface of Melo App, you can find the most suitable artist for the beauty service you need and make bookings for custom at-home services with secure payment processing. 
IF YOU WANT TO USE BEAUTY SERVICES AT YOUR HOME, HOTEL ROOM OR OFFICE,
You can download Melo App, meet 3,000+ certified freelance hairdressers, and nail and makeup artists in more than 30 cities, and make use of the online booking tool at your convenience.
Available types of services:
Manicure & Pedicure
Hairdressing Services
Makeup
Skincare
Waxing & Laser Hair Removal
Barbering Services
We’re here for you! Anytime, anywhere...
Melo App Beauty Artists are here to prepare you and your loved ones on your wedding day in the most professional way; bring beauty services to your home when you can’t leave your children alone; meet the personal care and beauty needs of seniors who cannot leave home; introduce you to new and trusted artists when you are new in town; or help you any time you want to receive training to improve your skills. Our artists are just one tap away!
Time to Meet New Professionals!
After visiting the profiles of our artists, you can view their certification, customer ratings, reviews with images, preferred brands, years of experience and much more. Furthermore, you can contact the artists you want to send a request to via the chat tool, and schedule your wonderful appointment together.
Receive Gifts After Bookings!
After making a booking via Melo App, you have the chance to win travel/sample size original products and discount codes from our select cosmetic brands!
Your Money Is Safe with Us!
Thanks to our online secure payment system, Melo App keeps your money in a pool account until the confirmation that you have received the service, and your payment is not transferred to the artists until the appointment is complete.
IF YOU ARE A FREELANCER OR BEAUTY SALON EMPLOYEE LOOKING FOR NEW CUSTOMERS OR ADDITIONAL INCOME,
You can earn additional income freelancing at your leisure without subscription fees or advertising costs, and attract new customers in all the locations you want to cover. You can open your profile to tens of thousands of Melo users and always stay in touch with your existing customers on our platform. Fill out the free application form and make your first step into our Melo family! Once the approval process is complete, you can start responding to booking requests and boosting your profile to reach more customers! You can always reach our artists assistant via our WhatsApp Customer Support Line.
This Year’s Favorite Melo App Services:
Gel manicures, gel polish, eyelash extensions, microblading, wedding day makeup, waxing, hair curling, ..

bluejetty:00126933:ios.description:
SPECIAL FEATURES
- AUGMENTED REALITY - AR
- STOP CARRYING BOOK GUIDES!!!
- 100% OFFLINE TRAVEL GUIDE
- OFFLINE METRO MAP
- ZOOMABLE 100% REGIONAL OFFLINE MAPS
- PICS GALLERY
- GPS CAPABLE
- INTERACTIVE POINTS OF INTEREST on the maps showing public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals, museums, theatres, and many others.
- DAILY BASED ITINERARIES
- BUDGET BASED HOTELS & RESTAURANTS
- WHERE, WHAT & HOW TO SHOP
- NIGHTLIFE ACTIVITIES
- CITY TIPS, MOVING AROUND, COMMUTING
- SAFETY TIPS
------------------------------------------
PRODUCT DESCRIPTION
Stop carrying heavy city tours guide in your pocket. TRAVEL LIGHT!!!
With this Travel Guide you have a full city guide in your iPhone & iPod Touch.
This tourist guide is built to be used offline. No connection to Internet required, meaning no extra charges in your phone bill!!
AUGMENTED REALITY, unlike other tourist guides you will be able to discover the city with the best iPhone tool - AR - Just click on the AR button, turn yourself 360° and view on the screen where the best spots are and how to find them. You can also scroll up and down to view the closest and furthest attraction. Slide through the tutorial for more tips. 
After many requests, we bring to you your own steps with a GPS feature. Do not get lost, just take a look where you are standed.
It is a very practical city guide since it is designed to be used by itineraries. There are 4 different itineraries for the city depending on the duration of your journey. We also provide tips and advices to travelers, how to get into the city, how to move around, where to shop, where to go at night, most popular places, safety tips, etc...
Unlike other guides, this Travel Guide provides you with interactive zoomable OFFLINE MAPS (x6 zoom + GPS capable) of the region showing the attractions, public bus stops, restaurants, pubs, hotels, hospitals and many other useful points of interest. You cannot get lost!. With this guide, you will not only visit the city but also move around its region.
Tourist info for must see attractions such as Topkapı Palace, Hagia Irene, Basilica Cistern, Sultan Ahmed Mosque, Süleymaniye Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Chora Church, Maiden's Tower, Galata Tower, Dolmabahçe Palace, Sarayburnu, Hagia Sofia, Beyoğlu, İstiklal Avenue, Bosphorus Bridge, Levent, Maslak, Sapphire of Istanbul, among others. 
The travel guide is made based on travelers advices. Unlike other city guides, we can guarantee we have already visited these places and would like to give you a fancy and practical tool to make your visit a more enjoyable one.
This app contains IAPs for you to enjoy and discover the best out of your visit.

Supports: Ghana • Nigeria • Kenya • South Africa • Zambia • Uganda • Tanzania • Rwanda • Namibia • Zimbabwe • Cameroon • Liberia • Sierra Leone • Malawi • South Sudan • Cambridge International • Papua New Guinea (SBC)

• Mock exams — exam-style practice with feedback for major national exams
• Structured lessons — Primary, JHS/JSS, SHS/SSS and Grades 1–12 by topic
• Quizzes & practice tests — instant scores and explanations
• AI tutor — step-by-step help on hard questions
• Audio learning — listen to lessons and answers on the go
• Learning Hub — curriculum-aligned study resources in one place
FOR TEACHERS
• AI lesson notes & lesson plans — by country, curriculum, class, subject, strand/topic and indicators/objectives
• Schemes of learning / schemes of work — term plans by week
• Exam & assessment generator — quizzes, class tests, end-of-term exams and marking schemes
• Mock examinations — BECE/WASSCE-style papers (curriculum or standardised)
• Teaching slides — turn lessons into presentations fast
• AI teaching assistant — plan lessons, select curriculum content and generate resources with guided help
• GES teacher promotion prep — practice for Principal Superintendent (PS), Assistant Director II (ADII), Assistant Director I (ADI) and Deputy Director (DD)
• Cambridge & PNG tools — Cambridge Pathway and Papua New Guinea SBC lesson plans, notes, schemes, slides and assessments
• Multilingual classroom support where available (including Ghanaian languages)

• Kenya – CBC
• South Africa – CAPS
• Zambia – ZEC / CBC
• Uganda – NCDC

Save hours on lesson prep. Practice real exam formats. Stay aligned to your country’s curriculum—not generic global worksheets. Built for African classrooms, exam seasons and busy teachers.
Perfect for BECE prep, WASSCE prep, WAEC past questions, GES lesson notes, lesson plans, schemes of work, mock exams, teacher promotion exams, Cambridge resources, PNG SBC, homework, school and home study.
Download EduMate Africa and start studying or teaching smarter today.

EduMate Africa is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by GES, WAEC, NERDC, KICD, the South African Department of Basic Education, Zambian curriculum authorities, NCDC, UNEB, TIE (Tanzania), REB (Rwanda), NIED, ZIMSEC, the Zimbabwe Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, MINEDUB, MINESEC, the Liberian Ministry of Education, the Sierra Leone Ministry of Basic and Senior Secondary Education, Malawi MoEST/MANEB, South Sudan MoGEI/NCDC, Cambridge Assessment International Education, the Papua New Guinea Department of Education / NDoE, or any government exam body. bluejetty:00151057:ios.name: REPSLog
bluejetty:00151057:ios.summary: Looking to save on taxes? Claiming REPS or unlocking the STR Loophole with the IRS could be your key! REPSLog is the hour-tracking app for real estate investors who claim Real Estate Professional Status (REPS) or the short-term rental (STR)
bluejetty:00151057:ios.description:
Looking to save on taxes? Claiming REPS or unlocking the STR Loophole with the IRS could be your key! REPSLog is the hour-tracking app for real estate investors who claim Real Estate Professional Status (REPS) or the short-term rental (STR) loophole. Log every hour of material participation with the date, property, category, participant and receipt attached, and hand your CPA an audit-ready PDF and CSV at tax time. iPhone and web app (app.reps-log.com), one account, synced in seconds.
WHY A CONTEMPORANEOUS LOG
The IRS expects a dated record of your hours kept as you go, not one rebuilt in April.
• REPS: more than 750 hours and more than half of your working time in real property trades or businesses, plus material participation in your rentals (the 500-hour test).
• STR loophole: material participation in your short-term rentals, typically 500+ hours, or 100+ hours and more than anyone else.
REPSLog keeps a counter for each test and each property.
LOG HOURS IN SECONDS
• One entry form: what, when, how long, which property, who did it, with evidence attached.
• Voice Logging: tap the mic, say what you did, and watch the entry write itself. Live chips confirm duration, property and date.
• AI Entry Autofill: type one sentence and the duration, property, category and date fill in.
• Built-in Timer with Live Activity and Dynamic Island: time the work as it happens, from the lock screen.
• Quick Actions: long-press the app icon to add an entry or start the timer.
• Recurring and Common Activities: one-tap tiles for routine landlord and STR tasks.
• Suggested for You: personalized AI entry suggestions learned from your own log.
• Duplicate an entry, or backdate one to the day the work happened.
PROVE IT
• Evidence Attachments: receipts, photos, PDFs, Word and Excel files on every entry, with notes.
• AI Receipt and Document Reading writes a plain-language note for each receipt or PDF.
• Smart Search finds entries by meaning, and by what is inside your receipts.
• Entry Log Filters by date range, property, participant and category, with a live hours total.
TRACK THE RIGHT NUMBER
• Hours Dashboard: progress toward 750, 500 or 100 hours, by property, category and year.
• STR Loophole Tracking: every short-term rental gets its own 100 or 500-hour counter, separate from your long-term rentals.

- Seamless 2D fields and perspective 3D volumes with touch rotation.

- Black hole and white hole tools for live interaction.
- Save and load fields, rule sets, and color schemes.
- P3 color support and vivid visual presets for generative art.
Use Quantum as a physics toy, creative sandbox, teaching aid, or generative art lab. It is built for people who enjoy science, cellular automata, n-body systems, chaos, and beautiful simulations.

bluejetty:00165909:ios.name: WeChef - Recipe Organizer
bluejetty:00165909:ios.summary:
DISCOVER WECHEF: YOUR ALL-IN-ONE RECIPE & MEAL COMPANION
WeChef transforms the way you cook, plan, and explore new dishes. From turning leftovers into something exciting, to saving recipes from the web, or organizing meals for special occa
bluejetty:00165909:ios.description:
DISCOVER WECHEF: YOUR ALL-IN-ONE RECIPE & MEAL COMPANION
WeChef transforms the way you cook, plan, and explore new dishes. From turning leftovers into something exciting, to saving recipes from the web, or organizing meals for special occasions – WeChef makes cooking easier, more fun, and stress-free. It’s your go-to partner for creating tasty, well-organized, and unforgettable meals.
SEARCH RECIPES BY INGREDIENTS
Turn your fridge into inspiration! Just enter what you have on hand, and WeChef will suggest creative recipes that help you minimize waste and maximize flavor. From veggies sitting in the fridge to random pantry staples – transform them into meals you’ll actually love. Cooking smarter has never been this easy.
IMPORT RECIPES FROM THE WEB
Spotted a great recipe online? Simply paste the link into WeChef, and it will pull in the ingredients, steps, and photos for you. Build your own personalized recipe library with favorites from across the web and keep everything organized in one place. Never lose track of your go-to recipes again!
DIGITIZE RECIPES WITH THE SCANNER
Bring your handwritten notes, cookbooks, or magazine clippings into the digital age. With WeChef’s smart OCR scanner, you can convert family recipes or PDFs into editable, searchable text – and keep those culinary treasures safe forever, accessible anytime, anywhere.
MOOD-BASED RECIPE SUGGESTIONS
Not sure what you’re craving? Just tell WeChef how you feel, and get recipe ideas that match your mood. Comfort food, quick & healthy bites, or festive treats – WeChef’s smart algorithm makes sure you always land on the perfect dish.
SIMPLIFIED MEAL PLANNING
Plan your meals like a pro! Add recipes to your calendar, generate shopping lists, and even set reminders so dinner is always on time. Whether you’re prepping for the week or planning a family feast, WeChef keeps everything organized and stress-free.
SURPRISE MODE FOR ADVENTUROUS COOKS
Feeling spontaneous? Let WeChef surprise you with a random recipe! Explore new cuisines, rediscover old favorites, and add some excitement to your meals. Who knows what delicious adventure awaits?
EFFORTLESS PORTION ADJUSTMENTS
Cooking for one or feeding a crowd? WeChef automatically adjusts recipe quantities for perfect portions every time. No more guessing or wasted ingredients – just accurate, reliable measurements tailored to your needs.
INTERACTIVE RECIPE ORGANIZER
Save and organize your recipes beautifully. Sort by type, occasion, or rating, add personal notes and photos, and find your favorites in seconds. Your collection has never looked this good – or been this easy to use.
ADVANCED RECIPE SEARCH
Looking for something specific? Search by name, ingredient, category, or dietary need. Whether it’s a gluten-free dinner, a quick breakfast, or a clever way to use leftovers, WeChef helps you find exactly what you need in no time.
WHY CHOOSE WECHEF
WeChef isn’t just another recipe app – it’s your personal kitchen assistant. From inspiration and planning to cooking and sharing, it makes every step of the journey easier, more fun, and more delicious. Say goodbye to the daily “What’s for dinner?” struggle, and hello to endless possibilities.
WE’D LOVE YOUR FEEDBACK
Your opinion helps us grow! Share your ideas, suggestions, or feedback at support@wechef.site and help shape the future of WeChef. Together, we’ll make cooking even more inspiring and stress-free.

bluejetty:00185873:ios.description:
Are you ready to take on the most challenging and exhilarating bike stunts in the world?
Do you have what it takes to overcome the toughest stunt courses and emerge victorious?
Play Bike Stunt Racing Motorcycle Game now and find out!
Bike Stunt Master 3D Game is an adrenaline-pumping racing game that challenges players to perform the most daring and impressive bike stunts. With a variety of challenging courses and high-speed action, this game is sure to keep players on the edge of their seats. Whether you're a seasoned pro or new to the world of bike stunts, Bike Stunt 3D Motorcycle Game has something for everyone. So, rev your engines and get ready for the ultimate motorcycle racing experience!
KEY FEATURES:
- Stunning & immersive 3D graphics
- ASMR sound effects of high-speed bike stunts
- Responsive & intuitive controls
- Customize and upgrade your bikes
- Multiple game modes
- Race and perform stunts in a variety of locations
- Play anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection
GAMEPLAY:
Select your preferred bike rider from a roster of characters & choose your favorite stunt bike from the garage. Race through a variety of challenging courses with obstacles and hurdles. Navigate through tricky tracks and perform impressive stunts and flips. Unlock new characters and new bikes as you progress in the bike stunt driving game. Complete all the challenges in one mode to move on to the next thrilling game modes.
GAME MODES:
FREE RIDE MODE: Enjoy the experience of bike riding through various tracks and environments such as sky-high tracks, stonehenge and island environments.
LIGHT TRIGGER MODE: Drive through tracks filled with glowing lights & fire rings. When a bike crosses or passes through these lights, they will light up and add to the player's score.
PARACHUTE MODE: Race to the edge of track and launch the biker off into the air, deploy the parachute and descent to the finishing line.
CRUSH MODE: Tracks are filled with various objects that can be crushed under the wheels of a bike. Use crushing bike wheels to destroy as much as possible.
MULTIPLAYER MODE: Experience challenging and competitive racing against rival opponents in multiplayer mode.
--- JOIN OUR COMMUNITY ---
►Website: https://mobify.tech/
►YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@MobifyPK
Privacy Policy

- Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified.
You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Your use of this application is governed by the Terms of Service available at:

Lost your earbuds, headphones or keys? This app helps you find them, warns you if you leave them behind, and checks if a hidden tracker is following you.
FIND THEM WHEN THEY'RE NEARBY
1. Open the app and tap your item to start Find Nearb
bluejetty:00021234:ios.description:
Lost your earbuds, headphones or keys? This app helps you find them, warns you if you leave them behind, and checks if a hidden tracker is following you.
FIND THEM WHEN THEY'RE NEARBY
1. Open the app and tap your item to start Find Nearby.
2. Walk slowly in one direction. The app shows how close you are: Far, In the room, Close, Within arm's reach.
3. Your phone beeps and vibrates faster as you get closer.
- It tells you if you're getting closer, and when you walked past it.
- Camera view (on supported devices): see the room through your screen as you search.
- Lost the signal? It says "Lost contact" instead of guessing.
SEE WHERE YOU LEFT THEM
- Save your things. If one goes missing, see when the app last detected it, and where on a map if Location was on.
- Get walking directions there, and a street-level view where available.
- Ask Siri "Where did I leave my keys in BLE Finder?" to hear the place and time.
- Get notified once when a saved item is back in range (for gear the app can connect to, not Apple devices).
DON'T LEAVE THEM BEHIND
- Turn on Left-Behind Alert to get an alert if you walk away without a saved item. Free while the app is on screen.
- Pro: Always-On Guard keeps these alerts working when your iPhone is locked (for items it can connect to).
- Pro: Before You Go shows what's with you and what's missing. Star the items you always carry and it checks them as you leave home.
- Pro: Safe Zones alert you if you leave a place you choose without your item.
CHECK FOR HIDDEN TRACKERS — FREE
1. Tap Safety, start a scan and allow Location.
2. Keep walking with the app on screen. A scan takes 10 minutes.
3. If a device moves with you from place to place, you're warned it may be following you. One that stays close for 8 minutes is listed as worth checking.
- Found one? Track it down with distance, free.
- Warnings are saved on this iPhone for 60 days. Share a report as text.
- Your own gear? Tap "This is with me" to ignore it.
- If the screen locks, the scan can't detect some trackers, including AirTags.
- It can miss some trackers, so keep your iPhone's own tracker alerts on too.
KEEP YOUR TAGS WORKING
- A warning when a tag's battery is low (for tags that report it).
- A heads-up when a saved tag hasn't been detected for 3 days.
WATCH, WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
- Works on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, synced with iCloud.
- Apple Watch: find items from your wrist, see what's nearby and where they were last detected.
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your items at a glance.
- Control Center, Lock Screen and Action button shortcuts open Find Nearby or the Safety Scan.
- Search any device by name or brand.
GOOD TO KNOW
- Works with Bluetooth earbuds, headphones, speakers, watches and tags (keys need a Bluetooth tag).
- It only finds things that are on: earbuds closed in their case or a dead tag stay silent.
- Unnamed items show their brand, like "Sony device 3F2A". Rename yours and pick icons.
- Swiping the app away pauses alerts until you open it again.
FREE
Everything above not marked Pro, including the full Safety Scan, plus a one-minute preview of distance and voice guidance.
EXACTTRACK PRO
- Estimated distance in feet or meters
- Voice guidance, and wrist taps on Apple Watch that speed up as you get closer
- Always-On Guard
- Before You Go and the leaving-home check
- Safe Zones
- 7-day location history, and where you usually leave it
Monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Cancel anytime.
Already own ExactTrack (lifetime)? You keep distance, voice and wrist taps for life.

bluejetty:00093807:ios.description:
NOTE:
This app requires a compatible security system and an interactive MyAlarm service plan to function. 
Contact your MyAlarm Registered Installer to discuss service plans and options before downloading the app.
DESCRIPTION: 
The MyAlarm iFob Control app provides real time control and feedback of compatible, IP enabled alarm systems. 
Users can arm and disarm areas, control outputs and doors, view system troubles and alarm system history as required. 
Multiple sites are supported allowing easy interface to your home, office and holiday house etc if required, and all events performed via the app are recorded in the system history log for easy auditing. All user restrictions configured on the panel are enforced by the app meaning app users can only control areas and doors they have access to on the system. Selected MyAlarm service plans include the ability to report alarm events via push notification and email.
Each site can be configured for 10 iFob Control users and various app functions can be restricted by the system owner if required giving them total control. 
If you are in doubt how to set these options contact your MyAlarm Registered Installer for assistance. 
If you don't have a MyAlarm Registered Installer you can locate one in your area here https://www.myalarm.com.au/findInstaller
COMPATIBILITY:
The iFob app is currently only compatible with the panels listed below. 
Most older version panels can be upgraded to meet the firmware requirements by your alarm installer.
If you do not have one of the systems listed then do not download the app. 
PANELS:
* Bosch - Solution 144 Alarm Panel (via firmware upgrade to Solution 6000 v2.25 and higher)
* Bosch - Solution 6000 Alarm Panel (v2.25 and higher)
* Bosch - Solution 6000-IP Alarm Panel (v3.00 and higher)
* Digiflex - Vision-X Alarm Panel (v2.25 and higher)
* Digiflex - Vision-XIP Alarm Panel (v3.00 and higher)
IP CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS:
 * CM751 Ethernet module (v2.16)
 * CM745 3G Radio module
 * CP741 Wi-Fi Enabled Graphic Keypad
 * CP737 Wi-Fi Enabled 3.5" Graphic Keypad
REQUIREMENTS: 
For the iFob Control app to function your system needs to meet the compatibility requirements listed above. 
Your system needs to have been installed and configured for MyAlarm services and you will need to sign up for a MyAlarm service plan with your installer. 
Contact your MyAlarm installer for more information regarding your alarm system configuration and MyAlarm service plan options.

bluejetty:00114316:ios.summary:
Claw Master invites you to master claw machine gameplay as you guide a lone hero through ever-changing roguelike dungeons, clash in epic boss fights, and snatch the gear that turns the tide of battle.
Step into a playful, fast-paced advent
bluejetty:00114316:ios.description:
Claw Master invites you to master claw machine gameplay as you guide a lone hero through ever-changing roguelike dungeons, clash in epic boss fights, and snatch the gear that turns the tide of battle.
Step into a playful, fast-paced adventure where skillful claw grabs meet deep RPG choices. Easy to pick up and endlessly replayable, the game blends timing and strategy: grab resources, adapt builds, and push your limits against fearsome bosses.
How to Play:
Claw Machine Gameplay: Use the claw to grab resources, weapons, and powerups – timing and precision matter.
Roguelike Mechanics: Every run is unique with randomly generated levels, enemies, and abilities. No two playthroughs are the same!
Strategic Build System: Choose abilities to shape your playstyle – boost damage, increase luck, or push enemies back with force.
Challenging Boss Fights: Confront epic bosses with unique mechanics that demand skill and smart choices.
Character Progression: Upgrade your hero and unlock new abilities to grow stronger between runs.
Mysterious Locations: Explore diverse hidden realms filled with danger, treasure, and secrets.
Fun & Engaging: Simple controls and high-skill moments make the game perfect for both casual and hardcore players.
Key Features:
- Intuitive claw mechanic that rewards precision and timing.
- Endless variety thanks to procedurally generated dungeons and enemy layouts.
- Meaningful choices in ability selection that create powerful synergies.
- Boss encounters designed to test your builds and reflexes.
- Persistent progression that keeps each comeback satisfying.
Why You’ll Love It:
Addictive loop of experimentation and improvement: test new builds, master claw timing, unlock stronger abilities, and tackle tougher bosses.
Clear progression and skill growth – your decisions and practice matter.
Accessible controls with high-skill depth for players who love mastery and discovery.
Ready to become the ultimate Claw Master? Pick up the claw, embrace the roguelike challenge, explore mysterious dungeons, and fight epic bosses to prove your heroism.

bluejetty:00027102:ios.name: Zulu Time
bluejetty:00027102:ios.summary: An iPhone, Apple Watch and iPad app to see Local and Zulu time (GMT) or multiple time zones in a single glance. Includes Widgets for both the iPhone and Apple Watch. Useful for pilots in getting weather briefings and filing flight plans, or
bluejetty:00027102:ios.description:
An iPhone, Apple Watch and iPad app to see Local and Zulu time (GMT) or multiple time zones in a single glance. Includes Widgets for both the iPhone and Apple Watch. Useful for pilots in getting weather briefings and filing flight plans, or Ham radio operators to do timezone conversions. No more worrying about getting the timezone offset correct or Daylight Savings Time conversions. Easily convert from different time zones, including times in the future or past.
On the iPhone:
- Home and Lock Screen widgets
- The Zulu Time page gives a quick view of both Zulu and Local times
- The Offset Time page allows you to see Zulu and local time either in the future or past by entering an offset via the Offset button. Tapping either Zulu or Local times will allow you to enter a time in the future or past, synchronizing both Local and Zulu times with that offset. The offset only applies to this view (except on the iPad the offset applies to everything on the page)
- The Multiple Zones page allows you to add as many time zones as you wish in a scrolling view. Clicking on any Time Zone will allow you to change it.
on iPad:
All information is combined on one screen. You have user customizable time zones on the right hand side. On the left, you have Zulu and Local time and one customizable time zone. The offset to see future or past time can be done via the Offset button or tapping any of either the Zulu, Local or Custom time buttons on the left.
On the Watch:
Complications available in all watch faces making for glanceable ZuluTime and access to the app, which gives offset able time computation.

>>Officially Licensed by Square Enix. A latest title from the prominent Japanese pixel strategy game series.
This is the latest mobile title of the classic pixel brand IP series "OCTOPATH TRAVELER", telling a new story that takes place on the continent of Orsterra.
Players will embark on adventures and experience an immersive fantasy world created by both the meticulously crafted 3D pixel art scenes (HD-2D) and the solemn, grand background music, going through many plot stories that are either heavy, warm, or joyful.
>>Story
On the continent of Orsterra, there exist rings imbued with divine power. Three of the rings fell into the hands of three evildoers, who used the rings to fulfill their desires for wealth, power,and fame, becoming the tyrants ruling this continent. Their endless hunger plunged the once-peaceful continent into utter chaos.
On this continent gradually being eroded by darkness, you will become the "chosen one of the ring" and embark onan adventure, confronting the masters of wealth, power, and fame. Meet travelers of eight different jobs during the adventure and invite them to thejourney to defeat the evil forces together!
>>Features
◆Inheriting the gameplay of theOCTOPATH TRAVELER series, creating another JRPG classic masterpiece◆
The title features an intricatelycrafted main storyline, classic turn-based battles, and a great atmosphere of a "solo immersive RPG", allowing you to enjoy a full console gaming experience onyour phone.
◆Enhanced pixel art, creating a 3DCGfantasy world◆
The visuals continue the HD-2D pixelfantasy style of the previous title, combining 3D CG visual effects with pixel art to present an enchanting game world.
◆Form a team of 8 and strategize combos with 8 unique jobs for tactical battles◆
There are a total of 8 jobs in the game: Warrior, Dancer, Merchant, Scholar, Apothecary, Thief, Hunter, andCleric.
Each job has its own unique stats and characteristics. Players can choose to build an 8-member team with different jobs for battle based on their personal preferences.
◆Three main storylines, with animmersive experience in the Chosen One's fateful journey◆
The protagonist, the one chosen by the divine ring, is destined to confront the evil ones and restore peace to the continent.
"Wealth", "Fame", and "Power". Which of the story would you choose to begin your journey?
◆Unique Path Actions that allow youto get more resources for the journey from NPCs◆
In towns, you can obtain variousin-game resources by inquiring about information from NPCs, purchasing items from them, or even hiring them.
◆Top-notch soundtrack for theultimate gaming experience◆
Soundtracks in the game are allcrafted by Yasunori Nishiki, and recorded live. The game also features tracks from "OCTOPATH TRAVELER", alongside numerous original songs composed exclusively for this title. Together, the music brings the vivid narrative worldto life.

No accounts, no clutter — just the one tool you reach for every day, done right.
